exercises.instructionEn: UNIT 14 — Dos and Don'ts
exercises.instructionUz: 14-UNIT — Qilinadigan va qilinmaydigan ishlar
exercises.explanationUz:
UNIT NOMINING MA'NOSI:
  'Dos and Don'ts'
  = Qilinadigan va qilinmaydigan ishlar

  Bu — FE'LDAN yasalgan OT birikmasi:
     do    (qilmoq)    →  DOS    (qilinadigan
                                  ishlar)
     don't (qilma)     →  DON'TS (qilinmaydigan
                                  ishlar)

  Qoidalar ro'yxati uchun ishlatiladi:
     'the dos and don'ts of recycling'
     (qayta ishlashning qoidalari)


UNIT 14 NING ASOSIY MAVZULARI
(4-modul muqovasidan):
  • the environment   (atrof-muhit)
  • tips & rules      (maslahat va qoidalar)


GRAMMATIKASI — MODAL FE'LLAR:
  SHOULD / SHOULDN'T  →  maslahat
  MUST / MUSTN'T      →  majburiyat / taqiq
  CAN / CAN'T         →  ruxsat


BETDAGI RASM:
  Butun bet fonida QARAG'AYZOR o'rmon —
  unitning ekologik mavzusiga ishora.
  Chap tomonda o'rmonning KESILGAN qismi ham
  ko'rinadi.


BOG'LIQLIK — OLDINGI BETLAR:
  • Coursebook 88-89-bet (The Expedition,
    2-epizod) — tropik o'rmonni himoya qilish
  • Coursebook 97-bet, 14-mashq — 30 yildan
    keyingi ifloslanish, kislorod niqoblari
  Ikkalasi ham shu unitga tayyorgarlik edi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  dos and don'ts = qilinadigan va qilinmaydigan
                   ishlar
  the environment = atrof-muhit
  a tip          = maslahat
  a rule         = qoida

exercises.instructionEn: Read the statements a to e. Which refers to: health? house rules? the environment? travel? school?
exercises.instructionUz: a dan e gacha bo'lgan gaplarni o'qing. Qaysi biri quyidagilarga tegishli: sog'liq? uy qoidalari? atrof-muhit? sayohat? maktab?
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh MAVZU:
  health?            (sog'liq)
  house rules?       (uy qoidalari)
  the environment?   (atrof-muhit)
  travel?            (sayohat)
  school?            (maktab)

BESh GAP:
  a  Use buses and trams — not cars.
  b  Always have your passport with you.
  c  Eat lots of fruit and vegetables.
  d  Don't keep pets in your room.
  e  Never eat in class.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  a  →  THE ENVIRONMENT  (atrof-muhit)
  b  →  TRAVEL           (sayohat)
  c  →  HEALTH           (sog'liq)
  d  →  HOUSE RULES      (uy qoidalari)
  e  →  SCHOOL           (maktab)


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  a  Avtobus va tramvaydan foydalaning —
     mashinadan emas.
  b  Doim pasportingizni yoningizda olib yuring.
  c  Ko'p meva va sabzavot yeng.
  d  Xonangizda uy hayvonlarini saqlamang.
  e  Sinfda hech qachon ovqat yemang.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — KALIT SO'ZLAR:

  a  'buses and trams — NOT CARS'
     → jamoat transporti mashinadan ko'ra
       kamroq ifloslantiradi
     → ATROF-MUHIT

  b  'PASSPORT'
     → pasport faqat chet elga chiqishda kerak
     → SAYOHAT

  c  'FRUIT AND VEGETABLES'
     → to'g'ri ovqatlanish
     → SOG'LIQ

  d  'in your ROOM', 'PETS'
     → uydagi tartib
     → UY QOIDALARI

  e  'in CLASS'
     → sinfdagi tartib
     → MAKTAB


DIQQAT — GAPLARNING ShAKLLARI:

  BUYRUQ (tasdiq) — nima QILISh kerak:
     'USE buses and trams'
     'HAVE your passport'
     'EAT lots of fruit'

  BUYRUQ (inkor) — nima QILMASLIK kerak:
     'DON'T KEEP pets in your room'
     'NEVER EAT in class'

  Bu — unitning nomi: DOS (a, b, c) va
  DON'TS (d, e).


DIQQAT — 'NEVER' va 'DON'T':
  'DON'T eat in class.'   — oddiy taqiq
  'NEVER eat in class.'   — KUChLIROQ taqiq
  'never' buyruq gapda 'don't' o'rniga keladi
  va ma'noni kuchaytiradi.


QO'ShIMChA SAVOL:
  'Can you think of any more DOS and DON'TS for
   each subject?'
  (Har bir mavzu uchun yana qoidalar o'ylab
   topa olasizmi?)

  NAMUNA JAVOBLAR:

  ATROF-MUHIT:
     Recycle paper and glass.
     Don't throw rubbish in the street.
     Turn off the lights when you leave a room.

  SAYOHAT:
     Book your tickets early.
     Don't carry a lot of money with you.

  SOG'LIQ:
     Do exercise every day.
     Don't eat too much sugar.

  UY QOIDALARI:
     Tidy your room every day.
     Don't play loud music at night.

  MAKTAB:
     Always do your homework.
     Don't be late for class.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a tram       = tramvay
  a passport   = pasport
  to keep pets = uy hayvonlarini saqlamoq
  in class     = sinfda (artikl YO'Q)
  a subject    = mavzu; fan

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures. Find the picture which shows:
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang. Quyidagilarni ko'rsatuvchi rasmni toping:
exercises.explanationUz:
SAKKIZ RASM (A-H), O'N BAND.
Demak BA'ZI rasmlar BIR NEChA marta ishlatiladi.


RASMLARDA NIMA KO'RINADI:

  A  Qarag'ayzor o'rmon (chapda kesilgan qismi
     ham bor)
  B  To'lib ketgan simto'r axlat qutisi;
     ustida plastik shishalar va bankalar,
     atrofda sochilib yotgan axlat
  C  Plastik idishlarda o'ralgan go'sht
  D  'RECYCLE' yozuvli kulrang g'ildirakli quti
  E  Shahar ko'chasidagi qizil-oq tramvay
  F  'SUPER BUBBLES' yozuvli uchta sariq
     idish-tovoq yuvish suyuqligi
  G  Ochilgan konserva bankasi
  H  'INSECT REPELLENT' yozuvli aerozol balloni


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  pre-packaged food     →  C
   2  washing-up liquid     →  F
   3  an aluminium can      →  G
   4  a recycling bin       →  D
   5  public transport      →  E
   6  rubbish               →  B
   7  a forest              →  A
   8  plastic bottles       →  B
   9  an aerosol can        →  H
  10  a rubbish bin         →  B


DIQQAT — 'B' RASMI UCh MARTA:
  Bu rasm bir vaqtning o'zida uchta narsani
  ko'rsatadi:
     • AXLAT QUTISI (rubbish bin) — simto'r quti
     • AXLAT (rubbish) — atrofda sochilgan
     • PLASTIK ShIShALAR (plastic bottles) —
       qutining ustida

  Shuning uchun 6, 8 va 10-bandlar hammasi B.


DIQQAT — 'D' va 'B' FARQI:
  B  — oddiy AXLAT QUTISI (rubbish bin),
        to'lib ketgan, atrofi iflos
  D  — QAYTA IShLASh QUTISI (recycling bin),
        ustida 'RECYCLE' yozuvi, toza

  Kitob ataylab ikkalasini bergan —
  farqi MUHIM: biri chiqindi, biri qayta ishlash.


DIQQAT — 'F' va 'B' DAGI ShIShALAR:
  F  — idish yuvish suyuqligi idishlari
        (yangi, ishlatilayotgan)
  B  — tashlab yuborilgan plastik shishalar
        (chiqindi)

  2-band → F (washing-up liquid — mahsulot nomi)
  8-band → B (plastic bottles — chiqindi sifatida)


DIQQAT — 'G' va 'H' FARQI:
  G  — ALUMINIY BANKA (aluminium can) —
        konserva bankasi, QAYTA IShLASh mumkin
  H  — AEROZOL BALLONI (aerosol can) —
        ozon qatlamiga ZARAR beradi

  Ikkalasi ham 'can' deyiladi, lekin BUTUNLAY
  boshqa narsa!


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA (ikkinchi qism):
  'I can see A FOREST in picture A.'

  QOLIP:
     'I can see + [narsa] + in picture + [harf].'


BARCHA GAPLAR:
  I can see pre-packaged food in picture C.
  I can see washing-up liquid in picture F.
  I can see an aluminium can in picture G.
  I can see a recycling bin in picture D.
  I can see public transport in picture E.
  I can see rubbish in picture B.
  I can see a forest in picture A.       (NAMUNA)
  I can see plastic bottles in picture B.
  I can see an aerosol can in picture H.
  I can see a rubbish bin in picture B.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  pre-packaged food = oldindan o'ralgan ovqat
  washing-up liquid = idish yuvish suyuqligi
  aluminium         = alyuminiy
  a can             = banka; ballon
  a recycling bin   = qayta ishlash qutisi
  public transport  = jamoat transporti
  rubbish           = axlat, chiqindi
  a rubbish bin     = axlat qutisi
  an aerosol        = aerozol
  insect repellent  = hasharotlarga qarshi vosita

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and circle the correct item.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va to'g'ri variantni aylantiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT JUFTLIK — har birida bittasi ATROF-MUHITGA
FOYDALI, ikkinchisi ZARARLI maslahat.

DIQQAT — AUDIO ShART EMAS:
  Unit mavzusi 'the environment' — demak DOIM
  ekologik jihatdan TO'G'RI variant tanlanadi.
  Har juftlikda bittasi ochiq-oydin zararli.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  a)  Try NOT to buy pre-packaged food.
  2  b)  NEVER light fires in forests.
  3  a)  DO NOT throw plastic bottles into the sea.
  4  b)  DO NOT use aerosols.

  Ya'ni: a, b, a, b


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Oldindan o'ralgan ovqat sotib olmaslikka
     harakat qiling.
  2  O'rmonlarda hech qachon olov yoqmang.
  3  Plastik shishalarni dengizga tashlamang.
  4  Aerozollardan foydalanmang.


HAR BIRI NEGA — EKOLOGIK ASOS:

  1  PRE-PACKAGED FOOD (o'ralgan ovqat)
     Har bir o'ram — plastik CHIQINDI.
     Ochiq sotiladigan mahsulot kamroq chiqindi
     hosil qiladi.
     → 'Try NOT to buy' (a)

  2  FIRES IN FORESTS (o'rmonda olov)
     Olov o'rmon YONG'INIGA sabab bo'ladi —
     minglab daraxt va hayvon nobud bo'ladi.
     → 'NEVER light fires' (b)

  3  PLASTIC BOTTLES INTO THE SEA
     Plastik dengizda yuzlab yil chiriydi,
     baliq va qushlar halok bo'ladi.
     → 'DO NOT throw' (a)

  4  AEROSOLS (aerozollar)
     Aerozollardagi gazlar OZON qatlamini
     yemiradi.
     → 'DO NOT use aerosols' (b)


NAQSh — JAVOB TARTIBI:
  1  a  (inkor variant BIRINChI)
  2  b  (inkor variant IKKINChI)
  3  a  (inkor variant BIRINChI)
  4  b  (inkor variant IKKINChI)

  Ya'ni HAR DOIM INKOR variant to'g'ri —
  faqat uning o'rni almashib turadi.
  Kitob ataylab shunday qilgan, toki o'quvchi
  'a' yoki 'b' ni yodlab olmasin.


UCh XIL INKOR ShAKLI:
  'TRY NOT TO buy ...'   — yumshoq maslahat
  'NEVER light ...'      — qat'iy taqiq
  'DO NOT throw ...'     — taqiq
  'DO NOT use ...'       — taqiq

  'try not to + fe'l' = ... qilmaslikka harakat
  qilmoq (eng yumshoq shakl).


DIQQAT — 'LIGHT A FIRE':
  'to LIGHT a fire' = olov yoqmoq.
  light → LIT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
  Workbook 54-betda ham bor edi:
  'matches → to light a campfire'.


BOG'LIQLIK — 2-MAShQ BILAN:
  Har bir band 2-mashqdagi rasmga to'g'ri keladi:
     1  →  C  (pre-packaged food)
     2  →  A  (a forest)
     3  →  B  (plastic bottles)
     4  →  H  (an aerosol can)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to light a fire = olov yoqmoq
  to throw        = tashlamoq
  into the sea    = dengizga
  an aerosol      = aerozol
  try not to      = ... qilmaslikka harakat qilmoq

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and choose verbs from the list to complete the instructions below about table manners.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang va dasturxon odobi haqidagi quyidagi ko'rsatmalarni to'ldirish uchun ro'yxatdan fe'llarni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAVZU: TABLE MANNERS (dasturxon odobi)

RO'YXAT (8 ta fe'l, har biri BIR marta):
  eat, blow, ask, use, talk, be late, take, put


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  Never EAT with your fingers.
  2  Don't PUT your elbows on the table.
  3  Don't TALK with your mouth full.
  4  Never BLOW your nose at the table.
  5  Always ASK before you smoke.
  6  Don't BE LATE for dinner.
  7  Always USE a knife and fork.
  8  Never TAKE food from someone else's plate.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Hech qachon qo'lingiz bilan ovqat yemang.
  2  Tirsaklaringizni stolga qo'ymang.
  3  Og'zingiz to'la turib gapirmang.
  4  Dasturxonda hech qachon burningizni
     qoqmang.
  5  Chekishdan oldin doim ruxsat so'rang.
  6  Kechki ovqatga kechikmang.
  7  Doim pichoq va sanchqidan foydalaning.
  8  Hech qachon birovning likopchasidan ovqat
     olmang.


RASMLARDA NIMA KO'RINADI:
  1  Ayol IKKI QO'LLAB katta bo'lakni yeyapti
  2  Ayol TIRSAKLARINI stolga qo'yib o'tiribdi
  3  Ayol og'zi to'la holda yon tomonga
     GAPIRYAPTI
  4  Erkak dasturxonda BURNINI QOQYAPTI
  5  Ayol dasturxonda SIGARET tutgan
  6  Odamlar allaqachon o'tirishibdi, biri
     KECh KELDI
  7  Erkak pichoq va sanchqi bilan ovqatlanyapti
  8  Ayol yonidagi odamning LIKOPChASIDAN
     ovqat olyapti


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — HAR FE'LNING
'HAMROHI' BOR:

  ...with your FINGERS   →  EAT
  ...your ELBOWS         →  PUT
  ...with your MOUTH FULL →  TALK
  ...your NOSE           →  BLOW
  ...before you SMOKE    →  ASK
  ...for DINNER          →  BE LATE
  ...a KNIFE AND FORK    →  USE
  ...FOOD from someone's plate → TAKE

  Har bo'shliqdan keyingi so'z faqat BITTA
  fe'lga mos keladi — taxmin kerak emas.


DIQQAT — 6-BANDDAGI 'BE LATE':
  Ro'yxatdagi yagona IKKI SO'ZLI shakl:
     'Don't BE LATE for dinner.'

  'be' fe'li kerak, chunki 'late' — SIFAT.
  'late FOR' — predlog 'for'.


DIQQAT — 'BLOW YOUR NOSE':
  Coursebook 100-betdagi Yaponiya matnida ham
  bor edi:
  'don't blow your nose in public'

  Bu yerda esa 'AT THE TABLE' (dasturxonda).


DIQQAT — 'WITH YOUR MOUTH FULL':
  Coursebook 100-betdagi Angliya matnidan:
  'Don't talk with your mouth full.'

  Ya'ni bu qoida ANGLIYA odobiga tegishli.


DIQQAT — 5-BANDDAGI 'ASK':
  'Always ASK before you smoke.'
  Coursebook 100-bet, Angliya:
  'always ask before smoking in someone's
   house.'

  Farqi: bu yerda 'before you SMOKE' (gap),
  u yerda 'before SMOKING' (-ing).
  Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.


DIQQAT — 'SOMEONE ELSE'S':
  'someone ELSE'S plate' = birovning
  likopchasi

  Apostrof 'else' ga qo'shiladi, 'someone' ga
  emas:
     someone else's  ✓
     someone's else  ✗


BUYRUQ ShAKLLARI — UCh XIL:
  NEVER + fe'l   →  eng kuchli taqiq (1, 4, 8)
  DON'T + fe'l   →  oddiy taqiq (2, 3, 6)
  ALWAYS + fe'l  →  kuchli maslahat (5, 7)

  Ya'ni 3 ta 'never', 3 ta 'don't',
  2 ta 'always'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  table manners = dasturxon odobi
  fingers       = barmoqlar
  an elbow      = tirsak
  to blow your nose = burnini qoqmoq
  a knife       = pichoq
  a fork        = sanchqi
  a plate       = likopcha
  someone else's = birovning

exercises.instructionEn: Match the words to their opposites.
exercises.instructionUz: So'zlarni ularning ziddiga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  dangerous  →  B  safe
  2  rude       →  E  polite
  3  upset      →  F  content
  4  upwards    →  C  downwards
  5  illegal    →  D  legal
  6  protect    →  A  destroy


HAR JUFTLIK BATAFSIL:

 1  DANGEROUS ↔ SAFE
    xavfli ↔ xavfsiz
    'It's dangerous to swim here.'
    'It's safe to swim here.'
    Coursebook 103-bet: 'There is always a
    danger of accidents.'

 2  RUDE ↔ POLITE
    qo'pol ↔ odobli
    Coursebook 100-bet:
    Xitoy — 'it's very RUDE'
    Yaponiya — 'it is POLITE to take a gift'
    Kitob ikkalasini ataylab bir betda bergan!

 3  UPSET ↔ CONTENT
    xafa, ko'ngli buzilgan ↔ mamnun, ko'ngli to'q
    Coursebook 100-bet, Xitoy matni:
    'this makes people very UPSET'
    'content' — bu yerda SIFAT (mamnun),
    'mundarija' emas!

 4  UPWARDS ↔ DOWNWARDS
    yuqoriga qarab ↔ pastga qarab
    Coursebook 100-bet, Xitoy:
    'chopsticks pointing UPWARDS'
    up + wards / down + wards

 5  ILLEGAL ↔ LEGAL
    qonunga xilof ↔ qonuniy
    Coursebook 102-bet, 16e-dialog:
    'You mustn't park here — it's ILLEGAL.'
    'IL-' — inkor old qo'shimchasi.

 6  PROTECT ↔ DESTROY
    himoya qilmoq ↔ yo'q qilmoq
    Coursebook 99-bet, varaqa:
    'things we can do to PROTECT the
     environment'
    Grammar 63-bet: 'the DESTRUCTION of
    rainforests'


DIQQAT — 'IL-' INKOR QO'ShIMChASI:
  legal    →  ILlegal   (qonunga xilof)
  logical  →  ILlogical (mantiqsiz)

  'IL-' faqat 'L' bilan boshlanadigan
  so'zlarga qo'shiladi.

  Boshqa inkor qo'shimchalari:
     IM- (m, p oldidan): possible → IMpossible
                         polite → IMpolite
     IR- (r oldidan):    regular → IRregular
     IN- (qolganlar):    correct → INcorrect
     UN- (eng keng):     happy → UNhappy
                         safe → UNsafe

  DIQQAT: 'rude' ning ziddi 'IMPOLITE' ham
  bo'lishi mumkin, lekin bu mashqda 'POLITE'
  berilgan (2-band).


DIQQAT — '-WARDS' QO'ShIMChASI:
  Yo'nalish bildiradi:
     up + WARDS      = upwards (yuqoriga)
     down + WARDS    = downwards (pastga)
     back + WARDS    = backwards (orqaga)
     for + WARDS     = forwards (oldinga)
     to + WARDS      = towards (... tomon)

  'towards' — Coursebook 100-betda bor edi:
  'the toes are pointing TOWARDS the door'.


DIQQAT — 'CONTENT' IKKI MA'NOLI:
  content (SIFAT) = mamnun, ko'ngli to'q
     O'qilishi: /kənˈtent/ — urg'u OXIRIDA
  content (OT) = mundarija, tarkib
     O'qilishi: /ˈkɒntent/ — urg'u BOSHIDA

  Urg'u ma'noni o'zgartiradi!


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  dangerous  = xavfli
  safe       = xavfsiz
  rude       = qo'pol
  polite     = odobli
  upset      = xafa
  content    = mamnun
  upwards    = yuqoriga qarab
  downwards  = pastga qarab
  illegal    = qonunga xilof
  legal      = qonuniy
  to protect = himoya qilmoq
  to destroy = yo'q qilmoq

exercises.instructionEn: Read the short dialogues below and fill in the gaps.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi qisqa dialoglarni o'qing va bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAVZU: kasalliklar va maslahatlar
(Coursebook 101-betning takrori)


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  COLD
  2  COUGH
  3  DENTIST
  4  HEADACHE
  5  SLEEP
  6  SORE


TO'LIQ DIALOGLAR:

 1  A: I feel very COLD.
    B: You should put a jumper on.
    (A: Juda sovqotdim.
     B: Jemper kiyishingiz kerak.)

 2  A: Doctor, I've got a bad COUGH.
    B: You should take some cough syrup.
    (A: Doktor, qattiq yo'talyapman.
     B: Yo'tal sharbatidan ichishingiz kerak.)

 3  A: Ooh! I've got toothache.
    B: You need to see a DENTIST.
    (A: Voy! Tishim og'riyapti.
     B: Tish shifokoriga borishingiz kerak.)

 4  A: I've got a HEADACHE.
    B: You should take an aspirin.
    (A: Boshim og'riyapti.
     B: Aspirin ichishingiz kerak.)

 5  A: What's wrong with you?
    B: I feel very tired. I need to get some
       SLEEP.
    (A: Sizga nima bo'ldi?
     B: Juda charchadim. Uxlab olishim kerak.)

 6  A: I've got a SORE throat and I think I've
       got the flu.
    B: Why don't you go home and go to bed?
    (A: Tomog'im og'riyapti va menimcha
        grippga chalindim.
     B: Uyga borib yotsangiz-chi?)


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — JAVOB DOIM
DIALOGNING IKKINChI QISMIDA:

 1  'put a JUMPER on'  →  sovqotgan  →  COLD
 2  'COUGH SYRUP'      →  yo'tal     →  COUGH
 3  'toothache'        →  tish       →  DENTIST
 4  'take an ASPIRIN'  →  bosh og'rig'i
                                     →  HEADACHE
 5  'I feel very TIRED' →  uyqu      →  SLEEP
 6  '...THROAT'        →  og'riyotgan →  SORE

  Ya'ni HAR bandda javob qo'shni gapda
  yashiringan — taxmin kerak emas.


DIQQAT — 2-BANDDAGI 'A BAD COUGH':
  'a BAD cough' = qattiq yo'tal
  'bad' bu yerda 'yomon' emas, 'kuchli'
  ma'nosida.

  Shu kabi: a bad headache, a bad cold

  'cough' o'qilishi /kɒf/ — 'gh' = /f/.


DIQQAT — 3-BANDDAGI 'NEED TO SEE':
  'You NEED TO see a dentist.'
  'need to + fe'l' = ... qilish kerak

  'to SEE a dentist/doctor' = qabuliga bormoq
  ('ko'rmoq' emas).

  Coursebook 101-bet, 9b: 'See the dentist.'


DIQQAT — 6-BANDDAGI 'SORE':
  'a SORE throat' = og'riyotgan tomoq
  'sore' — SIFAT (og'riyotgan, yallig'langan).

  Bo'shliq 'throat' dan OLDIN, demak SIFAT
  kerak — 'a sore throat' ✓
  ('a throat sore' ✗)


DIQQAT — 5-BANDDAGI 'GET SOME SLEEP':
  'sleep' bu yerda OT va SANALMAYDIGAN,
  shuning uchun 'SOME' bilan:
     'get SOME sleep'  ✓
     'get A sleep'     ✗


KASALLIK ARTIKLLARI (Coursebook 101-betdan):
     a cough, a headache, a cold,
     a sore throat        →  'A' bilan
     the flu              →  'THE' bilan
     toothache            →  ARTIKLSIZ

  Bu mashqda ham shu qoida saqlangan:
     'a bad COUGH'      (a)
     'a HEADACHE'       (a)
     'a SORE throat'    (a)
     'the FLU'          (the)
     'toothache'        (artiklsiz!)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a cough    = yo'tal
  a dentist  = tish shifokori
  a headache = bosh og'rig'i
  sleep      = uyqu (sanalmaydigan)
  sore       = og'riyotgan
  a throat   = tomoq
  a jumper   = jemper
  an aspirin = aspirin

exercises.instructionEn: Read the article and fill in the gaps with verbs from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Maqolani o'qing va bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi fe'llar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta fe'l, har biri BIR marta):
  throw, creates, use, protect, light, smells,
  drop, pollute


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  PROTECT
  2  USE
  3  POLLUTE
  4  CREATES
  5  DROP
  6  SMELLS
  7  THROW
  8  LIGHT


TO'LIQ MAQOLA (javoblar bilan):

  'We can all help to PROTECT the environment
   and there are a lot of things we can do.
   To start with we should USE public transport
   because cars POLLUTE the air. Packaging from
   food products CREATES a lot of rubbish.
   We should not DROP rubbish in the streets
   because it looks and SMELLS horrible.
   We mustn't THROW rubbish in the sea either
   because fish will die. Lastly, we should
   never LIGHT fires in forests or all the
   trees will burn. We should all try to help
   make a difference!'


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:
  'Hammamiz atrof-muhitni himoya qilishga
   yordam bera olamiz va qila oladigan ko'p
   ishlarimiz bor. Avvalo, jamoat transportidan
   foydalanishimiz kerak, chunki mashinalar
   havoni ifloslantiradi. Oziq-ovqat
   mahsulotlarining o'rami ko'p axlat hosil
   qiladi. Ko'chalarga axlat tashlamasligimiz
   kerak, chunki u dahshatli ko'rinadi va
   dahshatli hidlaydi. Dengizga ham axlat
   tashlamasligimiz kerak, chunki baliqlar
   nobud bo'ladi. Nihoyat, o'rmonlarda hech
   qachon olov yoqmasligimiz kerak, aks holda
   barcha daraxtlar yonib ketadi. Hammamiz
   o'zgarish yasashga harakat qilishimiz kerak!'


ENG MUHIM KALIT — RO'YXATNING O'ZI:

  Ro'yxatda IKKI fe'l '-S' bilan berilgan:
     CREATES  va  SMELLS

  Qolgan oltitasi ASOSIY shaklda:
     throw, use, protect, light, drop, pollute

  Demak '-S' li fe'llar faqat III ShAXS BIRLIK
  ega bo'lgan bo'shliqlarga tushadi:

     4) 'PACKAGING ... CREATES'
        ('packaging' — sanalmaydigan → birlik)
     6) 'IT looks and SMELLS'
        ('it' — birlik)

  Boshqa hamma bo'shliqda modal fe'l yoki
  'to' bor, demak ASOSIY shakl kerak:
     1) 'help TO protect'
     2) 'we SHOULD use'
     3) 'cars POLLUTE' (ko'plik ega!)
     5) 'we should not DROP'
     7) 'we MUSTN'T throw'
     8) 'we should never LIGHT'

  Ya'ni ro'yxat javobning yarmini AYTIB
  turibdi!


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 1  'help to ... THE ENVIRONMENT'
    Atrof-muhitni nima qilish kerak? HIMOYA.
    → PROTECT
    (Coursebook 99-bet varaqasining birinchi
     gapi: 'to PROTECT the environment')

 2  'we should ... PUBLIC TRANSPORT'
    Jamoat transportidan FOYDALANISH.
    → USE
    (Coursebook 99-bet: 'USE public transport')

 3  'because CARS ... THE AIR'
    Mashinalar havoni IFLOSLANTIRADI.
    → POLLUTE
    DIQQAT: 'cars' — KO'PLIK, shuning uchun
    '-S' YO'Q!
    (Coursebook 99-bet: 'Cars pollute the air.')

 4  'PACKAGING ... A LOT OF RUBBISH'
    O'ram ko'p axlat HOSIL QILADI.
    → CREATES
    DIQQAT: 'packaging' — SANALMAYDIGAN,
    ya'ni BIRLIK → '-S' kerak!
    (Coursebook 99-bet: 'The packaging creates
     a lot of rubbish.')

 5  'we should not ... RUBBISH IN THE STREETS'
    Ko'chaga axlat TASHLASh.
    → DROP
    (Coursebook 99-bet: 'Do not DROP rubbish
     in the street.')

 6  'because IT LOOKS AND ... HORRIBLE'
    Ko'rinadi va HIDLAYDI.
    → SMELLS
    DIQQAT: 'it' — BIRLIK, va 'looks' ham
    '-S' bilan → 'smells' ham '-S' bilan.
    (Coursebook 99-bet: 'It looks and smells
     horrible.')

 7  'we mustn't ... RUBBISH IN THE SEA'
    Dengizga axlat ULOQTIRISh.
    → THROW
    (Coursebook 99-bet: 'Do not THROW plastic
     bottles into the sea.')

 8  'we should never ... FIRES IN FORESTS'
    O'rmonda olov YOQISh.
    → LIGHT
    (Coursebook 99-bet: 'Never LIGHT fires in
     forests.')


DIQQAT — 'DROP' va 'THROW' FARQI:
  5) 'DROP rubbish in the streets'
     — tushirib yubormoq (beixtiyor, pastga)
  7) 'THROW rubbish in the sea'
     — uloqtirmoq (ataylab, uzoqqa)

  Kitob ikkalasini ataylab bir matnda bergan.


DIQQAT — 'EITHER' INKORDA:
  'We mustn't throw rubbish in the sea EITHER.'
  = dengizga HAM tashlamasligimiz kerak

  Inkor gapda 'ham' → EITHER ('too' emas).


DIQQAT — MAQOLANING TUZILISh SO'ZLARI:
  'TO START WITH' = avvalo
  'LASTLY'        = nihoyat, oxirida
  'EITHER'        = ham (inkorda)

  Bu so'zlar fikrlarni TARTIBGA soladi.


DIQQAT — 'MAKE A DIFFERENCE':
  'try to help MAKE A DIFFERENCE'
  = o'zgarish yasashga harakat qilmoq

  Turg'un ibora: bir narsani yaxshi tomonga
  o'zgartirmoq.


BU MAQOLA — COURSEBOOK 99-BETNING TAKRORI:
  Maqoladagi deyarli har gap 99-betdagi
  'HELPING THE ENVIRONMENT' varaqasidan
  olingan. Farqi:
     varaqada — BUYRUQ mayli
                ('Use public transport.')
     bu yerda — MODAL fe'l
                ('We should use public
                  transport.')


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to start with = avvalo
  packaging     = o'ram
  food products = oziq-ovqat mahsulotlari
  either        = ham (inkorda)
  lastly        = nihoyat
  to make a difference = o'zgarish yasamoq

exercises.instructionEn: Match the pictures with their meanings.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarni ularning ma'nolariga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI BELGI (A-F):

  A  Chizib tashlangan SIGARET
  B  Chizib tashlangan 'P' harfi
  C  'SPEED LIMIT 30' yozuvli to'rtburchak belgi
  D  Chizib tashlangan ChAPGA burilish strelkasi
  E  Chizib tashlangan JO'MRAK va PIYOLA
  F  Chizib tashlangan FOTOAPPARAT


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  Don't drink the water.  →  E
  2  Don't park here.        →  B
  3  Don't take pictures.    →  F
  4  Don't turn left.        →  D
  5  Don't smoke.            →  A
  6  Don't drive fast.       →  C


QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  SIGARET     →  smoke      (chekmoq)
  'P' harfi   →  park       (mashina qo'ymoq)
  30 raqami   →  drive fast (tez haydamoq)
  ChAP strelka →  turn left  (chapga burilmoq)
  JO'MRAK     →  drink water (suv ichmoq)
  FOTOAPPARAT →  take pictures (suratga olmoq)


DIQQAT — 'P' HARFI:
  Butun dunyoda 'P' = PARKING (avtoturargoh).
  Chizib tashlangan 'P' = 'NO PARKING'
  (mashina qo'yish taqiqlanadi).

  Coursebook 102-bet, 16e-dialog:
  'Can I park here?' — 'No, you can't. You
   mustn't park here — it's illegal.'


DIQQAT — 'SPEED LIMIT 30':
  Bu belgi TAQIQ emas, ChEGARA ko'rsatadi:
  soatiga 30 (mil yoki km) dan tez
  haydamaslik.

  Shuning uchun ma'nosi: 'Don't drive fast.'

  'a speed limit' = tezlik chegarasi
  Bu — to'rtburchak shaklidagi yagona belgi
  (qolganlari doira).


DIQQAT — 'E' BELGISI:
  Jo'mrak va piyola chizib tashlangan =
  bu suvni IChIB BO'LMAYDI.

  Bunday belgi ko'p mamlakatlarda
  jamoat joylaridagi jo'mraklarda turadi.

  Yozuv shakli: 'NOT DRINKING WATER' yoki
  'NON-POTABLE WATER'.


GRAMMAR BOOK 61-BET BILAN SOLIShTIRING:
  U yerda ham xuddi shunday mashq bor edi:
     Don't throw rubbish / walk / ride your
     bike / turn right / enter / touch

  Bu yerda BOShQA oltita:
     Don't drink the water / park / take
     pictures / turn left / smoke / drive fast

  Faqat 'turn' takrorlangan:
     Grammar 61: turn RIGHT
     Workbook 57: turn LEFT


BELGILARNI MODAL BILAN AYTISh:
  A  You mustn't smoke here.
  B  You mustn't park here.
  C  You mustn't drive fast.
  D  You mustn't turn left.
  E  You mustn't drink the water.
  F  You mustn't take pictures.

  'mustn't' — chunki bular QONUNIY taqiq.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to park         = mashina qo'ymoq
  a speed limit   = tezlik chegarasi
  to turn left    = chapga burilmoq
  to take pictures = suratga olmoq
  to smoke        = chekmoq
  to drive fast   = tez haydamoq

exercises.explanationUz:
MAVZU: PREDLOGLAR (Unit 14 dagi turg'un
birikmalar)


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  C (for)
  2  C (at)
  3  A (into)
  4  B (with)
  5  A (in)
  6  C (on)
  7  B (by)
  8  A (on)


HAR BIRI — TURG'UN BIRIKMA:

 1  'late FOR appointments'
    'to be late FOR something' — turg'un
    Coursebook 100-bet, Xitoy va Angliya
    matnlari: 'Never be late FOR appointments.'

 2  'leave your shoes AT the door'
    'AT the door' = eshik oldida
    Coursebook 100-bet, Yaponiya matni:
    'Leave your shoes AT the door.'

 3  'push INTO a queue'
    'to push INTO' = suqilib kirmoq
    ('into' — ichkariga HARAKAT)
    Coursebook 100-bet, Angliya matni:
    'Never push INTO a queue of people.'

 4  'talk WITH your mouth full'
    'WITH + ot + sifat' — holat qurilmasi
    Coursebook 100-bet:
    'Don't talk WITH your mouth full.'

 5  'kiss IN public'
    'IN public' = odamlar oldida (turg'un,
    artiklsiz)
    Coursebook 100-bet, Xitoy matni:
    'don't kiss anyone IN public'

 6  'pay the rent ON time'
    'ON time' = o'z vaqtida (turg'un)
    Coursebook 101-bet, 11-mashq jadvali:
    'pay the rent ON time'

 7  'be home BY 11 pm'
    'BY' = ... gacha (oxirgi muddat)
    Coursebook 101-bet va Grammar 60-bet:
    'You must be home BY 11 pm.'

 8  'write ON the desks'
    'ON' = ustiga (yuzaga yozish)
    Coursebook 102-bet, 13a-mashq:
    'You mustn't write ON the walls.'


ENG NOZIK JOYLAR:

  1) 'LATE FOR' — 'late AT/IN' XATO
     Yodda tuting: late FOR school,
     late FOR work, late FOR the party

  3) 'PUSH INTO' — 'push in' emas
     'into' harakat yo'nalishini bildiradi
     ('onto' — yuzaga chiqish, mos emas)

  6) 'ON TIME' va 'IN TIME' FARQI:
     ON time = o'z vaqtida, belgilangan paytda
        'The train arrived ON time.'
     IN time = ulgurib, kech qolmasdan
        'We arrived IN time to see the film.'

  7) 'BY' va 'UNTIL' FARQI:
     BY 11 pm    = 11 GACHA yetib kelish
                   (oxirgi muddat)
     UNTIL 11 pm = 11 GACHA turish
                   (butun vaqt davomida)

     'be home BY 11' ✓ (11 dan kechikmang)
     'be home UNTIL 11' — boshqa ma'no
     (11 gacha uyda turing)


JOY PREDLOGLARI — QISQA JADVAL:
  AT  — aniq nuqta:  at the door, at the bus
                     stop, at home
  IN  — ichida:      in the room, in public,
                     in the street
  ON  — yuzasida:    on the table, on the wall,
                     on the desk
  INTO — ichkariga HARAKAT: push into, go into


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an appointment = belgilangan uchrashuv
  a queue        = navbat
  the rent       = ijara haqi
  a desk         = parta
  Mrs Battersby  = Missis Battersbi
                   (CB 101-betdagi uy egasi)

exercises.instructionEn: HELPING THE ENVIRONMENT — the leaflet
exercises.instructionUz: ATROF-MUHITGA YORDAM BERISH — varaqa matni
exercises.explanationUz:
VARAQANING TO'LIQ MATNI VA TARJIMASI

Sarlavha:
  HELPING THE ENVIRONMENT
  (Atrof-muhitga yordam berish)

Kirish:
  'There are a lot of things we can do to
   PROTECT the environment.'
  (Atrof-muhitni HIMOYA QILISH uchun
   qila oladigan ko'p ishlarimiz bor.)


SAKKIZ KO'RSATMA:

 1  Try not to buy pre-packaged food.
    The packaging creates a lot of rubbish.
    → Oldindan o'ralgan ovqat sotib olmaslikka
      harakat qiling. O'ram ko'p axlat hosil
      qiladi.

 2  Use less washing-up liquid.
    It pollutes the seas and rivers.
    → Idish yuvish suyuqligidan KAMROQ
      foydalaning. U dengiz va daryolarni
      ifloslantiradi.

 3  Put aluminium cans into recycling bins.
    Factories can use them to make new things.
    → Alyuminiy bankalarni qayta ishlash
      qutisiga soling. Zavodlar ulardan yangi
      narsalar yasashi mumkin.

 4  Use public transport (i.e. buses, trains,
    trams, etc). Cars pollute the air.
    → Jamoat transportidan foydalaning (ya'ni
      avtobus, poyezd, tramvay va h.k.).
      Mashinalar havoni ifloslantiradi.

 5  Never light fires in forests.
    Trees will burn.
    → O'rmonlarda hech qachon olov yoqmang.
      Daraxtlar yonib ketadi.

 6  Do not drop rubbish in the street.
    It looks and smells horrible.
    Use rubbish bins.
    → Ko'chaga axlat tashlamang. U dahshatli
      ko'rinadi va dahshatli hidlaydi.
      Axlat qutilaridan foydalaning.

 7  Do not throw plastic bottles into the sea.
    Fish will die.
    → Plastik shishalarni dengizga tashlamang.
      Baliqlar nobud bo'ladi.

 8  Do not use aerosols.
    They pollute the air.
    → Aerozollardan foydalanmang.
      Ular havoni ifloslantiradi.


MATNNING TUZILIShI — HAR BANDDA IKKI GAP:

   1-gap:  KO'RSATMA  (buyruq)
   2-gap:  SABAB      (nima uchun)

  Masalan:
     KO'RSATMA:  'Try not to buy pre-packaged food.'
     SABAB:      'The packaging creates a lot of
                  rubbish.'

  Bu — 4b-mashqning kaliti: har bir savolning
  javobi IKKINCHI gap.


UCh XIL BUYRUQ ShAKLI VARAQADA:

  TASDIQ (nima qilish kerak) — 2 ta:
     'USE less washing-up liquid.'
     'PUT aluminium cans into recycling bins.'
     'USE public transport.'
     'USE rubbish bins.'

  YUMShOQ INKOR — 1 ta:
     'TRY NOT TO buy pre-packaged food.'

  QAT'IY INKOR — 4 ta:
     'NEVER light fires in forests.'
     'DO NOT drop rubbish in the street.'
     'DO NOT throw plastic bottles into the sea.'
     'DO NOT use aerosols.'


DIQQAT — SABABLARDA 'WILL':
  'Trees WILL burn.'   (Daraxtlar yonib ketadi.)
  'Fish WILL die.'     (Baliqlar nobud bo'ladi.)

  Bu — Unit 13 da o'rganilgan WILL:
  DALILGA asoslanmagan, lekin ishonchli BASHORAT.
  Ya'ni: agar shunday qilsang, natijasi shu bo'ladi.


DIQQAT — 'I.E.':
  'public transport (I.E. buses, trains, trams)'
  i.e. = lotincha 'id est' = ya'ni
  Misol keltirish uchun ishlatiladi.
  O'qilishi: 'that is' yoki harflab 'ai-i'.

tasks.en: HELPING THE ENVIRONMENT — the leaflet
tasks.uz: ATROF-MUHITGA YORDAM BERISH — varaqa matni

tasks.en: There are a lot of things we can do to protect the environment.
tasks.uz: Atrof-muhitni himoya qilish uchun qila oladigan ko'p ishlarimiz bor.
tasks.note: 'to protect' = himoya qilmoq (MAQSAD to-infinitive).

tasks.en: Try not to buy pre-packaged food. The packaging creates a lot of rubbish.
tasks.uz: Oldindan o'ralgan ovqat sotib olmaslikka harakat qiling. O'ram ko'p axlat hosil qiladi.
tasks.note: 'packaging' = o'ram (SANALMAYDIGAN).

tasks.en: Use less washing-up liquid. It pollutes the seas and rivers.
tasks.uz: Idish yuvish suyuqligidan kamroq foydalaning. U dengiz va daryolarni ifloslantiradi.
tasks.note:
'LESS' — sanalmaydigan otlar bilan
('FEWER' — sanaladigan bilan).

tasks.en: Put aluminium cans into recycling bins. Factories can use them to make new things.
tasks.uz: Alyuminiy bankalarni qayta ishlash qutisiga soling. Zavodlar ulardan yangi narsalar yasashi mumkin.
tasks.note: 'to make' — MAQSAD ('yasash uchun').

tasks.en: Use public transport (i.e. buses, trains, trams, etc). Cars pollute the air.
tasks.uz: Jamoat transportidan foydalaning (ya'ni avtobus, poyezd, tramvay va h.k.). Mashinalar havoni ifloslantiradi.
tasks.note: 'i.e.' = ya'ni.  'etc' = va hokazo.

tasks.en: Never light fires in forests. Trees will burn.
tasks.uz: O'rmonlarda hech qachon olov yoqmang. Daraxtlar yonib ketadi.
tasks.note:
'NEVER' — eng kuchli taqiq.
'will burn' — natija bashorati.

tasks.en: Do not drop rubbish in the street. It looks and smells horrible. Use rubbish bins.
tasks.uz: Ko'chaga axlat tashlamang. U dahshatli ko'rinadi va hidlaydi. Axlat qutilaridan foydalaning.
tasks.note:
'to DROP' = tushirib yubormoq, tashlamoq.
'look/smell + SIFAT' (ravish EMAS).

tasks.en: Do not throw plastic bottles into the sea. Fish will die.
tasks.uz: Plastik shishalarni dengizga tashlamang. Baliqlar nobud bo'ladi.
tasks.note:
'FISH' — ko'plik shakli ham FISH.
'fishes' — faqat turlar haqida.

tasks.en: Do not use aerosols. They pollute the air.
tasks.uz: Aerozollardan foydalanmang. Ular havoni ifloslantiradi.
tasks.note: Aerozollar ozon qatlamiga zarar beradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the leaflet and match the instructions to the pictures on p. 98, then explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Varaqani o'qing va ko'rsatmalarni 98-betdagi rasmlarga moslang, so'ngra qalin harfdagi so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
98-BETDAGI RASMLAR (eslatma):
  A  o'rmon
  B  to'lib ketgan axlat qutisi + sochilgan axlat
     + plastik shishalar
  C  plastik idishdagi go'sht (o'ralgan ovqat)
  D  'RECYCLE' yozuvli qayta ishlash qutisi
  E  tramvay (jamoat transporti)
  F  idish yuvish suyuqligi
  G  alyuminiy (konserva) banka
  H  aerozol balloni


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  pre-packaged food      →  C
  2  washing-up liquid      →  F
  3  aluminium cans /
     recycling bins         →  G va D
  4  public transport       →  E
  5  fires in forests       →  A
  6  rubbish in the street  →  B
  7  plastic bottles        →  B
  8  aerosols               →  H


DIQQAT — MOSLIK ANIQ EMAS:
  8 ta ko'rsatma, 8 ta rasm bor, lekin
  BIR-BIRIGA TENG taqsimlanmaydi:

  • 3-ko'rsatma IKKI narsani nomlaydi:
    'aluminium CANS' (G) va
    'recycling BINS' (D)

  • 6 va 7-ko'rsatmalar IKKALASI ham B rasmiga
    tegishli:
      6 — 'rubbish' va 'rubbish bins' → B
      7 — 'plastic bottles' → B (qutining
          ustida ko'rinadi)

  Bu kitobning o'z tuzilishi; taxmin bilan
  boshqacha bo'lib qo'yilmadi.


QALIN HARFDAGI SO'ZLAR — TUShUNTIRISh:

  PROTECT   = himoya qilmoq
              'to protect the environment'

  TRY       = harakat qilmoq
              'try NOT TO buy' = sotib olmaslikka
              harakat qilmoq

  CREATES   = hosil qiladi, yaratadi
              'the packaging CREATES rubbish'

  USE LESS  = kamroq foydalanmoq
              'less' — SANALMAYDIGAN otlar bilan

  POLLUTES  = ifloslantiradi
              'it POLLUTES the seas'

  FACTORIES = zavodlar
              factory → factorIES (y → ies)

  MAKE      = yasamoq
              'to MAKE new things'

  LIGHT FIRES = olov yoqmoq
              light → LIT (noto'g'ri fe'l)

  BURN      = yonmoq
              'trees will BURN'

  DROP      = tushirib yubormoq, tashlamoq
              'DROP rubbish in the street'

  LOOKS     = ko'rinadi
              'it LOOKS horrible' (SIFAT bilan)

  SMELLS    = hidlaydi, hidi keladi
              'it SMELLS horrible' (SIFAT bilan)

  THROW     = tashlamoq (uloqtirmoq)
              throw → THREW

  DIE       = nobud bo'lmoq, o'lmoq
              'fish will DIE'


DIQQAT — 'DROP' va 'THROW' FARQI:
  DROP  — tushirib yubormoq (pastga, beixtiyor)
          'Don't drop rubbish in the street.'
  THROW — uloqtirmoq (kuch bilan, uzoqqa)
          'Don't throw bottles into the sea.'


DIQQAT — 'LOOK' va 'SMELL' + SIFAT:
  'It looks HORRIBLE.'  (SIFAT — to'g'ri)
  'It looks horriblY.'  (RAVISH — XATO)

  His fe'llaridan keyin RAVISh emas, SIFAT keladi:
     look, smell, taste, sound, feel, seem

exercises.instructionEn: Read the leaflet and find the reason for each instruction. In pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Varaqani o'qing va har bir ko'rsatmaning sababini toping. Juftlikda namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: The leaflet says, 'Try not to buy
      pre-packaged food.' WHY?
  SB: BECAUSE the packaging creates a lot of
      rubbish.

  QOLIP:
     SAVOL:  The leaflet says, '...'. Why?
     JAVOB:  Because + [sabab gapi].


BARCHA SABABLAR:

 1  Try not to buy pre-packaged food. WHY?
    → BECAUSE the packaging creates a lot of
      rubbish.

 2  Use less washing-up liquid. WHY?
    → BECAUSE it pollutes the seas and rivers.

 3  Put aluminium cans into recycling bins. WHY?
    → BECAUSE factories can use them to make
      new things.

 4  Use public transport. WHY?
    → BECAUSE cars pollute the air.

 5  Never light fires in forests. WHY?
    → BECAUSE trees will burn.

 6  Do not drop rubbish in the street. WHY?
    → BECAUSE it looks and smells horrible.

 7  Do not throw plastic bottles into the sea.
    WHY?
    → BECAUSE fish will die.

 8  Do not use aerosols. WHY?
    → BECAUSE they pollute the air.


QANDAY TOPILADI — JUDA ODDIY QOIDA:
  Har bandda IKKI gap bor.
     1-gap = KO'RSATMA
     2-gap = SABAB
  Demak javob DOIM ikkinchi gap.
  Faqat oldiga 'BECAUSE' qo'shiladi.


DIQQAT — 'BECAUSE' DAN KEYIN:
  'Because the packaging CREATES ...'
  'Because it POLLUTES ...'

  Sabab gapida EGA + FE'L bo'lishi SHART.
  'Because of' — bundan farq qiladi:
     because + EGA + FE'L
     because of + OT

  'Because it pollutes the sea.'  ✓
  'Because of pollution.'         ✓
  'Because of it pollutes.'       ✗


DIQQAT — SABABLARDA IKKI XIL ZAMON:

  PRESENT SIMPLE (doimiy haqiqat) — 5 ta:
     'the packaging CREATES ...'
     'it POLLUTES ...'
     'factories CAN USE ...'
     'cars POLLUTE ...'
     'it LOOKS and SMELLS ...'
     'they POLLUTE ...'

  WILL (natija bashorati) — 2 ta:
     'trees WILL BURN'
     'fish WILL DIE'

  Farqi: birinchi guruh HOZIR ham shunday;
  ikkinchi guruh — AGAR qilsang, KEYIN shunday
  bo'ladi.


DIQQAT — 'the leaflet SAYS':
  'to say' fe'li matn/kitob/e'lon uchun
  ishlatiladi:
     'The leaflet says ...'
     'The sign says ...'
     'The book says ...'
  ('The leaflet TELLS' — XATO. 'tell' ga
   ODAM kerak: 'tell ME'.)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a leaflet   = varaqa, buklet
  a reason    = sabab
  packaging   = o'ram (SANALMAYDIGAN)
  to pollute  = ifloslantirmoq
  a factory   = zavod
  to burn     = yonmoq
  to die      = nobud bo'lmoq

exercises.instructionEn: ENGLAND — the text
exercises.instructionUz: ANGLIYA — matn
exercises.explanationUz:
MATNNING TO'LIQ NUSXASI:

  'The first thing you should remember when in
   England is always to say "please" and
   "thank you". Never push into a queue of
   people or they'll get angry. Don't be late
   for appointments and don't talk with your
   mouth full. Remember — always ask before
   smoking in someone's house.'


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:
  'Angliyada eslab qolish kerak bo'lgan
   birinchi narsa — doim "iltimos" va
   "rahmat" deyish. Odamlar navbatiga hech
   qachon suqilib kirmang, aks holda ular
   jahli chiqadi. Uchrashuvlarga kechikmang
   va og'zingiz to'la turib gapirmang.
   Esda tuting — birovning uyida chekishdan
   oldin doim ruxsat so'rang.'


ANGLIYADAGI TO'RT QOIDA:
  1  Always say 'please' and 'thank you'.
  2  Never push into a queue.
  3  Don't be late for appointments.
  4  Don't talk with your mouth full.
  5  Always ask before smoking in someone's
     house.


RASM:
  Big Ben (Vestminster soati) va qizil
  ikki qavatli avtobus — Londonning eng mashhur
  ikki ramzi.


DIQQAT — 'A QUEUE':
  queue = navbat (odamlar qatori)
  O'qilishi: /kyu/ — faqat BIRINCHI harf
  o'qiladi, qolgan 'ueue' JIM!

  Britaniyada navbat — juda muhim madaniy
  qoida. 'to push into a queue' = navbatga
  suqilib kirmoq (juda qo'pol harakat).

  Amerikada 'a line' deyiladi.


DIQQAT — 'OR THEY'LL GET ANGRY':
  Bu yerdagi 'OR' = 'aks holda'.
     'Don't do it OR you'll be sorry.'
     (Buni qilmang, AKS HOLDA afsuslanasiz.)

  'they'll get angry' — WILL bilan natija
  bashorati (Unit 13 dan).
  'to GET angry' = jahli chiqmoq
  ('to BE angry' = jahli chiqqan bo'lmoq —
   holat, harakat emas).


DIQQAT — 'WITH YOUR MOUTH FULL':
  So'zma-so'z: 'og'zingiz to'la holda'.
  Bu — 'with + OT + SIFAT' qurilmasi:
     with your mouth full
     with your eyes closed
     with the door open


DIQQAT — 'THE FIRST THING ... IS TO SAY':
  'The first thing you should remember IS
   always TO SAY ...'
  Ega — 'the first thing', kesim — 'is',
  keyin TO-INFINITIVE.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a queue          = navbat (o'qilishi /kyu/)
  to push into     = suqilib kirmoq
  to get angry     = jahli chiqmoq
  an appointment   = uchrashuv (belgilangan)
  with your mouth full = og'zi to'la holda
  to smoke         = chekmoq

exercises.instructionEn: CHINA — the text
exercises.instructionUz: XITOY — matn
exercises.explanationUz:
MATNNING TO'LIQ NUSXASI:

  'When in China, don't kiss anyone in public —
   it's very rude. Never be late for
   appointments, and don't tell jokes to people
   you don't know very well. Be careful when you
   are eating, too — never leave your chopsticks
   pointing upwards in your rice because this
   makes people very upset. A last tip — when
   you give someone a present, give it with both
   hands.'


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:
  'Xitoyda odamlar oldida hech kimni
   o'pmang — bu juda qo'pol. Uchrashuvlarga
   hech qachon kechikmang va yaxshi
   tanimaydigan odamlarga hazil aytmang.
   Ovqatlanayotganda ham ehtiyot bo'ling —
   guruchingizga tayoqchalarni tik qilib
   sanchib qo'ymang, chunki bu odamlarni juda
   xafa qiladi. Oxirgi maslahat — birovga
   sovg'a berayotganingizda, uni IKKI QO'LLAB
   bering.'


XITOYDAGI BESH QOIDA:
  1  Don't kiss anyone in public.
  2  Never be late for appointments.
  3  Don't tell jokes to people you don't know
     well.
  4  Never leave your chopsticks pointing
     upwards in your rice.
  5  Give a present with both hands.


RASM:
  Pekindagi Taqiqlangan shahar (Gugong)
  darvozasi — an'anaviy xitoy me'morchiligi.


DIQQAT — TAYOQChALAR QOIDASI:
  'never leave your chopsticks pointing
   UPWARDS in your rice'

  Nega? Guruchga TIK sanchilgan tayoqchalar
  marhumlar uchun qo'yiladigan tutatqiga
  o'xshaydi — shuning uchun juda yomon belgi
  hisoblanadi.

  Matn buni 'this makes people very UPSET'
  deb tushuntiradi.


DIQQAT — 'MAKE + kishi + SIFAT':
  'This MAKES people very UPSET.'
  (Bu odamlarni juda xafa QILADI.)

  Qurilma:  make + [kim] + [sifat]
     It makes me happy.
     It made him angry.

  'to' YO'Q: 'makes people TO be upset' — XATO.


DIQQAT — 'TELL JOKES':
  'TELL a joke'  ✓  (hazil aytmoq)
  'SAY a joke'   ✗

  'tell' bilan keladiganlar:
     tell a joke, tell a story, tell a lie,
     tell the truth


DIQQAT — 'PEOPLE YOU DON'T KNOW VERY WELL':
  So'zma-so'z: 'siz yaxshi tanimaydigan odamlar'.
  Bu yerda 'who/that' TUShIRIB QOLDIRILGAN:
     people (WHO) you don't know very well
  Ergash gapda 'who' to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa,
  tushirib qoldirish mumkin.


DIQQAT — 'IN PUBLIC':
  'in public' = odamlar oldida, ochiqchasiga
  Artikl YO'Q — turg'un ibora.
  ('in the public' — boshqa ma'no)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  rude          = qo'pol, odobsiz
  in public     = odamlar oldida
  to tell jokes = hazil aytmoq
  chopsticks    = (xitoy) tayoqchalar
  upwards       = yuqoriga qarab
  upset         = xafa, ko'ngli buzilgan
  a present     = sovg'a
  with both hands = ikki qo'llab

exercises.instructionEn: JAPAN — the text
exercises.instructionUz: YAPONIYA — matn
exercises.explanationUz:
MATNNING TO'LIQ NUSXASI:

  'When you visit someone in Japan, it is polite
   to take a gift. Remember to take your shoes
   off as you enter the house — they will give
   you special slippers to wear instead. Leave
   your shoes at the door, but make sure the
   toes are pointing towards the door. When you
   are in the living-room, don't sit anywhere
   you like — wait until someone shows you where
   to sit. Also, don't blow your nose in public —
   find a place where you can do it alone.'


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:
  'Yaponiyada birovnikiga borganingizda,
   sovg'a olib borish odobdan. Uyga
   kirayotganingizda oyoq kiyimingizni yechishni
   unutmang — ular sizga o'rniga maxsus
   shippak berishadi. Oyoq kiyimingizni
   eshik oldida qoldiring, lekin uchlari
   ESHIKKA QARAB turganiga ishonch hosil
   qiling. Mehmonxonada bo'lganingizda,
   xohlagan joyingizga o'tirmang — kimdir
   sizga qayerga o'tirishni ko'rsatgunicha
   kuting. Yana, odamlar oldida burningizni
   qoqmang — buni yolg'iz qila oladigan joy
   toping.'


YAPONIYADAGI BESH QOIDA:
  1  Take a gift when you visit someone.
  2  Take your shoes off as you enter the house.
  3  Make sure the toes point towards the door.
  4  Don't sit anywhere you like — wait until
     someone shows you where to sit.
  5  Don't blow your nose in public.


RASM:
  An'anaviy kimono va soch bezaklaridagi
  yapon ayollari (geysha).


DIQQAT — OYOQ KIYIM QOIDASI:
  Yaponiyada uyga oyoq kiyimda kirilmaydi.
  Uy egasi SHIPPAK (slippers) beradi.
  Oyoq kiyimning UCHLARI eshikka qaratib
  qo'yiladi — chiqishda oson kiyish uchun.


DIQQAT — 'TAKE OFF' — AJRALADIGAN FE'L:
  'take your shoes OFF'  ✓
  'take OFF your shoes'  ✓
  Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.

  LEKIN olmosh bilan FAQAT o'rtada:
     'take them OFF'      ✓
     'take OFF them'      ✗


DIQQAT — 'MAKE SURE':
  'MAKE SURE the toes are pointing ...'
  = ishonch hosil qiling, tekshiring

  Qurilma: make sure (that) + [to'liq gap]


DIQQAT — 'IT IS POLITE TO + fe'l':
  'It is POLITE TO TAKE a gift.'
  (Sovg'a olib borish odobdan.)

  Qurilma: It is + SIFAT + TO + fe'l
     It's rude to point at people.
     It's important to be on time.


DIQQAT — 'AS YOU ENTER':
  Bu yerdagi 'AS' = 'when' (payt).
     'as you enter the house'
     = uyga kirayotganingizda


DIQQAT — 'TO WEAR INSTEAD':
  'special slippers TO WEAR' — MAQSAD
  ('kiyish uchun maxsus shippak')
  'INSTEAD' = o'rniga (gap oxirida turadi)


DIQQAT — 'BLOW YOUR NOSE':
  'to blow your nose' = burnini qoqmoq
  (so'zma-so'z: 'burniga puflamoq')
  Yaponiyada bu odamlar oldida qo'pol
  hisoblanadi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  polite        = odobli
  a gift        = sovg'a
  to take off   = yechmoq
  to enter      = kirmoq
  slippers      = shippak
  instead       = o'rniga
  to make sure  = ishonch hosil qilmoq
  a toe         = oyoq barmog'i; (kiyim) uchi
  towards       = ... tomon
  the living-room = mehmonxona
  to blow your nose = burnini qoqmoq
  alone         = yolg'iz

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and circle the correct word in italics.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va kursiv so'zlardan to'g'risini aylantiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  ALWAYS
  2  LATE
  3  SHOES


HAR BIRI MATNDAN SO'ZMA-SO'Z TASDIQLANADI:

 1  'In England, ALWAYS/never ask before
     smoking in someone's house.'

    ANGLIYA matnining oxirgi gapi:
    'Remember — ALWAYS ask before smoking in
     someone's house.'
    → ALWAYS

 2  'In China, never be LATE/early for
     appointments.'

    XITOY matnidan:
    'NEVER BE LATE for appointments ...'
    → LATE

    DIQQAT: 'never be EARLY' mantiqan ham
    noto'g'ri — erta kelish hech qayerda
    taqiqlanmaydi.

 3  'In Japan, leave your gifts/SHOES at the
     door.'

    YAPONIYA matnidan:
    'LEAVE YOUR SHOES AT THE DOOR, but make
     sure the toes are pointing towards the
     door.'
    → SHOES

    DIQQAT: Yaponiya matnida sovg'a (gift) ham
    bor, lekin u eshik oldida QOLDIRILMAYDI —
    aksincha, uy egasiga BERILADI:
    'it is polite to TAKE a gift.'
    Kitob ataylab shu chalg'ituvchini bergan.


DEMAK AUDIO ShART EMAS:
  Kitobning o'zi 7b da aytadi:
  'Finally, READ THE TEXTS and CHECK YOUR
   ANSWERS.'
  Ya'ni matnlar javoblarni tasdiqlash uchun
  berilgan.

exercises.instructionEn: The statements from 1 to 12 are tips for visitors to England, China and Japan. Read the statements (1-12) and explain the words in bold, then guess which country each statement is for. Write J (for Japan), E (for England) or C (for China). Finally, read the texts and check your answers.
exercises.instructionUz: 1 dan 12 gacha bo'lgan gaplar — Angliya, Xitoy va Yaponiyaga boruvchilar uchun maslahatlar. Gaplarni o'qing, qalin harfdagi so'zlarni tushuntiring, so'ngra har biri qaysi mamlakat uchun ekanini toping. J (Yaponiya), E (Angliya) yoki C (Xitoy) deb yozing. Oxirida matnlarni o'qib, javoblaringizni tekshiring.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  E  (kitobda NAMUNA sifatida berilgan)
   2  J
   3  J
   4  C
   5  E
   6  J
   7  C
   8  E
   9  J
  10  E va C   (IKKI katakcha bor!)
  11  C
  12  E


MAMLAKATLAR BO'YIChA:

  ANGLIYA (E) — 5 ta:
     1  Ask before smoking in someone's house.
     5  Always say 'please' and 'thank you'.
     8  Never push into a queue of people.
    10  Don't be late for appointments.
    12  Don't talk with your mouth full.

  XITOY (C) — 4 ta:
     4  Don't kiss anyone in public.
     7  Never leave your chopsticks pointing
        upwards in your rice.
    10  Don't be late for appointments.
    11  Don't tell jokes to people you don't
        know well.

  YAPONIYA (J) — 4 ta:
     2  When you visit someone, take a gift
        with you.
     3  Take your shoes off as you enter the
        house.
     6  Don't blow your nose in public.
     9  Make sure the toes of your shoes are
        pointing towards the door.


DIQQAT — 10-BAND IKKI JAVOBLI:
  Kitobda 10-bandda IKKITA katakcha bosilgan:
     '10 Don't be late for appointments.
         ............., ............'

  Chunki bu qoida IKKI matnda ham bor:
     ANGLIYA: 'Don't be late for appointments'
     XITOY:   'Never be late for appointments'

  Javob: E va C.


DIQQAT — 'IN PUBLIC' IKKI MARTA:
  4-band: 'Don't KISS anyone in public.'  → C
  6-band: 'Don't BLOW YOUR NOSE in public.' → J

  Ikkalasida ham 'in public' bor, lekin
  HARAKAT boshqa. Faqat matnni o'qib ajratish
  mumkin:
     Xitoy matni — 'don't KISS anyone in public'
     Yaponiya matni — 'don't BLOW YOUR NOSE
                      in public'


QALIN HARFDAGI SO'ZLAR — TUShUNTIRISh:

  a GIFT = sovg'a
     'a present' bilan bir xil ma'no.

  TAKE YOUR SHOES OFF = oyoq kiyimni yechmoq
     'take off' — ajraladigan fe'l.

  to KISS = o'pmoq

  IN PUBLIC = odamlar oldida, ochiqchasiga
     Artikl YO'Q — turg'un ibora.

  BLOW YOUR NOSE = burnini qoqmoq
     So'zma-so'z: 'burniga puflamoq'.

  CHOPSTICKS POINTING UPWARDS
     = yuqoriga qaragan tayoqchalar
     chopsticks — xitoy/yapon ovqat tayoqchalari
     to point — ko'rsatmoq, qaramoq
     upwards — yuqoriga qarab

  to PUSH INTO A QUEUE = navbatga suqilib kirmoq
     queue — navbat (o'qilishi /kyu/)

  the TOES OF YOUR SHOES = oyoq kiyimning uchlari
     'a toe' — oyoq barmog'i; kiyimning uchi.

  an APPOINTMENT = belgilangan uchrashuv
     (shifokor, ish uchrashuvi va h.k.)
     Oddiy do'stona uchrashuv — 'a meeting'
     yoki 'a date'.

  a JOKE = hazil, latifa
     'TELL a joke' ('say a joke' XATO).

  MOUTH FULL = og'zi to'la
     'talk with your mouth full' — og'zi to'la
     turib gapirmoq.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — KALIT SO'ZLAR:

   2  'gift'         → Yaponiya matnida
                       'it is polite to take a
                        gift'
   3  'shoes off'    → Yaponiya matnida
                       'take your shoes off'
   4  'kiss'         → Xitoy matnida
   5  'please/thank you' → Angliya matnida
   6  'blow your nose' → Yaponiya matnida
   7  'chopsticks'   → Xitoy matnida
   8  'queue'        → Angliya matnida
   9  'toes ... towards the door' → Yaponiya
  11  'jokes'        → Xitoy matnida
  12  'mouth full'   → Angliya matnida


DIQQAT — 2-BAND VA XITOY MATNI:
  Xitoy matnida ham sovg'a haqida bor:
  'when you give someone a PRESENT, give it
   with both hands.'

  LEKIN 2-band 'TAKE a gift WITH YOU' deydi —
  ya'ni sovg'ani OLIB BORISH haqida.
  Bu — Yaponiya matnining birinchi gapi:
  'it is polite to TAKE a gift'.

  Xitoy matni esa sovg'ani QANDAY berish
  haqida (ikki qo'llab), olib borish haqida
  emas.


MATNLARDA BOR, LEKIN 12 BANDGA KIRMAGAN
QOIDALAR:
  • XITOY: give a present with both hands
  • YAPONIYA: don't sit anywhere you like —
    wait until someone shows you where to sit
  Bular 8-mashqda ishlatilishi mumkin.

exercises.instructionEn: The letter from Peter to Mick
exercises.instructionUz: Piterning Mikka yozgan xati
exercises.explanationUz:
XATNING TO'LIQ MATNI:

  Dear Mick,

  I'm afraid I have some bad news. While we
  were on holiday some thieves broke into our
  house.

  They broke in through the back door and
  nobody heard anything because we live quite
  far from the other houses. Nobody saw
  anything because it was dark. They stole our
  jewellery from the bedroom and the TV and
  video from the living-room. They also took
  the money that I had in the kitchen.

  Now I can't sleep at night because I'm afraid
  it will happen again. I don't know how to
  protect the house. Do you have any advice?

                            Best wishes,
                            Peter


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:

  Hurmatli Mik,

  Afsuski, yomon xabarim bor. Biz ta'tilda
  bo'lganimizda uyimizga o'g'rilar bostirib
  kirishdi.

  Ular orqa eshikdan kirishdi va hech kim hech
  narsa eshitmadi, chunki biz boshqa uylardan
  ancha uzoqda yashaymiz. Hech kim hech narsa
  ko'rmadi, chunki qorong'i edi. Ular yotoqxonadan
  taqinchoqlarimizni, mehmonxonadan televizor va
  videoni o'g'irlashdi. Oshxonada turgan pulimni
  ham olib ketishdi.

  Endi kechasi uxlay olmayman, chunki yana
  takrorlanishidan qo'rqaman. Uyni qanday himoya
  qilishni bilmayman. Maslahatingiz bormi?

                            Eng yaxshi tilaklar
                            bilan, Piter


ZAMONLAR — HAMMASI PAST SIMPLE:
  broke into, broke in, heard, saw, was, stole,
  took

  Chunki voqea TUGAGAN.

  Faqat oxirgi xatboshi HOZIRGI zamonda:
  'Now I CAN'T sleep', 'I'M afraid',
  'I DON'T KNOW' — chunki bu hozirgi holat.


NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR (xatdan):
  break → BROKE → BROKEN
  hear  → HEARD → HEARD
  see   → SAW   → SEEN
  steal → STOLE → STOLEN
  take  → TOOK  → TAKEN


DIQQAT — 'BREAK INTO' va 'BREAK IN':
  'break INTO a house' = uyga bostirib kirmoq
     (to'ldiruvchi BOR)
  'break IN' = bostirib kirmoq
     (to'ldiruvchi YO'Q)

  Xatda ikkalasi ham ishlatilgan:
     'thieves BROKE INTO our house'
     'They BROKE IN through the back door'


DIQQAT — 'STEAL' va 'ROB' FARQI:
  'to STEAL something' = narsani o'g'irlamoq
     'They stole our jewellery.'
  'to ROB somebody/a place' = birovni/joyni
     o'g'irlab ketmoq
     'They robbed the bank.'

  'steal' — NARSA; 'rob' — JOY yoki ODAM.


DIQQAT — 'NOBODY ... ANYTHING':
  'NOBODY heard ANYTHING.'
  = hech kim hech narsa eshitmadi

  Inglizchada IKKI INKOR ishlatilmaydi:
     'Nobody heard anything.'  ✓
     'Nobody heard nothing.'   ✗

  'nobody' allaqachon inkor, shuning uchun
  keyingi so'z 'anything' (nothing emas).


DIQQAT — 'QUITE FAR FROM':
  'quite far FROM the other houses'
  'far FROM' — predlog 'from'
  (Grammar 63-bet: 'close TO' ↔ 'far FROM')

  'quite' = ancha, ancha-muncha.


DIQQAT — 'THE MONEY THAT I HAD':
  'the money THAT I had in the kitchen'
  'that' — ergash gap bog'lovchisi
  ('which' ham bo'lardi; tushirib qoldirish
   ham mumkin: 'the money I had').


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  I'm afraid   = afsuski (yumshoq boshlanish)
  bad news     = yomon xabar (SANALMAYDIGAN)
  while        = ... paytda
  a thief      = o'g'ri (ko'pligi THIEVES)
  to break into = bostirib kirmoq
  the back door = orqa eshik
  quite far    = ancha uzoq
  dark         = qorong'i
  to steal     = o'g'irlamoq
  jewellery    = taqinchoqlar (SANALMAYDIGAN)
  a bedroom    = yotoqxona
  the living-room = mehmonxona
  to happen    = sodir bo'lmoq
  to protect   = himoya qilmoq
  advice       = maslahat (SANALMAYDIGAN)

'the money THAT I had' — ergash gap
('that' tushirib qoldirilishi mumkin).

'ADVICE' — SANALMAYDIGAN, shuning uchun
