exercises.instructionEn: Read the letter and answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Xatni o'qing va savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI SAVOL — BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  What happened when Peter was on holiday?
    → Some thieves broke into his house.
    (Uyiga o'g'rilar bostirib kirishdi.)

 2  How did the thieves get in?
    → They broke in through the back door.
    (Ular orqa eshikdan kirishdi.)

 3  Why didn't anybody hear anything?
    → Because they live quite far from the
      other houses.
    (Chunki ular boshqa uylardan ancha uzoqda
     yashaydi.)

 4  Why didn't anybody see anything?
    → Because it was dark.
    (Chunki qorong'i edi.)

 5  What did the thieves steal?
    → They stole his jewellery from the
      bedroom, the TV and video from the
      living-room and the money he had in the
      kitchen.
    (Ular yotoqxonadan taqinchoqlarni,
     mehmonxonadan televizor va videoni,
     oshxonadan pulni o'g'irlashdi.)

 6  Why can't Peter sleep at night?
    → Because he is afraid it will happen
      again.
    (Chunki u yana takrorlanishidan
     qo'rqadi.)


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — HAR JAVOB MATNDA:

  1  →  1-xatboshi:
        'some thieves BROKE INTO our house'
  2  →  2-xatboshining boshi:
        'They broke in THROUGH THE BACK DOOR'
  3  →  2-xatboshi:
        'because we live QUITE FAR FROM the
         other houses'
  4  →  2-xatboshi:
        'because IT WAS DARK'
  5  →  2-xatboshi:
        'They STOLE our jewellery ... the TV
         and video ... the money'
  6  →  3-xatboshi:
        'because I'M AFRAID IT WILL HAPPEN
         AGAIN'


ENG MUHIM QOIDA — OLMOSHLARNI O'ZGARTIRING:

  Xat BIRINCHI shaxsda yozilgan ('I', 'we',
  'our'), lekin javob UChINChI shaxsda
  bo'lishi kerak ('he', 'they', 'his'):

     Xatda:  'OUR house'
     Javobda: 'HIS house'

     Xatda:  'WE live far from'
     Javobda: 'THEY live far from'

     Xatda:  'the money that I had'
     Javobda: 'the money HE had'

     Xatda:  'I'M AFRAID'
     Javobda: 'HE IS AFRAID'

  Bu — savolga javob berishning eng ko'p
  unutiladigan qismi!


SAVOL TURLARI:
  WHAT happened?    →  voqea
  HOW did they ...? →  usul
  WHY didn't ...?   →  sabab ('Because ...')
  WHAT did they ...? → narsa


DIQQAT — 'WHY' SAVOLIGA JAVOB:
  'WHY didn't anybody hear anything?'
  → 'BECAUSE they live quite far ...'

  'Why' savoliga DOIM 'Because' bilan javob
  beriladi.


DIQQAT — 3 va 4-SAVOLDAGI 'ANYBODY':
  'Why didn't ANYBODY hear anything?'

  INKOR savolda 'nobody' emas, 'ANYBODY':
     'Didn't anybody hear?'  ✓
     'Didn't nobody hear?'   ✗

  Lekin TASDIQ gapda 'nobody':
     'NOBODY heard anything.' ✓


DIQQAT — 2-SAVOLDAGI 'GET IN':
  'How did the thieves GET IN?'
  'to get in' = kirmoq (og'zaki)
  = 'to break in' (bu holatda)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to happen    = sodir bo'lmoq
  to get in    = kirmoq
  anybody      = hech kim (inkor savolda)
  to steal     = o'g'irlamoq

tasks.en: Read the letter and answer the questions.
tasks.uz: Xatni o'qing va savollarga javob bering.

tasks.en: 1  What happened when Peter was on holiday?  —  Some thieves broke into his house.
tasks.uz: Piter ta'tilda bo'lganida nima sodir bo'ldi? — Uning uyiga o'g'rilar bostirib kirishdi.
tasks.note:
Xatning 1-xatboshisidan.
DIQQAT: 'OUR house' → 'HIS house'
(olmosh o'zgaradi!).

tasks.en: 2  How did the thieves get in?  —  They broke in through the back door.
tasks.uz: O'g'rilar qanday kirishdi? — Ular orqa eshikdan kirishdi.
tasks.note:
Xatning 2-xatboshisidan.
'to get in' = 'to break in' (bu holatda).
'THROUGH the back door' — predlog 'through'.

tasks.en: 3  Why didn't anybody hear anything?  —  Because they live quite far from the other houses.
tasks.uz: Nega hech kim hech narsa eshitmadi? — Chunki ular boshqa uylardan ancha uzoqda yashaydi.
tasks.note:
'Why' savoliga DOIM 'Because' bilan javob.
DIQQAT: 'WE live' → 'THEY live'.
'far FROM' — predlog 'from'.

tasks.en: 4  Why didn't anybody see anything?  —  Because it was dark.
tasks.uz: Nega hech kim hech narsa ko'rmadi? — Chunki qorong'i edi.
tasks.note:
Xatdan so'zma-so'z.
'IT was dark' — holat egasi 'it'.

tasks.en: 5  What did the thieves steal?  —  They stole his jewellery from the bedroom, the TV and video from the living-room and the money he had in the kitchen.
tasks.uz: O'g'rilar nimani o'g'irlashdi? — Ular yotoqxonadan taqinchoqlarni, mehmonxonadan televizor va videoni, oshxonadan pulni o'g'irlashdi.

tasks.en: 6  Why can't Peter sleep at night?  —  Because he is afraid it will happen again.
tasks.uz: Nega Piter kechasi uxlay olmaydi? — Chunki u yana takrorlanishidan qo'rqadi.
tasks.note:
Xatning 3-xatboshisidan.
DIQQAT: 'I'M afraid' → 'HE IS afraid'.
'to be afraid' = qo'rqmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Giving Advice
exercises.instructionUz: Maslahat berish
exercises.explanationUz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI — MASLAHAT BERISH

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 1 'We use SHOULD to say what the right/best
    thing to do is.'
    You SHOULD use public transport.
    (= It's a good idea.)

 2 'We use SHOULDN'T to say what isn't the
    right/best thing to do.'
    You SHOULDN'T use aerosols.
    (= It isn't a good idea.)

 3 'We can also give advice with:'
    • Why don't you ...?
    • I think it's a good idea to ...
    • I don't think it's a good idea to ...

    Why don't you use public transport?
    I think it's a good idea to use public
      transport.
    I don't think it's a good idea to use
      aerosols.


SHOULD — ENG MUHIM QOIDALAR:

  1  SHOULD dan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli:
        You should USE ...        ✓
        You should to use ...     ✗
        You should USES ...       ✗
        You should USING ...      ✗

  2  Barcha shaxslarda BIR XIL — -S QO'ShILMAYDI:
        I should      we should
        you should    you should
        he should     they should
        she should
        it should

        'He shouldS' — XATO!

  3  Inkor: SHOULD NOT = SHOULDN'T
        You shouldn't use aerosols.
        ('You don't should' — XATO!)

  4  Savol: SHOULD + ega + fe'l
        Should I use public transport?
        ('Do I should ...?' — XATO!)


UCh XIL MASLAHAT ShAKLI — QIYOSI:

  SHOULD           — oddiy, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri
     'You should drink more water.'

  WHY DON'T YOU ?  — do'stona TAKLIF
     'Why don't you drink more water?'
     DIQQAT: shakli SAVOL, ma'nosi MASLAHAT.

  I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO — yumshoq FIKR
     'I think it's a good idea to drink more
      water.'


DIQQAT — 'WHY DON'T YOU ...?':
  Bu — savol EMAS, MASLAHAT.
  So'zma-so'z: 'Nega ... qilmaysiz?'
  Ma'nosi: '... qilib ko'rsangiz-chi?'

  Tuzilishi:
     Why don't you + [ASOSIY fe'l] + ... ?
     Why don't you USE public transport?
     ('Why don't you TO use' — XATO)


DIQQAT — 'IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO + fe'l':
  'It's a good idea TO USE public transport.' ✓
  'It's a good idea USING ...'                ✗
  'It's a good idea USE ...'                  ✗

  INKORI — 'don't' BOSH gapga qo'yiladi:
     'I DON'T think it's a good idea to use
      aerosols.'                              ✓
     'I think it ISN'T a good idea ...'
      — grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri, lekin
        inglizlar birinchi shaklni ishlatadi.

  Bu — 'inkorni oldinga surish' hodisasi:
     I think he isn't right.  (kam ishlatiladi)
     I DON'T think he is right. (tabiiy)


MASLAHAT BERISHNING BARCHA ShAKLLARI
(ijobiy va salbiy juftlik):

  IJOBIY                     SALBIY
  ────────────────────────   ─────────────────────
  You SHOULD ...             You SHOULDN'T ...
  Why don't you ... ?        (juftligi yo'q)
  I think it's a good        I DON'T think it's a
    idea to ...                good idea to ...


BOG'LIQLIK — BUYRUQ BILAN FARQI:
  BUYRUQ:     'Use public transport.'
              — qat'iy, buyruq ohangi
  MASLAHAT:   'You should use public transport.'
              — yumshoq, tavsiya

  Varaqa (leaflet) BUYRUQ ishlatadi — chunki
  rasmiy e'lon.
  Do'stingizga esa MASLAHAT ishlatasiz.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  advice        = maslahat (SANALMAYDIGAN!)
                  'an advice' XATO
                  'a piece of advice' ✓
  to advise     = maslahat bermoq
  a good idea   = yaxshi fikr
  the right thing = to'g'ri ish

tasks.en: Giving Advice
tasks.uz: Maslahat berish

tasks.en: We use should to say what the right/best thing to do is.
tasks.uz: Nima qilish to'g'ri/eng yaxshi ekanini aytish uchun SHOULD ishlatamiz.
tasks.note: KITOBDAGI QOIDA.

tasks.en: You should use public transport. (= It's a good idea.)
tasks.uz: Jamoat transportidan foydalanishingiz kerak. (= Bu yaxshi fikr.)
tasks.note:
should + ASOSIY shakl.
Hech qanday shaxsda -S QO'SHILMAYDI.

tasks.en: We use shouldn't to say what isn't the right/best thing to do.
tasks.uz: Nima qilish to'g'ri/eng yaxshi EMASligini aytish uchun SHOULDN'T ishlatamiz.
tasks.note: shouldn't = should not.

tasks.en: You shouldn't use aerosols. (= It isn't a good idea.)
tasks.uz: Aerozollardan foydalanmasligingiz kerak. (= Bu yaxshi fikr emas.)
tasks.note: 'You DON'T should' — XATO.

tasks.en: We can also give advice with: Why don't you...? I think it's a good idea to ..., I don't think it's a good idea to ...
tasks.uz: Maslahatni shu yo'llar bilan ham berish mumkin: Why don't you...? I think it's a good idea to ..., I don't think it's a good idea to ...
tasks.note: Uchta qo'shimcha shakl.

tasks.en: Why don't you use public transport?
tasks.uz: Jamoat transportidan foydalansangiz-chi?
tasks.note:
Shakli SAVOL, ma'nosi MASLAHAT.
'Why don't you + ASOSIY fe'l?'

tasks.en: I think it's a good idea to use public transport.
tasks.uz: Menimcha, jamoat transportidan foydalanish yaxshi fikr.
tasks.note: 'a good idea TO + fe'l' (to-infinitive).

tasks.en: I don't think it's a good idea to use aerosols.
tasks.uz: Menimcha, aerozollardan foydalanish yaxshi fikr emas.
tasks.note:
INKOR bosh gapga qo'yiladi: 'I DON'T think'
(inglizcha odat).

exercises.instructionEn: Steve wants to keep fit and healthy. Look at the table, then listen to what his friend tells him. Tick the things he should do and put a cross next to the things he shouldn't do. Finally, use the expressions in the list to give advice to Steve.
exercises.instructionUz: Stiv sog'lom va tetik bo'lishni xohlaydi. Jadvalga qarang, so'ngra do'sti unga nima deyayotganini tinglang. U qilishi kerak bo'lgan ishlarga ✓, qilmasligi kerak bo'lganlariga ✗ qo'ying. So'ngra ro'yxatdagi iboralar bilan Stivga maslahat bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQSAD: 'keep fit and healthy'
(tetik va sog'lom bo'lish)

Demak har band SOG'LIQ nuqtai nazaridan
baholanadi — audio kerak emas.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  eat too many hamburgers or pizzas   ✗
  2  eat a lot of chocolate or ice-cream ✗
  3  eat a lot of fruit and vegetables   ✓
  4  drink fizzy drinks or beer          ✗
  5  drink a lot of water                ✓
  6  have cereal with milk for breakfast ✓
  7  take regular exercise               ✓
  8  walk to work                        ✓

  Ya'ni: ✗ ✗ ✓ ✗ ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓
  (3 ta salbiy, 5 ta ijobiy)


KITOBNING O'Z NAMUNASI 1-BANDNI TASDIQLAYDI:
  'I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO eat too
   many hamburgers or pizzas. OR
   YOU SHOULDN'T eat too many hamburgers or
   pizzas.'


HAR BIRI NEGA:

  1  ✗  Gamburger va pitsada ko'p yog' va tuz
        bor. 'TOO MANY' — haddan tashqari ko'p.
  2  ✗  Shokolad va muzqaymoqda ko'p shakar.
  3  ✓  Meva-sabzavot — vitamin manbai.
        98-betdagi 1-mashqning c-bandi ham shu:
        'Eat lots of fruit and vegetables.'
  4  ✗  Gazli ichimliklarda ko'p shakar;
        pivo — alkogol.
  5  ✓  Suv organizm uchun zarur.
  6  ✓  Sutli yormali nonushta — to'yimli va
        foydali boshlanish.
  7  ✓  Muntazam jismoniy mashq — sog'liqning
        asosi.
  8  ✓  Piyoda yurish — ham mashq, ham havoni
        ifloslantirmaydi.


HAR BAND UChUN TO'LIQ MASLAHAT
(ikki xil shaklda):

 1  You SHOULDN'T eat too many hamburgers or
    pizzas.
    I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO eat too
    many hamburgers or pizzas.

 2  You SHOULDN'T eat a lot of chocolate or
    ice-cream.
    I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO eat a lot
    of chocolate or ice-cream.

 3  You SHOULD eat a lot of fruit and vegetables.
    WHY DON'T YOU eat a lot of fruit and
    vegetables?

 4  You SHOULDN'T drink fizzy drinks or beer.
    I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO drink
    fizzy drinks or beer.

 5  You SHOULD drink a lot of water.
    WHY DON'T YOU drink a lot of water?

 6  You SHOULD have cereal with milk for
    breakfast.
    I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO have cereal with
    milk for breakfast.

 7  You SHOULD take regular exercise.
    WHY DON'T YOU take regular exercise?

 8  You SHOULD walk to work.
    I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO walk to work.


DIQQAT — 'WHY DON'T YOU' FAQAT IJOBIYDA:
  'Why don't you eat fruit?'          ✓
  'Why don't you NOT eat chocolate?'  ✗

  Salbiy maslahat uchun faqat:
     'You shouldn't ...' yoki
     'I don't think it's a good idea to ...'


DIQQAT — 'TOO MANY' va 'A LOT OF':
  1-bandda 'TOO many hamburgers'
     'too many' = HADDAN TASHQARI ko'p (salbiy)
  2-bandda 'A LOT OF chocolate'
     'a lot of' = ko'p (neytral)

  Ya'ni gamburgerni BIROZ yeyish mumkin,
  lekin 'too many' — chegaradan oshgan.


DIQQAT — 'TAKE EXERCISE':
  'TAKE regular exercise' — turg'un ibora.
  'DO exercise' ham to'g'ri.
  'MAKE exercise' — XATO.

  'exercise' bu ma'noda SANALMAYDIGAN:
     'take exercise'  ✓
     'an exercise' — mashq (kitobdagi vazifa)


DIQQAT — 'HAVE CEREAL':
  'to HAVE breakfast/lunch/dinner' = yemoq
  'cereal' — SANALMAYDIGAN (yormali nonushta)
  'a cereal' XATO.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to keep fit    = tetik bo'lib turmoq
  healthy        = sog'lom
  fizzy drinks   = gazli ichimliklar
  cereal         = yormali nonushta
  regular        = muntazam
  exercise       = jismoniy mashq
  to tick        = ✓ belgisini qo'ymoq
  a cross        = ✗ belgisi
  an expression  = ibora

tasks.prompt: 1  eat too many hamburgers or pizzas
tasks.promptUz: juda ko'p gamburger yoki pitsa yeyish
tasks.whyUz:
✗ — gamburger va pitsada ko'p YOG' va TUZ bor.
'TOO many' — haddan tashqari ko'p (salbiy).

KITOBNING O'Z NAMUNASI:
'I don't think it's a good idea to eat too many
hamburgers or pizzas. OR You shouldn't eat too
many hamburgers or pizzas.'

tasks.prompt: 2  eat a lot of chocolate or ice-cream
tasks.whyUz:
✗ — shokolad va muzqaymoqda ko'p SHAKAR.

MASLAHAT:
'You shouldn't eat a lot of chocolate or
ice-cream.'
'I don't think it's a good idea to eat a lot of
chocolate or ice-cream.'

tasks.prompt: 3  eat a lot of fruit and vegetables
tasks.whyUz:
✓ — meva-sabzavot VITAMIN manbai.
98-betdagi 1-mashqning c-bandi ham aynan shu edi:
'Eat lots of fruit and vegetables.' (health)

MASLAHAT:
'You should eat a lot of fruit and vegetables.'
'Why don't you eat a lot of fruit and vegetables?'

tasks.prompt: 4  drink fizzy drinks or beer
tasks.whyUz:
✗ — gazli ichimliklarda ko'p SHAKAR,
pivo esa ALKOGOL.

MASLAHAT:
'You shouldn't drink fizzy drinks or beer.'

'fizzy' = gazli (fizz = shovullash tovushi).

tasks.prompt: 5  drink a lot of water
tasks.whyUz:
✓ — suv organizm uchun ZARUR.

MASLAHAT:
'You should drink a lot of water.'
'Why don't you drink a lot of water?'

'water' — SANALMAYDIGAN.

tasks.prompt: 6  have cereal with milk for breakfast
tasks.whyUz:
✓ — to'yimli va foydali nonushta.

MASLAHAT:
'You should have cereal with milk for breakfast.'
'I think it's a good idea to have cereal with
milk for breakfast.'

'to HAVE breakfast' = nonushta qilmoq.
'cereal' — SANALMAYDIGAN.

tasks.prompt: 7  take regular exercise
tasks.whyUz:
✓ — muntazam mashq sog'liqning ASOSI.

MASLAHAT:
'You should take regular exercise.'
'Why don't you take regular exercise?'

'TAKE exercise' — turg'un ibora
('MAKE exercise' XATO).

tasks.prompt: 8  walk to work
tasks.whyUz:
✓ — ikki foyda: ham MASHQ, ham havoni
ifloslantirmaydi (98-betdagi ekologik mavzu
bilan bog'lanadi).

MASLAHAT:
'You should walk to work.'
'I think it's a good idea to walk to work.'

'walk TO work' — 'to' bor;
lekin 'walk HOME' — 'to' YO'Q.

exercises.instructionEn: can/can't, must/mustn't
exercises.instructionUz: can/can't, must/mustn't
exercises.explanationUz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI — TO'RT MODAL

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 1 'We use CAN to give permission.'
      You CAN listen to the radio.
      (= You are ALLOWED to.)
      → RUXSAT BERISH

 2 'We use CAN'T to refuse permission.'
      You CAN'T keep pets in your room.
      (= You AREN'T allowed to.)
      → RUXSAT BERMASLIK

 3 'We use MUST to tell someone to do
    something.' (expressing OBLIGATION)
      You MUST clean your room.
      (= You are OBLIGED to.)
      → MAJBURIYAT

 4 'We use MUSTN'T to tell someone not to do
    something.' (expressing PROHIBITION)
      You MUSTN'T smoke in hospitals.
      (= It's FORBIDDEN.)
      → TAQIQ


TO'RTTASINI BIR JADVALDA:

            RUXSAT        MAJBURIYAT
  IJOBIY    CAN           MUST
            (mumkin)      (shart)

  SALBIY    CAN'T         MUSTN'T
            (mumkin emas) (mutlaqo mumkin emas)


ENG MUHIM FARQ — 'CAN'T' va 'MUSTN'T':

  CAN'T   — ruxsat berilmagan
            'You can't keep pets.'
            (Uy egasi ruxsat bermayapti.)

  MUSTN'T — TAQIQLANGAN, qonun/qoida
            'You mustn't smoke in hospitals.'
            (Bu — qat'iy taqiq.)

  Amalda ikkalasi ko'pincha almashib
  ishlatiladi, lekin 'mustn't' KUChLIROQ.


ENG MUHIM FARQ — 'MUSTN'T' va 'DON'T HAVE TO':

  MUSTN'T       = mutlaqo QILMASLIK kerak
     'You mustn't be late.'
     (Kechikish TAQIQLANGAN.)

  DON'T HAVE TO = qilish ShART EMAS
                  (lekin xohlasangiz mumkin)
     'You don't have to be early.'
     (Erta kelish shart emas.)

  Bu — o'zbek tilida ikkalasi ham 'kerak emas'
  deb tarjima qilinadi, shuning uchun eng
  ko'p xato qilinadigan joy!


BARCHASIDAN KEYIN — ASOSIY ShAKL:
  You can LISTEN ...      ✓
  You can TO listen ...   ✗
  You must CLEAN ...      ✓
  You must TO clean ...   ✗
  He must CLEANS ...      ✗ (-S YO'Q!)


HECH QANDAY ShAXSDA -S QO'ShILMAYDI:
  I can / you can / he can / she can /
  it can / we can / they can
  I must / you must / he must / ...

  'He cans' ✗   'She musts' ✗


SAVOL ShAKLI — 'DO' KERAK EMAS:
  Can I use the telephone?   ✓
  Do I can use ...?          ✗
  Must I make the bed?       ✓
  Do I must ...?             ✗


QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Can I play music?
     — Yes, you CAN. / No, you CAN'T.
  Must I make the bed?
     — Yes, you MUST. / No, you NEEDN'T.
     (DIQQAT: 'No, you mustn't' — BOSHQA ma'no!
      'mustn't' = taqiq, 'needn't' = shart emas.)


'MUST' va 'HAVE TO' — 12-MAShQDAN:
  12-mashqning namunasi:
     SA: 'Do I HAVE TO make the bed?'
     SB: 'Yes, you do. You MUST make the bed.'

  Ya'ni SAVOLDA 'have to', JAVOBDA 'must'.
  Nega? Chunki 'must' savol shaklida kamroq
  ishlatiladi — 'Do I have to ...?' tabiiyroq.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  permission   = ruxsat
  to allow     = ruxsat bermoq
  allowed      = ruxsat etilgan
  to refuse    = rad etmoq
  obligation   = majburiyat
  obliged      = majbur
  prohibition  = taqiq
  forbidden    = taqiqlangan

tasks.en: can/can't, must/mustn't
tasks.uz: can/can't, must/mustn't

tasks.en: We use can to give permission. You can listen to the radio. (You are allowed to.)
tasks.uz: RUXSAT BERISH uchun CAN ishlatamiz. Radio eshitishingiz mumkin. (Sizga ruxsat etilgan.)
tasks.note: can + ASOSIY shakl ('to' YO'Q).

tasks.en: We use can't to refuse permission. You can't keep pets in your room. (You aren't allowed to.)
tasks.uz: RUXSAT BERMASLIK uchun CAN'T ishlatamiz. Xonangizda uy hayvonlarini saqlay olmaysiz. (Sizga ruxsat etilmagan.)
tasks.note:
11-mashqda kitob 'keep pets' ni CAN'T ustuniga
belgilagan — aynan shu misoldan.

tasks.en: We use must to tell someone to do something. (expressing obligation) You must clean your room. (You are obliged to.)
tasks.uz: Kimgadir biror ishni qilishni aytish uchun MUST ishlatamiz (MAJBURIYAT). Xonangizni tozalashingiz shart. (Siz majbursiz.)
tasks.note:
Bu misol 11-mashqning 'keep the room clean'
qatorini tasdiqlaydi → MUST.

tasks.en: We use mustn't to tell someone not to do something. (expressing prohibition) You mustn't smoke in hospitals. (It's forbidden.)
tasks.uz: Kimgadir biror ishni qilmaslikni aytish uchun MUSTN'T ishlatamiz (TAQIQ). Kasalxonalarda chekish mumkin emas. (Bu taqiqlangan.)
tasks.note:
DIQQAT: 'mustn't' (taqiq) va 'don't have to'
(shart emas) — BUTUNLAY boshqa ma'no!

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to Mrs Battersby talking to her new lodger and put a tick in the correct column. Then, make sentences using must, can't or can. — the rows confirmed by the book itself
exercises.instructionUz: Missis Battersbi yangi ijarachisi bilan gaplashayotganini tinglang va to'g'ri ustunga ✓ qo'ying. So'ngra must, can't yoki can bilan gap tuzing. — kitobning O'ZI tasdiqlagan qatorlar
exercises.explanationUz:
VAZIYAT:
  Mrs Battersby — uy egasi (landlady).
  'a lodger' = ijarachi (birovning uyida
  xona ijaraga oluvchi).
  U yangi ijarachiga UY QOIDALARINI aytyapti.


JADVALDA 10 QATOR, 3 USTUN:
  MUST  |  CAN'T  |  CAN


BU MASHQ AUDIOGA MO'LJALLANGAN, LEKIN
BETNING O'ZI 5 QATORNI TASDIQLAYDI:

 1  KEEP PETS → CAN'T
    Kitobda ✓ allaqachon qo'yilgan (NAMUNA).
    Grammatika qutisi ham aynan shu:
    'You CAN'T keep pets in your room.'
    Jadval ostidagi namuna gap ham:
    'You can't keep pets.'

 2  PLAY LOUD MUSIC → CAN'T
    12-mashqning namuna dialogi:
       SA: 'CAN I PLAY LOUD MUSIC?'
       SB: 'NO, YOU CAN'T.'

 3  USE THE TELEPHONE → CAN
    12-mashqning namuna dialogi:
       SA: 'CAN I USE THE TELEPHONE?'
       SB: 'YES, OF COURSE YOU CAN.'

 4  MAKE THE BED → MUST
    12-mashqning namuna dialogi:
       SA: 'DO I HAVE TO MAKE THE BED?'
       SB: 'Yes, you do. YOU MUST MAKE THE BED.'

 5  KEEP THE ROOM CLEAN → MUST
    Grammatika qutisining misoli:
    'You MUST CLEAN YOUR ROOM.'


QOLGAN 5 QATOR — FAQAT AUDIODAN:
  have parties in the room
  have a TV in the room
  put posters on the walls
  pay the rent on time
  be home by 11 pm

  Bular betning hech yerida yozilmagan.
  Taxmin bilan to'ldirilmadi — audio
  tinglanganda belgilanadi.
  (Ular quyidagi alohida ro'yxatda
   ko'rsatilgan.)


TASDIQLANGAN 5 QATOR UChUN TO'LIQ GAPLAR:

  You CAN'T keep pets.
  You CAN'T play loud music.
  You CAN use the telephone.
  You MUST make the bed.
  You MUST keep the room clean.


DIQQAT — JADVAL OSTIDAGI NAMUNA:
  Kitob jadval ostiga yozgan:
     'You can't keep pets.'
  Bu — birinchi qatorning to'liq gap shakli.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a lodger      = ijarachi (xona ijarasi)
  a landlady    = uy bekasi (ijaraga beruvchi)
  a landlord    = uy egasi (erkak)
  the rent      = ijara haqi
  on time       = o'z vaqtida
  a poster      = plakat
  loud          = baland (ovoz)
  to make the bed = to'shakni yig'ishtirmoq
  by 11 pm      = kechqurun 11 gacha

tasks.prompt: keep pets
tasks.whyUz:
KITOBDA ✓ ALLAQACHON QO'YILGAN (namuna).

Uch marta tasdiqlanadi:
  1) jadvalda ✓ CAN'T ustunida
  2) grammatika qutisi:
     'You CAN'T keep pets in your room.'
  3) jadval ostidagi namuna gap:
     'You can't keep pets.'

TO'LIQ GAP: You can't keep pets.

tasks.prompt: play loud music
tasks.whyUz:
12-MASHQNING NAMUNA DIALOGI TASDIQLAYDI:
  SA: 'Can I play loud music?'
  SB: 'NO, YOU CAN'T.'

Mantiq ham shuni ko'rsatadi: baland musiqa
boshqa ijarachilarga xalaqit beradi.

TO'LIQ GAP: You can't play loud music.

tasks.prompt: use the telephone
tasks.whyUz:
12-MASHQNING NAMUNA DIALOGI TASDIQLAYDI:
  SA: 'Can I use the telephone?'
  SB: 'YES, OF COURSE YOU CAN.'

'of course' — ruxsatni kuchaytiradi
(ya'ni bu oddiy, muammosiz narsa).

TO'LIQ GAP: You can use the telephone.

tasks.prompt: make the bed
tasks.whyUz:
12-MASHQNING NAMUNA DIALOGI TASDIQLAYDI:
  SA: 'Do I have to make the bed?'
  SB: 'Yes, you do. YOU MUST MAKE THE BED.'

DIQQAT: savolda 'have to', javobda 'must' —
ma'nosi bir xil, lekin savolda 'Do I have to'
tabiiyroq.

TO'LIQ GAP: You must make the bed.

tasks.prompt: keep the room clean
tasks.whyUz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISINING MISOLI TASDIQLAYDI:
  'You MUST CLEAN YOUR ROOM.'
  (= majburiyat, obligation)

Kitob 'must' ni tushuntirish uchun aynan shu
misolni tanlagan — bu tasodif emas.

'to KEEP + ot + SIFAT' = ... holatda saqlamoq:
  keep the room clean
  keep the door open

TO'LIQ GAP: You must keep the room clean.

tasks.prompt: be home by 11 pm
tasks.whyUz:
GRAMMAR BOOK 60-BET TASDIQLAYDI:
'must' ning ishlatilishi tushuntirilgan joyda
kitob aynan shu misolni bergan:
  'b) for RULES —
      You MUST BE HOME BY 11 PM.'

Ya'ni uy egasining qoidasi → MUST.

DIQQAT — 'BY' va 'UNTIL' FARQI:
  'be home BY 11 pm' = 11 GACHA yetib kelish
  'stay home UNTIL 11 pm' = 11 gacha uyda TURISH

TO'LIQ GAP: You must be home by 11 pm.

exercises.instructionUz: 11-mashq — faqat audiodan aniqlanadigan to'rt qator
exercises.explanationUz:
OChIQ QOLGAN 4 QATOR

Quyidagi to'rtta qator betning HECH YERIDA
yozilmagan. Ularni faqat Mrs Battersby ning
nutqini tinglab aniqlash mumkin.

TAXMIN BILAN TO'LDIRILMADI — audio
tinglanganda o'zingiz belgilaysiz.


  1  have parties in the room
     (xonada bazm o'tkazish)
     MUST  /  CAN'T  /  CAN   →  ........

  2  have a TV in the room
     (xonada televizor saqlash)
     MUST  /  CAN'T  /  CAN   →  ........

  3  put posters on the walls
     (devorlarga plakat osish)
     MUST  /  CAN'T  /  CAN   →  ........

  4  pay the rent on time
     (ijara haqini o'z vaqtida to'lash)
     MUST  /  CAN'T  /  CAN   →  ........


BELGILAGANDAN KEYIN GAP TUZISH:

  Agar MUST bo'lsa:
     You MUST pay the rent on time.
  Agar CAN'T bo'lsa:
     You CAN'T have parties in the room.
  Agar CAN bo'lsa:
     You CAN have a TV in the room.


HAR BIRINING LUG'ATI:

  to have a party    = bazm o'tkazmoq
  a TV               = televizor
  a poster           = plakat
  to put ... on the walls = devorlarga osmoq
  the rent           = ijara haqi
  to pay the rent    = ijara haqini to'lamoq
  on time            = o'z vaqtida
  to be home         = uyda bo'lmoq
  by 11 pm           = kechqurun 11 GACHA


DIQQAT — 'BY' va 'UNTIL' FARQI:
  'be home BY 11 pm'
     = 11 GACHA uyga yetib kelish
       (11 dan KEChIKMASDAN)

  'stay home UNTIL 11 pm'
     = 11 GACHA uyda TURISh
       (butun vaqt davomida)

  'by' — oxirgi muddat
  'until' — davomiylik


DIQQAT — 'ON TIME' va 'IN TIME':
  'pay the rent ON TIME'
     = o'z vaqtida, belgilangan kunda
  'arrive IN TIME'
     = ulgurib, kech qolmasdan


DIQQAT — 'BE HOME' — PREDLOG YO'Q:
  'be HOME'      ✓
  'be AT home'   ✓ (ikkalasi ham to'g'ri)
  'go HOME'      ✓
  'go TO home'   ✗ (XATO!)

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture. Each student is doing something wrong. Use the prompts in the list to tell the students what they must or mustn't do while in class.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmga qarang. Har bir o'quvchi noto'g'ri ish qilyapti. Ro'yxatdagi ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib, o'quvchilarga darsda nima qilishlari yoki qilmasliklari kerakligini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'RSATMALAR RO'YXATI (10 ta):
  eat in class, chew gum in class,
  write on the walls, keep the classroom clean,
  be quiet in class, cheat in tests,
  sleep in class, talk to each other in class,
  bring pets into school, fight in class


RASMDA 9 TA RAQAMLANGAN O'QUVCHI:

  1  Yashil koftali qiz, og'zidan PUFAK
     chiqib turibdi          → saqich chaynayapti
  2  Sariq sochli bola devorga 'I ♥ KATE' deb
     YOZYAPTI                → devorga yozyapti
  3  Sariq sochli qiz (to'q sariq kofta,
     ayiqcha rasmi), qo'lida qalam, boshini
     yon tomonga burib qarayapti
                             → nusxa ko'chiryapti
  4  Sariq sochli bola boshini partaga qo'yib
     UXLAYAPTI               → uxlayapti
  5  Binafsha koftali bola qo'lida non/pishiriq,
     og'zi ochiq             → OVQAT YEYAPTI
  6  Yashil va jigarrang koftali ikki bola
     bo'yinlashib OLIShYAPTI → urishyapti
  7  Sariq koftali bola tirjayib, g'ijimlangan
     qog'ozlarni OTYAPTI     → sinfni ifloslantiryapti
  8  Qizil koftali qiz partadagi qutidagi
     MUShUKChAGA qo'l cho'zgan
                             → maktabga hayvon olib kelgan
  9  Ikki qiz boshlarini qo'shib PIChIRLAShYAPTI
                             → gaplashyaptilar


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  You MUSTN'T chew gum in class.
  2  You MUSTN'T write on the walls.
  3  You MUSTN'T cheat in tests.
  4  You MUSTN'T sleep in class.
  5  You MUSTN'T eat in class.
  6  You MUSTN'T fight in class.
  7  You MUST keep the classroom clean.
  8  You MUSTN'T bring pets into school.
  9  You MUSTN'T talk to each other in class.

  (be quiet in class → You MUST be quiet in
   class. — alohida o'quvchisi yo'q)


⚠ KITOBNING O'Z XATOSI:

  Kitob namuna sifatida yozgan:
     '1-You mustn't EAT in class.'

  LEKIN rasmda 1-o'quvchi SAQICH CHAYNAYAPTI —
  og'zidan pufak chiqib turibdi.
  OVQAT yeyayotgani esa 5-o'quvchi (binafsha
  koftali bola, qo'lida pishiriq).

  Rasm 5 barobar kattalashtirilib tekshirildi.

  Ehtimol kitob '1-' deganda RO'YXATNING
  birinchi so'zini ('eat in class') nazarda
  tutgan, RASMDAGI 1-o'quvchini emas.

  Ikkala variant ham quyida ko'rsatildi.


DIQQAT — IKKI TA IJOBIY KO'RSATMA:

  Ro'yxatdagi 10 tadan 8 tasi SALBIY
  (mustn't), lekin IKKITASI IJOBIY (must):

     keep the classroom clean
        → You MUST keep the classroom clean.
     be quiet in class
        → You MUST be quiet in class.

  Mashq nomi ham shuni aytadi:
  'what they MUST OR MUSTN'T do'.

  Agar ularni ham 'mustn't' bilan yozsangiz,
  ma'no TESKARI bo'lib qoladi:
     'You mustn't keep the classroom clean' ✗
     (= sinfni toza tutish taqiqlangan!)


DIQQAT — 9 O'QUVCHI, 10 KO'RSATMA:
  'be quiet in class' ga alohida o'quvchi
  to'g'ri kelmaydi — bu butun sinfga tegishli
  umumiy qoida.
  (6-urishuv va 9-gaplashuv ham shovqin
   qiladi, lekin ular boshqa ko'rsatmalarni
   olgan.)
  Taxmin bilan bog'lanmadi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to chew gum   = saqich chaynamoq
  chewing gum   = saqich
  to cheat      = aldamoq, nusxa ko'chirmoq
  a test        = nazorat ishi
  to fight      = urishmoq (fight → FOUGHT)
  quiet         = jim, tinch
  a classroom   = sinfxona
  to bring into = ichkariga olib kirmoq
  each other    = bir-biri
  while in class = darsda, dars davomida

You mustn't write on the walls.

exercises.instructionEn: Make three rules for your school. Use must or mustn't.
exercises.instructionUz: Maktabingiz uchun uchta qoida tuzing. must yoki mustn't dan foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'You MUST do your homework.'


QOLIP:
  You MUST + [ASOSIY fe'l] + ...    (majburiyat)
  You MUSTN'T + [ASOSIY fe'l] + ... (taqiq)


NAMUNA QOIDALAR (maktab uchun):

  MUST bilan (nima QILISh kerak):
     You must do your homework.  (NAMUNA)
     You must come to school on time.
     You must wear your school uniform.
     You must listen to the teacher.
     You must put up your hand before you speak.
     You must keep the classroom clean.
     You must be quiet in class.

  MUSTN'T bilan (nima QILMASLIK kerak):
     You mustn't be late for class.
     You mustn't use your mobile phone in class.
     You mustn't run in the corridors.
     You mustn't cheat in tests.
     You mustn't fight with other students.
     You mustn't drop rubbish in the playground.


UChTA QOIDA — NAMUNA JAVOB:
  1  You must do your homework every day.
  2  You must be quiet in class.
  3  You mustn't use your mobile phone in class.


DIQQAT — 'MUST' DAN KEYIN 'TO' YO'Q:
  'You must DO your homework.'    ✓
  'You must TO DO your homework.' ✗


DIQQAT — 'MUSTN'T' va 'DON'T HAVE TO':
  'You MUSTN'T be late.'
     = kechikish TAQIQLANGAN
  'You DON'T HAVE TO be early.'
     = erta kelish SHART EMAS (lekin mumkin)

  Maktab qoidalarida deyarli doim 'mustn't'
  ishlatiladi, chunki qoida — taqiq.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a rule        = qoida
  homework      = uy vazifasi (SANALMAYDIGAN!)
                  'homeworks' XATO
  a uniform     = maktab formasi
  a corridor    = koridor
  a playground  = maktab hovlisi
  to put up your hand = qo'l ko'tarmoq

tasks.en: Make three rules for your school. Use must or mustn't.
tasks.uz: Maktabingiz uchun uchta qoida tuzing. must yoki mustn't dan foydalaning.

tasks.en: You must do your homework.
tasks.uz: Uy vazifangizni bajarishingiz kerak.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
'homework' — SANALMAYDIGAN ('homeworks' XATO).

tasks.en: You must come to school on time and listen to the teacher.
tasks.uz: Maktabga o'z vaqtida kelishingiz va o'qituvchini tinglashingiz kerak.
tasks.note: 'ON time' = o'z vaqtida (101-betdan).

tasks.en: You must be quiet in class and keep the classroom clean.
tasks.uz: Darsda jim bo'lishingiz va sinfxonani toza tutishingiz kerak.
tasks.note: 13a-mashqning ikkita IJOBIY ko'rsatmasi.

tasks.en: You mustn't be late for class or use your mobile phone in class.
tasks.uz: Darsga kechikmasligingiz yoki darsda mobil telefondan foydalanmasligingiz kerak.
tasks.note: 'late FOR' — predlog 'for'.

tasks.en: You mustn't run in the corridors or fight with other students.
tasks.uz: Koridorlarda yugurmasligingiz yoki boshqa o'quvchilar bilan urishmasligingiz kerak.
tasks.note: 'fight WITH somebody' = kimdir bilan urishmoq.

tasks.en: You mustn't cheat in tests.
tasks.uz: Nazorat ishlarida nusxa ko'chirmasligingiz kerak.
tasks.note: 13a-mashqning 3-o'quvchisi.

exercises.instructionEn: Giving Advice
exercises.instructionUz: Maslahat berish
exercises.explanationUz:
SHOULD / SHOULDN'T — NAZARIYA

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use SHOULD to say what the right/best
    thing to do is.'
      You SHOULD take regular exercise.
      (= It's a good idea.)

 • 'We use SHOULDN'T to say what isn't the
    right/best thing to do.'
      You SHOULDN'T drop rubbish in the street.
      (= It isn't a good idea.)

 • 'We can also give advice with:
    WHY DON'T YOU ...?
    I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO ...,
    I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO ...'

      Why don't you take regular exercise?
      I think it's a good idea to take regular
        exercise.
      I don't think it's a good idea to eat
        junk food.


TO'LIQ TUSLANISh:

  TASDIQ:
     I should go        we should go
     you should go      you should go
     he should go       they should go
     she should go
     it should go

  INKOR:
     I should not go = I shouldn't go
     (barcha shaxslarda bir xil)

  SO'ROQ:
     Should I go?
     Should he go?
     ...


UCh OLTIN QOIDA:

 1  -S HECH QAChON QO'ShILMAYDI:
       'He should go.'    ✓
       'He shouldS go.'   ✗

 2  'TO' YO'Q:
       'You should take ...'    ✓
       'You should TO take ...' ✗

 3  'DO' KERAK EMAS:
       'Should I go?'      ✓
       'DO I should go?'   ✗
       'I shouldn't go.'   ✓
       'I DON'T should go.' ✗


QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Should I take an aspirin?
     — Yes, you should. / No, you shouldn't.


UCh XIL MASLAHAT ShAKLI — QIYOSI:

  SHOULD
     'You should take regular exercise.'
     → to'g'ridan-to'g'ri, oddiy

  WHY DON'T YOU ...?
     'Why don't you take regular exercise?'
     → shakli SAVOL, ma'nosi MASLAHAT
     → do'stona taklif

  I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO ...
     'I think it's a good idea to take regular
      exercise.'
     → yumshoq shaxsiy fikr

  I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO ...
     'I don't think it's a good idea to eat
      junk food.'
     → yumshoq salbiy fikr


DIQQAT — INKOR QAYERGA QO'YILADI:
  'I DON'T think it's a good idea to ...' ✓
     (inkor BOSH gapda)
  'I think it ISN'T a good idea to ...'
     (grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri, lekin
      inglizlar birinchi shaklni ishlatadi)


DIQQAT — 'A GOOD IDEA TO + fe'l':
  'a good idea TO TAKE exercise'   ✓
  'a good idea TAKING exercise'    ✗
  'a good idea TAKE exercise'      ✗


DIQQAT — 'WHY DON'T YOU + ASOSIY fe'l':
  'Why don't you TAKE exercise?'    ✓
  'Why don't you TO take exercise?' ✗
  'Why don't you TAKING exercise?'  ✗


MISOLLARDAGI YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  regular exercise = muntazam jismoniy mashq
  to drop rubbish  = axlat tashlamoq
  junk food        = zararli tez ovqat
                     (gamburger, chips va h.k.)


BOG'LIQLIK — COURSEBOOK BILAN:
  Bu qoida Coursebook 99-betdagi
  'Giving Advice' qutisi bilan AYNAN bir xil,
  faqat misollari boshqa.

tasks.en: Giving Advice
tasks.uz: Maslahat berish

tasks.en: We use should to say what the right/best thing to do is. You should take regular exercise. (= It's a good idea.)
tasks.uz: Nima qilish to'g'ri/eng yaxshi ekanini aytish uchun SHOULD ishlatamiz. Muntazam jismoniy mashq qilishingiz kerak. (= Bu yaxshi fikr.)
tasks.note:
should + ASOSIY shakl.
Hech qanday shaxsda -S QO'SHILMAYDI.

tasks.en: We use shouldn't to say what isn't the right/best thing to do. You shouldn't drop rubbish in the street. (= It isn't a good idea.)
tasks.uz: Nima qilish to'g'ri emasligini aytish uchun SHOULDN'T ishlatamiz. Ko'chaga axlat tashlamasligingiz kerak. (= Bu yaxshi fikr emas.)
tasks.note:
shouldn't = should not.
'You DON'T should' — XATO.

tasks.en: We can also give advice with: Why don't you ...? I think it's a good idea to ..., I don't think it's a good idea to ...
tasks.uz: Maslahatni shu yo'llar bilan ham berish mumkin: Why don't you ...? I think it's a good idea to ..., I don't think it's a good idea to ...
tasks.note: Uchta qo'shimcha shakl.

tasks.en: Why don't you take regular exercise?
tasks.uz: Muntazam jismoniy mashq qilsangiz-chi?
tasks.note:
Shakli SAVOL, ma'nosi MASLAHAT.
'Why don't you + ASOSIY fe'l?'

tasks.en: I think it's a good idea to take regular exercise.
tasks.uz: Menimcha, muntazam jismoniy mashq qilish yaxshi fikr.
tasks.note: 'a good idea TO + fe'l' (to-infinitive).

tasks.en: I don't think it's a good idea to eat junk food.
tasks.uz: Menimcha, zararli tez ovqat yeyish yaxshi fikr emas.
tasks.note:
INKOR BOSH gapga qo'yiladi: 'I DON'T think'.
'junk food' = zararli tez ovqat.

tasks.en: I / you / he / she / it / we / they SHOULD go. — Should I go? — I shouldn't go.
tasks.uz: Men / siz / u / biz / ular BORISHI kerak. — Borishim kerakmi? — Borishim kerak emas.
tasks.note:
TO'LIQ TUSLANISH.
Barcha shaxslarda 'should' O'ZGARMAYDI.
Savolda 'do' KERAK EMAS.

exercises.instructionEn: Must / Mustn't — Affirmative, Interrogative, Negative
exercises.instructionUz: Must / Mustn't — tasdiq, so'roq, inkor
exercises.explanationUz:
MUST — TO'LIQ TUSLANISh

TASDIQ (Affirmative):
     I must stay          we must stay
     you must stay        you must stay
     he must stay         they must stay
     she must stay
     it must stay

SO'ROQ (Interrogative):
     Must I stay?         Must we stay?
     Must you stay?       Must you stay?
     Must he stay?        Must they stay?
     Must she stay?
     Must it stay?

INKOR (Negative):
     TO'LIQ ShAKL         QISQA ShAKL
     I must not stay      I mustn't stay
     you must not stay    you mustn't stay
     he must not stay     he mustn't stay
     she must not stay    she mustn't stay
     it must not stay     it mustn't stay
     we must not stay     we mustn't stay
     you must not stay    you mustn't stay
     they must not stay   they mustn't stay


ENG MUHIM XUSUSIYAT:
  'MUST' BARCHA ShAXSLARDA BIR XIL —
  hech qanday o'zgarish yo'q!

     'He must stay.'   ✓
     'He mustS stay.'  ✗
     'He must stayS.'  ✗


SO'ROQ — 'DO' KERAK EMAS:
     'Must I stay?'     ✓
     'Do I must stay?'  ✗

  MUST ni EGADAN OLDINGA qo'yish yetarli.


INKOR — 'DON'T' KERAK EMAS:
     'I must not stay.' ✓
     'I don't must stay.' ✗

  'NOT' ni MUST dan KEYIN qo'yish yetarli.


'MUSTN'T' TALAFFUZI:
  /ˈmʌsnt/ — 'masnt'
  DIQQAT: birinchi 'T' O'QILMAYDI!
  ('must not' da esa o'qiladi.)


MUST NIMA UChUN IShLATILADI — UCh HOLAT:

 KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

  a)  TO EXPRESS OBLIGATION (majburiyat)
         'You MUST KEEP the room clean.'

  b)  FOR RULES (qoidalar uchun)
         'You MUST BE home by 11 pm.'

  c)  TO GIVE ADVICE (maslahat berish)
         'You MUST SEE a dentist.'
         (I STRONGLY advise you.)


DIQQAT — c) HOLATI ENG NOZIK:
  'MUST' maslahat uchun ham ishlatiladi,
  lekin 'should' dan ANChA KUCHLIROQ:

     'You SHOULD see a dentist.'
        → oddiy maslahat
     'You MUST see a dentist.'
        → QAT'IY maslahat
          ('I strongly advise you')

  Kitob buni qavs ichida aytadi:
  '(I STRONGLY advise you.)'


MUSTN'T NIMANI ANGLATADI:

 KITOBDAGI QOIDA:
  'MUSTN'T means "IT IS FORBIDDEN" or
   "IT ISN'T RIGHT".'

     'You MUSTN'T PARK here.'
     (= It is FORBIDDEN to park here,
        it is AGAINST THE RULE.)


DIQQAT — 'MUSTN'T' va 'DON'T HAVE TO':
  Bu — eng ko'p xato qilinadigan joy!

     MUSTN'T       = mutlaqo QILMASLIK kerak
                     (TAQIQ)
        'You mustn't park here.'
        (Bu yerga qo'yish TAQIQLANGAN.)

     DON'T HAVE TO = qilish ShART EMAS
                     (lekin mumkin)
        'You don't have to park here.'
        (Bu yerga qo'yish shart emas —
         boshqa joyga ham qo'yishingiz mumkin.)

  O'zbek tilida ikkalasi ham 'kerak emas'
  deb tarjima qilinadi — shuning uchun
  adashish oson.


QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Must I stay?
     — Yes, you must.
     — No, you NEEDN'T. (shart emas)

  DIQQAT: 'No, you mustn't' — BOSHQA ma'no!
     'No, you needn't.'  = qolish shart emas
     'No, you mustn't.'  = qolish TAQIQLANGAN


MISOLLARDAGI YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to stay          = qolmoq
  obligation       = majburiyat
  a rule           = qoida
  forbidden        = taqiqlangan
  against the rule = qoidaga zid
  strongly         = qat'iy, kuchli
  to advise        = maslahat bermoq


⚠ MUHIM BOG'LIQLIK — COURSEBOOK 101-BET:
  Bu betdagi ikki misol Coursebook 101-betning
  11-mashqidagi jadval qatorlarini TASDIQLAYDI:

     'You must KEEP THE ROOM CLEAN.'
        → 'keep the room clean' = MUST ✓

     'You must BE HOME BY 11 PM.'
        → 'be home by 11 pm' = MUST ✓

  Ikkinchisi 101-betda audio uchun ochiq
  qolgan edi — endi kitobning O'ZIDAN
  tasdiqlandi.

tasks.note:
'must' BARCHA shaxslarda O'ZGARMAYDI.

tasks.note:
'not' ni MUST dan KEYIN qo'yish yetarli.
'mustn't' talaffuzi /ˈmʌsnt/ — birinchi 'T' JIM.

(SHART EMAS)!

exercises.instructionEn: Can/Can't - Could/Couldn't — Form and Use
exercises.instructionUz: Can/Can't - Could/Couldn't — yasalishi va ishlatilishi
exercises.explanationUz:
COULD — TO'LIQ TUSLANISh

TASDIQ (Affirmative):
     I could swim         we could swim
     you could swim       you could swim
     he could swim        they could swim
     she could swim
     it could swim

SO'ROQ (Interrogative):
     Could I swim?        Could we swim?
     Could you swim?      Could you swim?
     Could he swim?       Could they swim?
     Could she swim?
     Could it swim?

INKOR (Negative):
     TO'LIQ ShAKL         QISQA ShAKL
     I could not swim     I couldn't swim
     you could not swim   you couldn't swim
     he could not swim    he couldn't swim
     she could not swim   she couldn't swim
     it could not swim    it couldn't swim
     we could not swim    we couldn't swim
     you could not swim   you couldn't swim
     they could not swim  they couldn't swim


YASALIShI (FORM) — KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We form the INTERROGATIVE by putting CAN or
    COULD BEFORE THE SUBJECT.'
       CAN THEY swim?  /  COULD THEY swim?

 • 'We form the NEGATIVE by putting the word NOT
    AFTER can or could.'
       They CANNOT / CAN'T swim well.
       They COULD NOT / COULDN'T swim well.


DIQQAT — 'CANNOT' BIR SO'Z:
  'CANNOT'   ✓  (qo'shib yoziladi!)
  'can not'  — kam ishlatiladi
  'CAN'T'    ✓  (qisqa shakl)

  Bu — inglizchadagi yagona modal fe'l
  bo'lib, inkori QO'ShIB yoziladi:
     could not  → couldn't (ayrim)
     must not   → mustn't  (ayrim)
     cannot                 (QO'ShIQ!)


IShLATILIShI (USE) — KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use CAN to show that someone has the
    ABILITY to do something IN THE PRESENT.
    We use COULD to show that someone HAD the
    ability to do something IN THE PAST.'

       HOZIR:  I CAN swim.
               (Men suza olaman.)
       O'TGAN:  I COULD swim when I was five.
               (Besh yoshimda suza olardim.)

 • 'We also use CAN to give PERMISSION.'
       You CAN watch TV.
       (You are allowed to.)

 • 'We use CAN'T to REFUSE permission.'
       You CAN'T watch TV.
       (You aren't allowed to.)


CAN NING IKKI MA'NOSI:

  1  QOBILIYAT (ability)
        'I can swim.' = suza olaman
        'I can speak English.'

  2  RUXSAT (permission)
        'You can watch TV.' = ruxsat berilgan
        'Can I use your phone?'

  Qaysi ma'no ekanini KONTEKST ko'rsatadi.


COULD — 'CAN' NING O'TGAN ZAMONI:

     HOZIR              O'TGAN
     I can swim.        I could swim.
     I can't swim.      I couldn't swim.
     Can you swim?      Could you swim?

  Misol:
     'I COULD run very fast when I was young,
      but now I CAN'T.'
     (Yosh vaqtimda juda tez yugurardim,
      lekin hozir yugura olmayman.)


DIQQAT — 'COULD' NING IKKINChI VAZIFASI:
  'Could' o'tgan zamondan tashqari,
  ODOBLI ILTIMOS uchun ham ishlatiladi:

     'CAN you help me?'    — oddiy
     'COULD you help me?'  — ODOBLIROQ

  Bu holatda o'tgan zamon ma'nosi YO'Q.


BARCHA MODALLARGA UMUMIY UCh QOIDA:

 1  -S QO'ShILMAYDI:
       he can, he could, he must, he should
       ('he cans' ✗)

 2  'TO' YO'Q:
       'I can swim.'    ✓
       'I can TO swim.' ✗

 3  'DO' KERAK EMAS:
       'Can you swim?'     ✓
       'Do you can swim?'  ✗


QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Can you swim?
     — Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
  Could you swim when you were five?
     — Yes, I could. / No, I couldn't.


MISOLLARDAGI YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  ability       = qobiliyat
  able          = qodir
  the present   = hozirgi zamon
  the past      = o'tgan zamon
  to allow      = ruxsat bermoq
  allowed       = ruxsat etilgan
  to refuse     = rad etmoq
  the subject   = ega (grammatikada)
  affirmative   = tasdiq
  interrogative = so'roq
  negative      = inkor

tasks.en: Can/Can't - Could/Couldn't — Form and Use
tasks.uz: Can/Can't - Could/Couldn't — yasalishi va ishlatilishi

tasks.en: AFFIRMATIVE: I could swim / you could swim / he could swim / she could swim / it could swim / we could swim / they could swim
tasks.uz: TASDIQ: men suza olardim / siz suza olardingiz / u suza olardi / ... / ular suza olardilar
tasks.note: 'could' BARCHA shaxslarda O'ZGARMAYDI.

tasks.en: INTERROGATIVE: Could I swim? Could you swim? Could he swim? Could she swim? Could it swim? Could we swim? Could they swim?
tasks.uz: SO'ROQ: Suza olarmidim? Suza olarmidingiz? U suza olarmidi? ...
tasks.note: 'could' ni EGADAN OLDINGA qo'yish yetarli.

tasks.en: NEGATIVE (long): I could not swim ... (short): I couldn't swim ...
tasks.uz: INKOR (to'liq): men suza olmasdim ... (qisqa): I couldn't swim ...
tasks.note: 'not' ni COULD dan KEYIN qo'yish yetarli.

tasks.en: We form the interrogative by putting can or could before the subject. Can they swim? / Could they swim?
tasks.uz: So'roq shaklini can yoki could ni egadan oldin qo'yib yasaymiz. Ular suza oladimi? / Ular suza olarmidi?
tasks.note:
'the subject' = EGA.
'Do they can swim?' — XATO.

tasks.en: We form the negative by putting the word not after can or could. They cannot/can't swim well. / They could not/couldn't swim well.
tasks.uz: Inkor shaklini can yoki could dan keyin not qo'yib yasaymiz. Ular yaxshi suza olmaydi. / Ular yaxshi suza olmasdi.
tasks.note:
DIQQAT: 'CANNOT' — BIR SO'Z, qo'shib yoziladi!
'could not' esa ajratib yoziladi.

tasks.en: We use can to show that someone has the ability to do something in the present. We use could to show that someone had the ability to do something in the past.
tasks.uz: Kimningdir HOZIR biror ishni qila olish qobiliyati borligini ko'rsatish uchun CAN ishlatamiz. O'TMISHDA qobiliyati bo'lganini ko'rsatish uchun COULD ishlatamiz.
tasks.note:
CAN = hozir; COULD = o'tmishda.
'I could swim when I was five.'

tasks.en: We also use can to give permission. You can watch TV. (You are allowed to.)
tasks.uz: CAN ni ruxsat berish uchun ham ishlatamiz. Televizor ko'rishingiz mumkin. (Sizga ruxsat etilgan.)
tasks.note:
CAN ning IKKINCHI ma'nosi: RUXSAT.
Coursebook 101-bet bilan bir xil.

tasks.en: We use can't to refuse permission. You can't watch TV. (You aren't allowed to.)
tasks.uz: CAN'T ni ruxsat bermaslik uchun ishlatamiz. Televizor ko'ra olmaysiz. (Sizga ruxsat etilmagan.)
tasks.note: Coursebook 102-bet, 16d-dialog bilan bir xil.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the pictures to their meanings.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarni ularning ma'nolariga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI YO'L BELGISI (A-F):

  A  Qizil doira ichida CHIZIB TAShLANGAN
     PIYODA figurasi
  B  Qizil doira ichida chizib tashlangan
     O'NGGA BURILISh strelkasi
  C  Qizil doira, o'rtasida OQ GORIZONTAL
     chiziq (klassik 'KIRISh TAQIQLANGAN'
     belgisi)
  D  Qizil doira ichida chizib tashlangan
     VELOSIPEDChI
  E  Qizil doira ichida chizib tashlangan
     QO'L (biror narsaga tegayotgan)
  F  Qizil doira ichida chizib tashlangan
     odam AXLAT tashlayapti


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  Don't throw rubbish.   →  F
  2  Don't walk.            →  A
  3  Don't ride your bike.  →  D
  4  Don't turn right.      →  B
  5  Don't enter.           →  C
  6  Don't touch.           →  E


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — HAR RASMDAGI ASOSIY
FIGURA:

  PIYODA        →  walk      (yurmoq)
  STRELKA       →  turn      (burilmoq)
  OQ CHIZIQ     →  enter     (kirmoq)
  VELOSIPED     →  ride      (minmoq)
  QO'L          →  touch     (tegmoq)
  AXLAT         →  throw     (tashlamoq)


DIQQAT — 'C' BELGISI:
  Qizil doira + oq gorizontal chiziq —
  butun dunyoda 'NO ENTRY' (kirish taqiqlangan)
  degani. Ichida hech qanday rasm yo'q,
  faqat chiziq.

  Bu belgi bir tomonlama ko'chalarda va
  taqiqlangan kirish joylarida turadi.


DIQQAT — YO'L BELGILARINING TILI:
  Belgilar odatda BUYRUQ MAYLIDA yoziladi:
     'Don't enter.'  /  'No entry.'
     'Don't walk.'   /  'No pedestrians.'

  Ikki xil shakl:
     DON'T + fe'l    (buyruq)
     NO + ot         (qisqa e'lon)

  Misollar:
     No smoking.     = Chekish taqiqlanadi.
     No parking.     = Mashina qo'yish taqiqlanadi.
     No entry.       = Kirish taqiqlanadi.
     No swimming.    = Suzish taqiqlanadi.

  DIQQAT: 'NO + -ING' shakli!
     'No smoking'  ✓
     'No smoke'    ✗


BELGILARNI MODAL BILAN AYTISh:
  Har bir belgini 'mustn't' bilan ham aytish
  mumkin (Coursebook 101-betdagi qoida):

     F  →  You mustn't throw rubbish here.
     A  →  You mustn't walk here.
     D  →  You mustn't ride your bike here.
     B  →  You mustn't turn right.
     C  →  You mustn't enter.
     E  →  You mustn't touch.

  'mustn't' — chunki bular QONUNIY taqiq
  (Grammar 60-bet: 'it is against the rule').


DIQQAT — 'TO ENTER' PREDLOGSIZ:
  'enter the room'      ✓
  'enter INTO the room' ✗

  'enter' o'timli fe'l — to'ldiruvchi
  to'g'ridan-to'g'ri keladi.


DIQQAT — 'TO RIDE':
  ride a bike / a horse / a motorbike
  ride → RODE → RIDDEN (noto'g'ri fe'l)

  Mashina uchun 'ride' emas, 'DRIVE':
     drive a car  ✓
     ride a car   ✗


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to throw rubbish = axlat tashlamoq
  to walk          = yurmoq, piyoda yurmoq
  to ride a bike   = velosiped minmoq

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  SHOULD      (meva-sabzavot — foydali)
   2  SHOULD      (ko'zoynak — himoya qiladi)
   3  SHOULDN'T   (og'zi to'la gapirish — qo'pol)
   4  SHOULD      (imtihon oldidan o'qish — foydali)
   5  SHOULDN'T   (zararli ovqat — zarar)
   6  SHOULDN'T   (o'rmonda olov — xavfli)
   7  SHOULD      (uy vazifasi — foydali)
   8  SHOULDN'T   (aerozol — ozonga zarar)
   9  SHOULD      (kasal — shifokorga borish)
  10  SHOULDN'T   (ko'p shirinlik — zarar)

  Ya'ni: SHOULD — 1, 2, 4, 7, 9 (5 ta)
         SHOULDN'T — 3, 5, 6, 8, 10 (5 ta)


OLTIN QOIDA — QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  Ish FOYDALI bo'lsa       →  SHOULD
  Ish ZARARLI/QO'POL bo'lsa →  SHOULDN'T

  Boshqa hech qanday grammatik belgi yo'q —
  faqat MA'NO.


HAR BIRINING KELIB ChIQIShI (Coursebook'dan):

   1  'Eat lots of fruit and vegetables.'
      — CB 98-bet, 1-mashq (health)
   2  'Always wear sunglasses.'
      — CB 103-bet, 17-mashq
   3  'Don't talk with your mouth full.'
      — CB 100-bet (Angliya)
   5  'junk food' — GB 60-bet misoli
   6  'Never light fires in forests.'
      — CB 99-bet, varaqa
   7  'You must do your homework.'
      — CB 102-bet, 13b namunasi
   8  'Do not use aerosols.'
      — CB 99-bet, varaqa
   9  'See the dentist / call the doctor'
      — CB 101-bet, 9b

  Ya'ni butun mashq unitni takrorlaydi.


DIQQAT — 5-BAND, EGA 'PETER':
  'PETER shouldn't eat so much junk food.'

  Ega III shaxs birlik bo'lsa ham,
  'should' O'ZGARMAYDI:
     'Peter shouldn't' ✓
     'Peter shouldnS't' ✗
     'Peter doesn't should' ✗


DIQQAT — 'SO MUCH' va 'SO MANY':
   5  'so MUCH junk food'  — SANALMAYDIGAN
  10  'so MANY sweets'     — SANALADIGAN

  much + sanalmaydigan (food, water, money)
  many + sanaladigan    (sweets, books, cars)

  'so' — kuchaytiruvchi ('shunchalik ko'p').


DIQQAT — 7-BANDDA 'ALWAYS' QAYERDA:
  'You SHOULD ALWAYS do your homework.'

  Ravish MODAL bilan ASOSIY FE'L ORASIGA
  qo'yiladi:
     should ALWAYS do   ✓
     ALWAYS should do   ✗
     should do ALWAYS   (noto'g'ri emas, lekin
                         g'alati)


DIQQAT — 9-BAND, 'GO TO A DOCTOR':
  'He should go to A doctor.'
  Artikl 'A' — qaysi shifokor ekani muhim emas.
  'go to THE doctor' — o'z shifokoringiz.

  'isn't feeling well' — Present Continuous,
  chunki VAQTINChA holat.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  junk food       = zararli tez ovqat
  sweets          = shirinliklar
  a test          = nazorat ishi
  to feel well    = o'zini yaxshi his qilmoq
  aerosols        = aerozollar

exercises.instructionEn: Make sentences using should or shouldn't, as in the example. — HOW TO TAKE CARE OF YOUR CAT
exercises.instructionUz: Namunadagidek should yoki shouldn't bilan gap tuzing. — MUSHUKNI QANDAY PARVARISH QILISH KERAK
exercises.explanationUz:
SARLAVHA:
  'HOW TO TAKE CARE OF YOUR CAT'
  (Mushugingizni qanday parvarish qilish kerak)

RASM: kattakon ko'zli, yo'l-yo'l mushukcha.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  feed/twice a day
    → You SHOULD feed your cat twice a day.
       (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  leave/outside for a long time
    → You SHOULDN'T leave your cat outside for
      a long time.

 3  take/to the vet every six months
    → You SHOULD take your cat to the vet every
      six months.

 4  forget/to fill water bowl
    → You SHOULDN'T forget to fill its water
      bowl.

 5  empty/litter tray once a week
    → You SHOULD empty its litter tray once a
      week.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
 1  Mushugingizni kuniga ikki marta
    ovqatlantirishingiz kerak.
 2  Mushugingizni uzoq vaqt tashqarida
    qoldirmasligingiz kerak.
 3  Mushugingizni har olti oyda veterinarga
    olib borishingiz kerak.
 4  Uning suv idishini to'ldirishni
    unutmasligingiz kerak.
 5  Uning hojatxona lotogini haftada bir marta
    tozalashingiz kerak.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  MUSHUKKA FOYDALI  →  SHOULD    (1, 3, 5)
  MUSHUKKA ZARARLI  →  SHOULDN'T (2, 4)

     1  ovqatlantirish     — foydali
     2  uzoq tashqarida qoldirish — xavfli
     3  veterinarga olib borish — foydali
     4  suvni unutish      — zararli
     5  lotokni tozalash   — foydali


QISQARTMA ShAKLNI TO'LIQ GAPGA AYLANTIRISh:

  Kitob chiziqcha bilan qisqa ko'rsatma
  bergan. To'liq gapda EGALIK olmoshi va
  ARTIKL qo'shiladi:

     feed/twice a day
       → feed YOUR CAT twice a day

     leave/outside
       → leave YOUR CAT outside

     take/to the vet
       → take YOUR CAT to the vet

     forget/to fill water bowl
       → forget to fill ITS water bowl

     empty/litter tray
       → empty ITS litter tray


DIQQAT — 'ITS' va 'IT'S' FARQI:
  ITS   = uning (EGALIK olmoshi)
          'its water bowl' = uning suv idishi
  IT'S  = it is / it has (QISQARTMA)
          'it's cold' = sovuq

  Bu — inglizchadagi eng ko'p qilinadigan
  yozma xato!
  Egalik olmoshida APOSTROF YO'Q:
     its ✓   it's ✗ (egalik ma'nosida)


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDAGI IKKI INKOR EMAS:
  'You SHOULDN'T FORGET to fill ...'
  = unutmasligingiz kerak
  = ya'ni ESLAB QOLISHINGIZ kerak

  'shouldn't forget' — ikki inkor emas,
  chunki 'forget' o'zi inkor emas.

  Boshqacha aytish mumkin:
     'You should REMEMBER to fill its water
      bowl.' (bir xil ma'no)


DIQQAT — 'FORGET TO' va 'FORGET -ING':
  'forget TO DO' = qilishni unutmoq
     (qilinmagan)
  'forget DOING' = qilganini unutmoq
     (qilingan, lekin esdan chiqqan)

  Bu yerda 'forget TO FILL' — suvni quyish
  hali qilinmagan.


DIQQAT — TAKRORLANISh IBORALARI:
  TWICE a day      = kuniga ikki marta
  ONCE a week      = haftada bir marta
  EVERY six months = har olti oyda
  three TIMES a day = kuniga uch marta

  DIQQAT: 'once' va 'twice' — maxsus so'zlar
  ('one time', 'two times' kam ishlatiladi),
  lekin uchdan boshlab 'three TIMES'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to take care of = parvarish qilmoq
  to feed         = ovqatlantirmoq
                    (feed → FED)
  twice a day     = kuniga ikki marta
  to leave        = qoldirmoq (leave → LEFT)
  outside         = tashqarida
  a vet           = veterinar (mol shifokori)
  to fill         = to'ldirmoq
  a bowl          = kosa, idish
  to empty        = bo'shatmoq, tozalamoq
  a litter tray   = mushuk hojatxonasi (lotok)
  once a week     = haftada bir marta


DIQQAT — 'LITTER' SO'ZINING IKKI MA'NOSI:
  Coursebook 103-betda:
     'LITTER' = ko'chadagi axlat
     'Don't drop litter on the beach.'

  Bu yerda:
     'a LITTER TRAY' = mushuk hojatxonasi
     (ichiga maxsus qum solinadi)

  Bir so'z, ikki butunlay boshqa ma'no —
  KONTEKST hal qiladi.

exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri so'zning tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  MUST
   2  MUSTN'T
   3  SHOULDN'T
   4  CAN'T
   5  CAN
   6  SHOULD
   7  SHOULDN'T
   8  MUSTN'T
   9  SHOULD
  10  CAN'T


UCh SAVOL — HAR BANDDA:

  1) Ma'no IJOBIY mi, SALBIY mi?
  2) MAJBURIYAT mi, MASLAHAT mi, RUXSAT mi?
  3) QONUN/QOIDA mi, shaxsiy fikr mi?


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 1  'You MUST be quiet in class.'
    Jim bo'lish — IJOBIY qoida.
    'shouldn't' bo'lsa ma'no TESKARI bo'lardi
    ('jim bo'lmasligingiz kerak').
    → MUST
    (CB 102-bet, 13a: 'You must be quiet in
     class.')

 2  'When in China, you MUSTN'T kiss anyone in
     public.'
    Xitoyda bu QO'POL — TAQIQ.
    'must kiss' bo'lsa 'o'pishingiz shart'
    degan kulgili ma'no chiqadi.
    → MUSTN'T
    (CB 100-bet, Xitoy matni)

 3  'People SHOULDN'T smoke because it's bad
     for their health.'
    KALIT: 'BECAUSE IT'S BAD' — sabab
    salbiylikni ko'rsatib turibdi.
    → SHOULDN'T

 4  'Speak louder, please. I CAN'T hear you.'
    KALIT: 'Speak LOUDER' — demak hozir
    eshitilmayapti.
    'I can hear you' bo'lsa balandroq gapirish
    kerak bo'lmasdi.
    → CAN'T

 5  'CAN I have a glass of water, please?'
    KALIT: 'PLEASE' — bu ILTIMOS, majburiyat
    emas.
    'Must I have a glass of water?' =
    'suv ichishim shartmi?' — ma'nosiz.
    → CAN

 6  'You SHOULD keep your room tidy.'
    Xonani ozoda tutish — IJOBIY.
    'mustn't' bo'lsa 'ozoda tutmasligingiz
    kerak' degan teskari ma'no chiqadi.
    → SHOULD

 7  'You SHOULDN'T buy pre-packaged food.'
    O'ralgan ovqat ko'p chiqindi hosil qiladi
    — SALBIY.
    → SHOULDN'T
    (CB 99-bet: 'Try NOT to buy pre-packaged
     food.')

 8  'You MUSTN'T fight in class.'
    Urishish — TAQIQLANGAN.
    'can fight' bo'lsa 'urishishingiz mumkin'
    degan ma'no chiqadi.
    → MUSTN'T
    (CB 102-bet, 13a: 6-o'quvchi)

 9  'A: I'm tired.  B: You SHOULD go to bed
     early.'
    KALIT: 'I'M TIRED' — yordam kerak, demak
    IJOBIY maslahat.
    → SHOULD
    (CB 101-bet, 9b: 'Get some sleep.')

10  'A: Can I go to the cinema?
     B: No, you CAN'T.'
    OLTIN QOIDA: QISQA JAVOB savoldagi
    MODALNI TAKRORLAYDI.
       'CAN I ...?'  →  'No, you CAN'T.'
    'shouldn't' bo'lsa savolga mos kelmaydi.
    → CAN'T


ENG MUHIM UCh KALIT:

  A) MA'NO IJOBIY MI?
     ijobiy → must / should / can
     salbiy → mustn't / shouldn't / can't

  B) QISQA JAVOB SAVOLNI TAKRORLAYDI (10-band)
     'Can I ...?' → 'No, you can't.'

  C) KONTEKSTDAGI SABAB (3, 4, 9-bandlar)
     'because it's bad'  → shouldn't
     'Speak louder'      → can't
     'I'm tired'         → should


MUST va SHOULD FARQI (1 va 6-bandlar):
   1  'You MUST be quiet in class.'
      → QOIDA (maktab qoidasi, majburiy)
   6  'You SHOULD keep your room tidy.'
      → MASLAHAT (yumshoqroq)

  Kitob ataylab ikkalasini yonma-yon bergan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  tidy          = ozoda, tartibli
  to keep tidy  = ozoda tutmoq
  louder        = balandroq
  to hear       = eshitmoq (hear → HEARD)
  health        = sog'liq
  the cinema    = kinoteatr
  a glass of water = bir stakan suv

'jim bo'lmasligingiz kerak'.

(bu ham IJOBIY ko'rsatmalardan biri edi)

'BECAUSE IT'S BAD for their health'

Bu bandda javob gapning ICHIDA berilgan —

tasks.prompt: 4  Speak louder, please. I can't/can hear you.

ESHITILMAYAPTI.

Agar 'I CAN hear you' bo'lsa, balandroq
gapirish kerak bo'lmasdi — mantiqan zid.

'to hear' → HEARD (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'louder' — 'loud' ning qiyosiy darajasi.

tasks.prompt: 5  Must/Can I have a glass of water, please?
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT — 'PLEASE':
Bu ILTIMOS, majburiyat emas → CAN.

'Must I have a glass of water?' =
'suv ichishim SHARTMI?' — ma'nosiz savol.

tasks.prompt: 6  You should/mustn't keep your room tidy.
tasks.whyUz:
Xonani ozoda tutish — IJOBIY ish → SHOULD.

'mustn't' bo'lsa ma'no TESKARI:
'xonangizni ozoda tutmasligingiz kerak' —
kulgili.

DIQQAT — 1-BAND BILAN SOLISHTIRING:
  1  'You MUST be quiet' — QOIDA (majburiy)
  6  'You SHOULD keep tidy' — MASLAHAT (yumshoq)

'tidy' = ozoda, tartibli.

tasks.prompt: 7  You must/shouldn't buy pre-packaged food.
tasks.promptUz: Oldindan o'ralgan ovqat sotib olmasligingiz kerak.
tasks.whyUz:
O'ralgan ovqat ko'p CHIQINDI hosil qiladi
— SALBIY → SHOULDN'T.

Coursebook 99-betdagi varaqa:
'TRY NOT TO buy pre-packaged food.
The packaging creates a lot of rubbish.'

'must buy' bo'lsa 'sotib olishingiz shart'

tasks.prompt: 8  You can/mustn't fight in class.
tasks.whyUz:
Urishish — TAQIQLANGAN → MUSTN'T.

'can fight' bo'lsa 'urishishingiz MUMKIN'
degan ma'no chiqadi — maktab qoidasiga zid.

Coursebook 102-bet, 13a-mashq, 6-o'quvchi:
'You mustn't fight in class.'

'to fight' → FOUGHT (noto'g'ri fe'l).

tasks.prompt: 9  A: I'm tired.  B: You should/mustn't go to bed early.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT — 'I'M TIRED':
Charchagan odamga YORDAM kerak, demak
IJOBIY maslahat → SHOULD.

'mustn't go to bed early' = 'erta yotish
taqiqlangan' — charchagan odamga aytiladigan
gap emas.

'I feel very tired.' → 'You should get some
sleep.'

tasks.prompt: 10  A: Can I go to the cinema?  B: No, you shouldn't/can't.
tasks.whyUz:
OLTIN QOIDA — QISQA JAVOB SAVOLDAGI MODALNI
TAKRORLAYDI:

  'CAN I go ...?'  →  'No, you CAN'T.'
  'SHOULD I go ...?' → 'No, you SHOULDN'T.'

Savol 'CAN' bilan boshlangan, demak javob ham
'CAN'T' bo'ladi.

TO'LIQ DIALOG (javoblar bilan):

  Teacher:  Okay children, today we are going
            to visit the zoo and there are some
            rules we MUST follow. First, you
            MUSTN'T feed the animals.

  Student:  CAN we touch the animals?

  Teacher:  No, you CAN'T! You are not allowed
            to touch the animals because it's
            dangerous.

  Student:  CAN we take pictures of the animals?

  Teacher:  Yes, you CAN. You CAN take pictures
            but you MUSTN'T bother them.

  Student:  CAN we go anywhere we want?

  Teacher:  No! Everyone MUST stay close to me.


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:

  O'qituvchi: Xo'p bolalar, bugun hayvonot
              bog'iga boramiz va bajarishimiz
              KERAK bo'lgan bir necha qoida bor.
              Birinchidan, hayvonlarni
              ovqatlantirMANG.
  O'quvchi:   Hayvonlarga tegsak BO'LADIMI?
  O'qituvchi: Yo'q, BO'LMAYDI! Hayvonlarga
              tegishga ruxsat yo'q, chunki bu
              xavfli.
  O'quvchi:   Hayvonlarni suratga olsak
              BO'LADIMI?
  O'qituvchi: Ha, BO'LADI. Suratga olishingiz
              MUMKIN, lekin ularni bezovta
              qilMANG.
  O'quvchi:   Xohlagan joyimizga borsak
              BO'LADIMI?
  O'qituvchi: Yo'q! Hamma menga yaqin turishi
              KERAK.


HAR BIRI NEGA:

  1  'rules we ... FOLLOW'
     Qoidaga AMAL QILISh — MAJBURIYAT.
     → MUST

  2  'you ... FEED the animals'
     Hayvonot bog'ida ovqatlantirish
     TAQIQLANGAN.
     → MUSTN'T

  3  '... we TOUCH the animals?'
     SAVOL — RUXSAT so'ralyapti.
     → CAN
     ('Must we touch?' = 'tegishimiz shartmi?'
      — ma'nosiz)

  4  'No, you ...!'
     QISQA JAVOB savoldagi modalni
     TAKRORLAYDI: 'Can we?' → 'you CAN'T'.
     Yana KALIT: 'You are NOT ALLOWED to touch'
     — grammatika qutisidagi ta'rif:
     'can't = you AREN'T ALLOWED to'.
     → CAN'T

  5  '... we TAKE PICTURES?'
     Yana RUXSAT savoli.
     → CAN

  6  'Yes, you ...'
     Qisqa javob: 'Can we?' → 'you CAN'.
     → CAN

  7  'You ... take pictures'
     O'qituvchi hozirgina ruxsat berdi.
     → CAN

  8  'but you ... BOTHER them'
     'BUT' — qarama-qarshilik: ruxsat bor,
     LEKIN taqiq ham bor.
     Bezovta qilish TAQIQLANGAN.
     → MUSTN'T

  9  '... we go anywhere we want?'
     RUXSAT savoli.
     → CAN

 10  'Everyone ... STAY CLOSE to me.'
     Bu — QAT'IY qoida ('No!' bilan
     boshlangan).
     → MUST


OLTIN QOIDA — MASHQNING TUZILIShI:

  O'QUVChI so'raydi  →  DOIM 'CAN ...?'
                        (3, 5, 9)
  O'QITUVChI javob:
     ruxsat beradi   →  CAN     (6, 7)
     rad etadi       →  CAN'T   (4)
     qoida aytadi    →  MUST    (1, 10)
     taqiqlaydi      →  MUSTN'T (2, 8)


DIQQAT — 4-BAND 'MUSTN'T' EMAS, 'CAN'T':
  Ikkalasi ham taqiq, lekin:
  • QISQA JAVOB savoldagi modalni takrorlaydi
    ('Can we?' → 'you can't')
  • Matnning o'zi 'NOT ALLOWED' deydi —
    bu 'can't' ning ta'rifi


DIQQAT — 'ANYWHERE WE WANT':
  'anywhere (that) we want' = xohlagan
  joyimizga
  Coursebook 100-betdagi Yaponiya matnida ham
  bor edi: 'don't sit ANYWHERE YOU LIKE'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a zoo         = hayvonot bog'i
  to follow rules = qoidalarga amal qilmoq
  to feed       = ovqatlantirmoq
  to touch      = tegmoq
  allowed       = ruxsat etilgan
  dangerous     = xavfli
  to take pictures = suratga olmoq
  to bother     = bezovta qilmoq
  anywhere      = istalgan joyda
  close to      = ... ga yaqin

exercises.explanationUz:
IBORALAR (4 ta):
  you should
  I think it's a good idea
  Why don't you
  I don't think it's a good idea

MATN: Tresi Lindaga xat yozgan (Rimga
ko'chib borish haqida). Rasmda Rim Kolizeyi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA
  2  I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA
  3  YOU SHOULD
  4  WHY DON'T YOU


TO'LIQ XAT (javoblar bilan):

                              6th May
  Dear Linda,

  I'm happy to hear that you are moving to
  Rome. I'm worried though, that you don't
  have a place to stay when you get there.

  I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA to move to Rome,
  but I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA to stay
  at a hotel because hotels are very expensive
  in Rome. Maybe YOU SHOULD wait a little while
  and go when you find a flat. WHY DON'T YOU
  ask your friends there to look for a flat
  for you?

  Hope to hear from you soon.

                              Love,
                              Tracy


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:
  Hurmatli Linda,

  Rimga ko'chib ketayotganingni eshitib
  xursandman. Lekin u yerga borganingda
  turadigan joying yo'qligidan xavotirdaman.

  Menimcha, Rimga ko'chish yaxshi fikr, lekin
  mehmonxonada turish yaxshi fikr emas, chunki
  Rimda mehmonxonalar juda qimmat. Balki biroz
  kutib, kvartira topganingdan keyin borsang
  yaxshiroq. U yerdagi do'stlaringdan senga
  kvartira qidirishlarini so'rasang-chi?

  Tez orada javobingni kutaman.

  Mehr bilan, Tresi


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — FAQAT GRAMMATIKA!

  Har bo'shliqdan KEYINGI so'z javobni
  belgilab beradi:

  1  '... TO MOVE to Rome'
     Keyin 'TO + fe'l' keladi.
     'a good idea TO + fe'l' qurilmasi.
     Ma'no IJOBIY (Rimga ko'chish yaxshi).
     → I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA

  2  'BUT ... TO STAY at a hotel'
     Yana 'TO + fe'l', LEKIN oldida 'BUT' bor
     va sabab salbiy ('hotels are very
     EXPENSIVE').
     → I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA

  3  'Maybe ... WAIT a little while'
     Keyin 'to' SIZ fe'l ('wait') keladi!
     'should + ASOSIY fe'l' qurilmasi.
     → YOU SHOULD

  4  '... ASK your friends ... ?'
     Gap SAVOL BELGISI bilan tugaydi!
     Ro'yxatdagi yagona savol shakli —
     'Why don't you ...?'
     → WHY DON'T YOU


ENG MUHIM UCh BELGI:

  A) 'TO + fe'l' keladimi?
        → 'it's a good idea TO ...'
           (1 va 2-bandlar)

  B) 'to' SIZ fe'l keladimi?
        → 'you should + fe'l'
           (3-band)

  C) Gap oxirida SAVOL BELGISI bormi?
        → 'Why don't you ...?'
           (4-band)

  Bu uch belgi mashqni GRAMMATIK jihatdan
  butunlay hal qiladi — taxmin kerak emas.


DIQQAT — 1 va 2 NI QANDAY AJRATISh:
  Ikkalasida ham 'TO + fe'l' keladi.
  Farqi — MA'NODA:
     1  Rimga ko'chish — Tresi buni QO'LLAB-
        QUVVATLAYDI ('I'm happy to hear')
        → ijobiy
     2  'BUT' + 'hotels are very EXPENSIVE'
        → salbiy

  'BUT' so'zi qarama-qarshilikni ko'rsatib
  turibdi.


XAT TUZILIShI (norasmiy xat):
  Sana:        6th May (o'ng yuqorida)
  Murojaat:    Dear Linda,
  1-xatboshi:  sabab (nima uchun yozyapman)
  2-xatboshi:  maslahatlar
  Yakun:       Hope to hear from you soon.
  Imzo:        Love, Tracy


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to move to    = ... ga ko'chib bormoq
  worried       = xavotirda
  though        = lekin, biroq (gap o'rtasida
                  yoki oxirida)
  a place to stay = turadigan joy
  to get there  = u yerga yetib bormoq
  expensive     = qimmat
  a while       = biroz vaqt
  a flat        = kvartira
  to look for   = qidirmoq
  Hope to hear from you soon = Tez orada
                  javobingizni kutaman

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in can, can't, could or couldn't.
exercises.instructionUz: can, can't, could yoki couldn't ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  COULDN'T ... CAN
  2  CAN
  3  COULD
  4  CAN'T
  5  CAN
  6  COULDN'T
  7  COULDN'T ... CAN
  8  COULD


TO'LIQ GAPLAR VA TARJIMASI:

 1  Michael COULDN'T use a computer when he was
    two but he CAN now.
    (Maykl ikki yoshida kompyuterdan
     foydalana olmasdi, lekin hozir oladi.)

 2  Sally is from Paris. She CAN speak French.
    (Salli Parijdan. U fransuzcha gapira oladi.)

 3  COULD you play football when you were five?
    (Besh yoshingizda futbol o'ynay olarmidingiz?)

 4  I CAN'T go to the cinema. I must study for
    a test.
    (Kinoga bora olmayman. Nazorat ishiga
     tayyorlanishim kerak.)

 5  Paul is a chef. He CAN make many delicious
    dishes.
    (Pol oshpaz. U ko'p mazali taomlar tayyorlay
     oladi.)

 6  I lost my keys and I COULDN'T find them
    anywhere.
    (Kalitlarimni yo'qotdim va ularni hech
     qayerdan topa olmadim.)

 7  I COULDN'T count when I was three but I CAN
    now.
    (Uch yoshimda sanay olmasdim, lekin hozir
     olaman.)

 8  COULD you ride a bicycle when you were four?
    (To'rt yoshingizda velosiped mina
     olarmidingiz?)


OLTIN QOIDA — VAQT BELGISINI TOPING:

  O'TGAN ZAMON belgisi bo'lsa  →  COULD/COULDN'T
     'when he WAS two'
     'when you WERE five'
     'when I WAS three'
     'when you WERE four'
     'I LOST my keys'

  HOZIRGI ZAMON belgisi bo'lsa  →  CAN/CAN'T
     'but he ... NOW'
     'She IS from Paris'
     'Paul IS a chef'
     'I MUST study' (hozirgi majburiyat)

  Ya'ni GAPDAGI BOSHQA FE'L zamonni aytib
  turibdi!


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 1  IKKI BO'SHLIQ, IKKI ZAMON:
       'when he WAS two'  → o'tgan → COULDN'T
       'but he ... NOW'   → hozir  → CAN
    Ma'no: ikki yoshida bilmasdi, hozir biladi.
    Shuning uchun birinchisi INKOR, ikkinchisi
    TASDIQ.

 2  'She IS from Paris' — hozirgi zamon.
    Parijliklar fransuzcha gapiradi → QOBILIYAT
    bor.
    → CAN

 3  'when you WERE five' — o'tgan zamon.
    SAVOL shakli → COULD egadan oldin.
    → COULD

 4  'I MUST study for a test' — hozirgi
    majburiyat, shuning uchun kinoga bora
    olmaydi.
    → CAN'T

 5  'Paul IS a chef' — hozirgi zamon.
    Oshpaz — demak QOBILIYATI bor.
    → CAN

 6  'I LOST my keys' — o'tgan zamon (lost).
    Shuning uchun keyingi fe'l ham o'tgan
    zamonda.
    → COULDN'T
    ('anywhere' — inkor gapda 'hech qayerda')

 7  1-band bilan AYNAN bir xil tuzilish:
       'when I WAS three' → COULDN'T
       'but I ... NOW'    → CAN

 8  3-band bilan bir xil: 'when you WERE four'
    → savol, o'tgan zamon
    → COULD


DIQQAT — 6-BANDDA 'ANYWHERE':
  'I couldn't find them ANYWHERE.'
  = hech qayerdan topa olmadim

  INKOR gapda 'anywhere' = 'hech qayerda'.
  TASDIQ gapda 'anywhere' = 'istalgan joyda'
  (5-mashqning 9-bandidagidek).

  Bir so'z, gap shakliga qarab ikki ma'no!


DIQQAT — 'CAN' QOBILIYAT MI, RUXSAT MI:
  Bu mashqda hammasi QOBILIYAT (ability):
     use a computer, speak French, play
     football, make dishes, count, ride a
     bicycle

  4-bandda esa boshqacha: 'I CAN'T go to the
  cinema' — bu qobiliyat emas, VAZIYAT
  (imkoni yo'q, chunki o'qishi kerak).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to use a computer = kompyuterdan foydalanmoq
  French            = fransuz tili
  a chef            = oshpaz (professional)
  delicious         = mazali
  a dish            = taom; likopcha
  to lose           = yo'qotmoq (lose → LOST)
  keys              = kalitlar
  anywhere          = hech qayerda (inkorda)
  to count          = sanamoq
  a bicycle         = velosiped

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in must or mustn't.
exercises.instructionUz: must yoki mustn't ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  MUSTN'T
  2  MUST
  3  MUST
  4  MUSTN'T
  5  MUSTN'T
  6  MUST


TO'LIQ GAPLAR VA TARJIMASI:

 1  It's cold. You MUSTN'T leave without your
    jacket.
    (Sovuq. Kurtkasiz chiqmang.)

 2  You MUST eat fruit and vegetables to stay
    healthy.
    (Sog'lom bo'lish uchun meva va sabzavot
     yeyishingiz kerak.)

 3  I MUST go to the post office. I have a
    letter to send.
    (Pochtaga borishim kerak. Yuboradigan
     xatim bor.)

 4  You MUSTN'T speak rudely to your parents.
    (Ota-onangizga qo'pol gapirmang.)

 5  You MUSTN'T park here — it's illegal.
    (Bu yerga mashina qo'ymang — qonunga
     xilof.)

 6  We MUST hurry or we'll miss the bus.
    (Shoshilishimiz kerak, aks holda
     avtobusdan qolamiz.)


HAR BIRIDA SABAB GAPNING ICHIDA:

 1  'IT'S COLD.'
    → kurtkasiz chiqish XAVFLI → MUSTN'T

 2  'TO STAY HEALTHY'
    → maqsad IJOBIY → MUST

 3  'I HAVE A LETTER TO SEND.'
    → sabab bor, borish KERAK → MUST

 4  'RUDELY' (qo'pol)
    → qo'pollik TAQIQLANGAN → MUSTN'T

 5  'IT'S ILLEGAL.'
    → qonun taqiqlagan → MUSTN'T
    (Coursebook 102-bet, 16e-dialog bilan
     AYNAN bir xil!)

 6  'OR WE'LL MISS THE BUS.'
    → 'or' = aks holda; shoshilish ZARUR
    → MUST


OLTIN QOIDA:
  Har bandda IKKINCHI qism (sabab) javobni
  belgilaydi.
     Sabab SALBIY/XAVFLI  →  MUSTN'T
     Sabab MAQSAD/ZARURAT →  MUST


DIQQAT — 6-BANDDAGI 'OR':
  'We must hurry OR we'll miss the bus.'
  'or' = aks holda

  Coursebook 100-betdagi Angliya matnida ham
  bor edi:
  'Never push into a queue OR they'll get
   angry.'

  Tuzilishi:
     [buyruq/must] + OR + [will bilan natija]


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDA 'RUDELY':
  'speak RUDELY' — RAVISH (fe'lni izohlaydi)
  'be RUDE' — SIFAT

     'He speaks rudely.'  ✓ (ravish)
     'He is rude.'        ✓ (sifat)
     'He speaks rude.'    ✗

  Coursebook 100-bet, Xitoy matni:
  'it's very RUDE' (sifat).


DIQQAT — 3-BANDDA 'A LETTER TO SEND':
  'I have a letter TO SEND.'
  = yuboradigan xatim bor

  'ot + TO + fe'l' qurilmasi:
     something to eat   = yeydigan narsa
     a place to stay    = turadigan joy
                          (6-mashqdagi xatda!)
     work to do         = qiladigan ish


DIQQAT — 1-BANDDA 'WITHOUT':
  'leave WITHOUT your jacket' = kurtkasiz
  chiqmoq
  'without' — predlog, keyin OT yoki -ING:
     without a jacket
     without eating


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to leave        = chiqmoq, ketmoq
  without         = ...siz
  a jacket        = kurtka
  to stay healthy = sog'lom bo'lib turmoq
  the post office = pochta bo'limi
  to send         = yubormoq (send → SENT)
  rudely          = qo'pol tarzda
  parents         = ota-ona
  illegal         = qonunga xilof
  to hurry        = shoshilmoq
  to miss the bus = avtobusdan qolmoq

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with should or shouldn't.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni should yoki shouldn't bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  SHOULD
  2  SHOULDN'T
  3  SHOULD
  4  SHOULD
  5  SHOULDN'T
  6  SHOULD
  7  SHOULD
  8  SHOULDN'T

  Ya'ni: SHOULD — 1, 3, 4, 6, 7 (5 ta)
         SHOULDN'T — 2, 5, 8 (3 ta)


TO'LIQ GAPLAR VA TARJIMASI:

 1  Kevin has a problem with his eyes. He
    SHOULD see an optician.
    (Kevinning ko'zi bilan muammo bor. U
     ko'zoynak ustasiga borishi kerak.)

 2  People SHOULDN'T drop litter in the
    streets.
    (Odamlar ko'chalarga axlat tashlamasligi
     kerak.)

 3  It's cold outside. You SHOULD put on a
    heavy jacket.
    (Tashqarida sovuq. Qalin kurtka
     kiyishingiz kerak.)

 4  You SHOULD look both ways before crossing
    the street.
    (Ko'chadan o'tishdan oldin ikki tomonga
     qarashingiz kerak.)

 5  You SHOULDN'T swim after eating a big meal.
    (Ko'p ovqat yegandan keyin suzmasligingiz
     kerak.)

 6  Michael SHOULD join a gym to lose weight.
    (Maykl vazn tashlash uchun sport zaliga
     yozilishi kerak.)

 7  When you are on a bus you SHOULD give your
    seat to older people.
    (Avtobusda bo'lganingizda o'rningizni
     keksalarga berishingiz kerak.)

 8  Children SHOULDN'T talk to strangers.
    (Bolalar notanish odamlar bilan
     gaplashmasligi kerak.)


OLTIN QOIDA:
  Ish FOYDALI/XAVFSIZ    →  SHOULD
  Ish ZARARLI/XAVFLI     →  SHOULDN'T


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  KALIT: 'a PROBLEM with his eyes' —
    muammo bor, demak yordam kerak → SHOULD.
    (Coursebook 102-bet, 16a-dialog:
     'You should see an optician.')

 2  Ko'chaga axlat tashlash — ZARARLI
    → SHOULDN'T.
    (Coursebook 99-bet, varaqa)

 3  KALIT: 'IT'S COLD outside' — sovuqda
    qalin kiyim FOYDALI → SHOULD.
    (Grammar 62-bet, 8-mashqning 1-bandi:
     'It's cold. You mustn't leave without
      your jacket.')

 4  Ko'chadan o'tishdan oldin qarash —
    XAVFSIZLIK choralari → SHOULD.

 5  To'la oshqozon bilan suzish — XAVFLI
    → SHOULDN'T.
    (Coursebook 103-bet, 17b:
     'It is dangerous to swim with a full
      stomach.')

 6  KALIT: 'TO LOSE WEIGHT' — maqsad
    IJOBIY → SHOULD.

 7  Keksalarga o'rin berish — ODOBLI ish
    → SHOULD.

 8  Notanish odamlar bilan gaplashish —
    bolalar uchun XAVFLI → SHOULDN'T.


DIQQAT — 'PUT ON' AJRALADIGAN FE'L:
  'PUT ON a heavy jacket'  ✓
  'PUT a heavy jacket ON'  ✓
  'PUT IT ON'              ✓
  'PUT ON IT'              ✗

  Coursebook 101-bet, 9b: 'Put a jumper on.'


DIQQAT — 'BEFORE CROSSING':
  'before CROSSING the street'
  Predlogdan keyin fe'l -ING oladi.

  Yana: 'after EATING' (5-band)


DIQQAT — 'LOOK BOTH WAYS':
  'both ways' = ikki tomonga (chapga va o'ngga)
  'a way' bu yerda = tomon, yo'nalish.


DIQQAT — 'JOIN A GYM':
  'to JOIN a gym/club/team' = a'zo bo'lmoq,
  yozilmoq
  ('to enter a gym' — shunchaki ichkariga
   kirish)

  'to LOSE WEIGHT' = vazn tashlamoq
  (lose → LOST)
  Teskarisi: 'to PUT ON weight' = semirmoq


DIQQAT — 'GIVE YOUR SEAT TO':
  'give something TO somebody' — predlog 'to'.
  'older people' = keksalar
  ('old people' ham to'g'ri, lekin 'older'
   odobliroq).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an optician    = ko'zoynak ustasi
  litter         = axlat
  heavy          = qalin, og'ir
  both ways      = ikki tomonga
  to cross       = kesib o'tmoq
  a meal         = ovqat (bir mahal)
  to join a gym  = sport zaliga yozilmoq
  to lose weight = vazn tashlamoq
  a seat         = o'rindiq, joy
  older people   = keksalar
  a stranger     = notanish odam
