exercises.instructionEn: Read the leaflet below giving advice to dog owners and make sentences using should or shouldn't, as in the example. — HOW TO TAKE CARE OF YOUR DOG
exercises.instructionUz: It egalariga maslahat beruvchi quyidagi varaqani o'qing va namunadagidek should yoki shouldn't bilan gap tuzing. — ITINGIZNI QANDAY PARVARISH QILISH KERAK
exercises.explanationUz:
SARLAVHA:
  'HOW TO TAKE CARE OF YOUR DOG'
  (Itingizni qanday parvarish qilish kerak)

BESH BAND, HAR BIRIDA RASM va BELGI:
  ✓ = SHOULD    (qilish kerak)
  ✗ = SHOULDN'T (qilmaslik kerak)

  Ya'ni BELGI javobni AYTIB TURIBDI —
  taxmin kerak emas!


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  ✓ take/for a walk three times a day
    → You SHOULD take your dog for a walk
      three times a day.
      (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  ✗ keep/cage
    → You SHOULDN'T keep your dog in a cage.

 3  ✓ feed/once a day
    → You SHOULD feed your dog once a day.

 4  ✓ wash/once a week
    → You SHOULD wash your dog once a week.

 5  ✗ leave/at home alone
    → You SHOULDN'T leave your dog at home
      alone.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
 1  Itingizni kuniga uch marta sayrga olib
    chiqishingiz kerak.
 2  Itingizni qafasda saqlamasligingiz kerak.
 3  Itingizni kuniga bir marta
    ovqatlantirishingiz kerak.
 4  Itingizni haftada bir marta
    yuvishingiz kerak.
 5  Itingizni uyda yolg'iz
    qoldirmasligingiz kerak.


RASMLARDA NIMA KO'RINADI:
  1  It sayr uchun tayyor, arqonni tishlab
     turibdi
  2  It QAFASDA (panjara ortida), g'amgin
  3  It kosasi yonida o'tiribdi
  4  It TOG'ORAda yuvinyapti
  5  It 'FIDO' yozuvli budkasida YOLG'IZ


QISQARTMA ShAKLNI TO'LIQ GAPGA AYLANTIRISh:

  Kitob chiziqcha bilan qisqa ko'rsatma
  bergan. To'liq gapda EGALIK olmoshi va
  PREDLOG qo'shiladi:

     take/for a walk
       → take YOUR DOG for a walk

     keep/cage
       → keep YOUR DOG IN A cage

     feed/once a day
       → feed YOUR DOG once a day

     wash/once a week
       → wash YOUR DOG once a week

     leave/at home alone
       → leave YOUR DOG at home alone

  DIQQAT — 2-BANDDA PREDLOG QO'ShILADI:
  'keep/cage' → 'keep your dog IN A cage'
  Bu — eng ko'p unutiladigan joy.


GRAMMAR 61-BET BILAN SOLIShTIRING:
  U yerda AYNAN shunday mashq bor edi, lekin
  MUShUK haqida:
     'HOW TO TAKE CARE OF YOUR CAT'
     feed/twice a day, leave/outside,
     take/to the vet, forget/to fill water
     bowl, empty/litter tray

  Bu yerda IT haqida.
  Farqlar qiziq:
     mushuk — kuniga IKKI marta ovqat
     it     — kuniga BIR marta ovqat


TAKRORLANISh IBORALARI:
  three times a day = kuniga uch marta
  once a day        = kuniga bir marta
  once a week       = haftada bir marta

  DIQQAT:
     once  (bir marta) — 'one time' emas
     twice (ikki marta) — 'two times' emas
     three TIMES (uch marta) — uchdan boshlab
                              'times'


DIQQAT — 'TAKE FOR A WALK':
  'to take somebody FOR A WALK' = sayrga olib
  chiqmoq (turg'un ibora)

  'to GO for a walk' = sayr qilmoq
  'to TAKE somebody for a walk' = birovni
  sayrga olib chiqmoq


DIQQAT — 'LEAVE ... ALONE':
  'leave your dog at home ALONE' = uyda
  YOLG'IZ qoldirmoq

  'alone' — sifat/ravish (yolg'iz).
  DIQQAT: 'lonely' — BOSHQA ma'no
  (yolg'izlikdan qiynalgan).

  Coursebook 100-bet, Yaponiya matni:
  'find a place where you can do it ALONE'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a dog owner   = it egasi
  to take care of = parvarish qilmoq
  to take for a walk = sayrga olib chiqmoq
  a cage        = qafas
  to feed       = ovqatlantirmoq
  to wash       = yuvmoq
  to leave alone = yolg'iz qoldirmoq
  three times a day = kuniga uch marta

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table below about camping tips and tick the appropriate column. Then make sentences using always or never.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi kemping maslahatlari jadvaliga qarang va tegishli ustunga ✓ qo'ying. So'ngra always yoki never bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL IKKI USTUNLI:  DO  /  DON'T

Birinchi qatorga kitob ✓ ni ALLAQAChON
'DON'T' ustuniga qo'ygan (namuna).


BARCHA JAVOBLAR (✓ qayerga):

  1  leave the camp fire burning when you go
     to sleep                        →  DON'T
  2  have a torch with you           →  DO
  3  take too many clothes with you  →  DON'T
  4  put your tent up next to a river →  DON'T
  5  keep a lot of money in your tent →  DON'T
  6  leave rubbish behind            →  DON'T
  7  tell your family where you are  →  DO

  Ya'ni: DO — 2 va 7 (2 ta)
         DON'T — 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 (5 ta)


TO'LIQ GAPLAR:

 1  NEVER leave the camp fire burning when you
    go to sleep.
    (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  ALWAYS have a torch with you.

 3  NEVER take too many clothes with you.

 4  NEVER put your tent up next to a river.

 5  NEVER keep a lot of money in your tent.

 6  NEVER leave rubbish behind.

 7  ALWAYS tell your family where you are.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
 1  Uxlagani ketayotganda gulxanni yonib
    turgan holda hech qachon qoldirmang.
 2  Doim qo'l fonarini yoningizda olib yuring.
 3  Hech qachon juda ko'p kiyim olmang.
 4  Chodiringizni hech qachon daryo yoniga
    tikmang.
 5  Chodiringizda hech qachon ko'p pul
    saqlamang.
 6  Hech qachon axlat tashlab ketmang.
 7  Doim oilangizga qayerdaligingizni ayting.


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  DON'T — yonayotgan gulxan O'RMON
    YONG'INIGA sabab bo'ladi.
    (Coursebook 99-bet: 'Never light fires in
     forests. Trees will burn.')

 2  DO — fonar kechasi ZARUR (kempingda
    elektr yo'q).

 3  DON'T — ko'p kiyim = OG'IR yuk;
    hammasini o'zingiz ko'tarasiz.

 4  DON'T — daryo TOSHIB ketishi mumkin,
    chodir suv ostida qoladi.

 5  DON'T — chodirni QULFLAB bo'lmaydi,
    pul o'g'irlanadi.

 6  DON'T — axlat tabiatni IFLOSLANTIRADI.
    (Coursebook 99 va 103-betlar)

 7  DO — biror narsa bo'lsa, oilangiz
    sizni QAYERDAN qidirishni biladi.


OLTIN QOIDA:
  DO ustuni    →  ALWAYS + fe'l
  DON'T ustuni →  NEVER + fe'l

  Ikkalasi ham BUYRUQ maylida — ega YO'Q.


DIQQAT — 'PUT YOUR TENT UP':
  'to put up a tent' = chodir tikmoq
  AJRALADIGAN fe'l:
     put your tent up  ✓
     put up your tent  ✓
     put IT up         ✓
     put up IT         ✗


DIQQAT — 'LEAVE ... BURNING':
  'leave the camp fire BURNING'
  = gulxanni YONIB TURGAN holda qoldirmoq

  'leave + ot + -ING' — holatni bildiradi:
     leave the tap running
     leave the door open


DIQQAT — 'LEAVE RUBBISH BEHIND':
  'to leave BEHIND' = ortda qoldirib ketmoq
  'behind' gap oxirida turadi.


DIQQAT — 'TOO MANY':
  'take TOO MANY clothes' = haddan tashqari
  ko'p kiyim
  'too many' + SANALADIGAN
  'too much' + SANALMAYDIGAN

  DIQQAT: 'clothes' — DOIM ko'plikda
  ('a clothe' XATO; birligi 'a piece of
   clothing').


DIQQAT — 'TELL YOUR FAMILY WHERE YOU ARE':
  'tell somebody WHERE you are'
  Ergash gapda so'z tartibi TO'G'RI
  (savol tartibi EMAS):
     'where YOU ARE'    ✓
     'where ARE YOU'    ✗


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  camping        = kemping, chodirda dam olish
  a camp fire    = gulxan
  to burn        = yonmoq
  a torch        = qo'l fonari (britancha;
                   AmE: a flashlight)
  clothes        = kiyim-kechak (DOIM ko'plik)
  a tent         = chodir
  to put up a tent = chodir tikmoq
  next to        = yonida
  to leave behind = ortda qoldirmoq

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the phrases below.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni quyidagi iboralar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
IBORALAR (4 ta):
  you should
  I think it's a good idea
  Why don't you
  I don't think it's a good idea

MATN: Erik Semga xat yozgan (do'kon ochish
haqida).


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA
  2  I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA
  3  YOU SHOULD
  4  WHY DON'T YOU


TO'LIQ XAT (javoblar bilan):

  Dear Sam,

  I'm pleased to hear that you want to open
  your own shop. I'm worried though, that you
  want to ask your friend for the money you
  need.

  I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA to open a place of
  your own but I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA
  to borrow money from your friend because he
  may want to get involved in the shop and that
  can become a problem. Perhaps YOU SHOULD wait
  a little while so that you can make some
  money of your own. WHY DON'T YOU ask the bank
  for a loan?

  Hope to hear from you soon.

                              Love,
                              Eric


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:
  Hurmatli Sem,

  O'z do'koningni ochmoqchi ekaningni eshitib
  xursandman. Lekin kerakli pulni do'stingdan
  so'ramoqchi ekaningdan xavotirdaman.

  Menimcha, o'z joyingni ochish yaxshi fikr,
  lekin do'stingdan qarz olish yaxshi fikr
  emas, chunki u do'konga aralashishni xohlab
  qolishi mumkin va bu muammoga aylanadi.
  Balki biroz kutib, o'zing pul topishing
  kerakdir. Bankdan qarz so'rasang-chi?

  Tez orada javobingni kutaman.

  Mehr bilan, Erik


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — FAQAT GRAMMATIKA:

  1  '... TO OPEN a place of your own'
     Keyin 'TO + fe'l' → 'a good idea TO ...'
     Ma'no IJOBIY ('I'm PLEASED to hear')
     → I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA

  2  'BUT ... TO BORROW money'
     Yana 'TO + fe'l', lekin oldida 'BUT'
     va sabab salbiy ('can become a PROBLEM')
     → I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA

  3  'Perhaps ... WAIT a little while'
     Keyin 'to' SIZ fe'l ('wait')
     → YOU SHOULD

  4  '... ASK the bank for a loan?'
     Gap SAVOL BELGISI bilan tugaydi!
     → WHY DON'T YOU


UCh BELGI (Grammar 62-bet, 6-mashq bilan
AYNAN bir xil):

  A) 'TO + fe'l' keladi  →  it's a good idea TO
  B) 'to' SIZ fe'l       →  you should
  C) SAVOL BELGISI (?)   →  Why don't you


GRAMMAR 62-BET BILAN SOLIShTIRING:
  U yerda: Tresi → Lindaga (Rimga ko'chish)
  Bu yerda: Erik → Semga (do'kon ochish)

  Tuzilishi AYNAN bir xil:
     1) ijobiy fikr
     2) 'but' + salbiy fikr
     3) 'Perhaps/Maybe' + you should
     4) 'Why don't you ...?'

  Kitob ataylab takrorlagan — qolipni
  mustahkamlash uchun.


DIQQAT — 'OF YOUR OWN':
  'a place OF YOUR OWN' = o'zingizniki
  'your OWN shop' = o'z do'koningiz

  'own' egalikni KUCHAYTIRADI:
     'my own house' = aynan mening uyim


DIQQAT — 'SO THAT':
  'wait a little while SO THAT you can make
   some money'
  'so that' = ... uchun (MAQSAD)

  Grammar 62-bet, 9-mashqning 2-bandi ham
  shu haqda edi:
  'Tonia is saving money SO she can go on
   holiday.'


DIQQAT — 'GET INVOLVED IN':
  'to get INVOLVED IN something' = biror
  ishga aralashmoq


DIQQAT — 'ASK FOR':
  'ask your friend FOR the money'
  'ask the bank FOR a loan'
  'to ask somebody FOR something' = so'ramoq

  DIQQAT: 'ask somebody something' — savol
  berish ('ask me a question');
  'ask somebody FOR something' — narsa
  so'rash.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  pleased        = mamnun, xursand
  your own       = o'zingizniki
  to borrow      = qarz olmoq
  to lend        = qarz bermoq (TESKARISI)
  to get involved in = aralashmoq
  perhaps        = balki
  so that        = ... uchun
  a loan         = qarz, kredit
  to make money  = pul topmoq

exercises.instructionEn: Read the notice of library rules and make sentences about what you must and mustn't do, as in the example. — BEARBROOK LIBRARY RULES
exercises.instructionUz: Kutubxona qoidalari e'lonini o'qing va nima qilish va qilmaslik kerakligi haqida namunadagidek gap tuzing. — BEARBROOK KUTUBXONASI QOIDALARI
exercises.explanationUz:
E'LON MATNI:

  BEARBROOK LIBRARY RULES
  Remember!
   1  Be quiet
   2  No smoking
   3  Return books on time
   4  No eating or drinking
   5  Don't bring pets into the library
   6  Keep books in good condition


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  You MUST be quiet.
    (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  You MUSTN'T smoke.

 3  You MUST return books on time.

 4  You MUSTN'T eat or drink.

 5  You MUSTN'T bring pets into the library.

 6  You MUST keep books in good condition.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
 1  Jim bo'lishingiz kerak.
 2  Chekmasligingiz kerak.
 3  Kitoblarni o'z vaqtida qaytarishingiz kerak.
 4  Ovqat yeyish yoki ichish mumkin emas.
 5  Kutubxonaga uy hayvonlarini olib
    kirmasligingiz kerak.
 6  Kitoblarni yaxshi holatda saqlashingiz
    kerak.


OLTIN QOIDA — E'LON ShAKLI JAVOBNI BERADI:

  IJOBIY buyruq  →  MUST
     'BE quiet'                (1)
     'RETURN books on time'    (3)
     'KEEP books in good condition' (6)

  'NO + -ING'    →  MUSTN'T
     'NO SMOKING'              (2)
     'NO EATING OR DRINKING'   (4)

  'DON'T + fe'l' →  MUSTN'T
     'DON'T BRING pets'        (5)

  Ya'ni: 3 ta MUST, 3 ta MUSTN'T.


'NO + -ING' NI GAPGA AYLANTIRISh:

  E'LONDA          →  GAPDA
  'No smoking'     →  'You mustn't SMOKE.'
  'No eating'      →  'You mustn't EAT.'
  'No parking'     →  'You mustn't PARK.'

  DIQQAT: '-ING' TUShIB QOLADI!
     'You mustn't smokING' ✗
     'You mustn't SMOKE'   ✓

  Chunki 'mustn't' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl
  keladi.


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDAGI 'OR':
  'No eating OR drinking'
  → 'You mustn't eat OR drink.'

  INKOR gapda 'and' emas, 'OR':
     'You mustn't eat OR drink.'  ✓
     'You mustn't eat AND drink.' — ma'no
       o'zgaradi (ikkalasini BIRGA qilmaslik)


DIQQAT — 'BRING INTO':
  'bring pets INTO the library'
  'into' — ichkariga HARAKAT.

  Coursebook 102-bet, 13a, 8-o'quvchi:
  'You mustn't bring pets INTO school.'


DIQQAT — 'IN GOOD CONDITION':
  'keep books IN GOOD CONDITION'
  = kitoblarni yaxshi holatda saqlamoq

  'condition' = holat, ahvol.
  'in good/bad condition' — turg'un ibora.


DIQQAT — 'ON TIME' YANA:
  'return books ON time' = kitoblarni o'z
  vaqtida qaytarmoq

  Workbook 57-bet, 6-mashqning 6-bandi ham
  shu edi: 'pay the rent ON time'.


NEGA 'MUSTN'T', 'SHOULDN'T' EMAS:
  Bular KUTUBXONANING RASMIY QOIDALARI —
  maslahat emas, MAJBURIYAT va TAQIQ.

  Grammar 60-bet: 'We use must b) FOR RULES'.


RASM:
  Kutubxonachi ayol stolda kitob ustida
  o'tiribdi, orqasida kitob javonlari.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a library      = kutubxona
  a notice       = e'lon
  quiet          = jim
  to return      = qaytarmoq
  on time        = o'z vaqtida
  to bring into  = ichkariga olib kirmoq
  condition      = holat, ahvol
  in good condition = yaxshi holatda

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogue below and fill in the gaps with the appropriate modal verbs.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi dialogni o'qing va bo'shliqlarni mos modal fe'llar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
VAZIYAT: o'qituvchi bolalarni MUZEYGA olib
bormoqda va qoidalarni tushuntiryapti.

(Grammar 62-betdagi HAYVONOT BOG'I dialogi
bilan AYNAN bir xil tuzilish!)


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  MUST
  2  CAN
  3  CAN'T
  4  MUSTN'T
  5  CAN
  6  CAN'T
  7  MUSTN'T
  8  CAN
  9  CAN


TO'LIQ DIALOG (javoblar bilan):

  Teacher: Today we are going to visit the
           museum children and there are some
           things we need to talk about.
           First you MUST always stay close
           to me.

  S1:      CAN we bring our cameras?

  Teacher: No, you CAN'T! You MUSTN'T take any
           pictures.

  S2:      CAN we bring our lunch with us?

  Teacher: No, you CAN'T! You MUSTN'T eat in
           the museum.

  S3:      Where CAN we eat?

  Teacher: You CAN eat in the restaurant which
           is next to the museum.


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:
  O'qituvchi: Bugun muzeyga boramiz, bolalar,
              va gaplashishimiz kerak bo'lgan
              bir necha narsa bor. Birinchidan,
              doim menga yaqin turishingiz
              KERAK.
  1-o'quvchi: Fotoapparatlarimizni olib
              kelsak BO'LADIMI?
  O'qituvchi: Yo'q, BO'LMAYDI! Suratga
              olMASLIGINGIZ kerak.
  2-o'quvchi: Tushligimizni olib kelsak
              BO'LADIMI?
  O'qituvchi: Yo'q, BO'LMAYDI! Muzeyda ovqat
              yeMASLIGINGIZ kerak.
  3-o'quvchi: Qayerda ovqat yeya olamiz?
  O'qituvchi: Muzey yonidagi restoranda ovqat
              yeyishingiz MUMKIN.


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'First you ... always STAY CLOSE to me.'
    Bu — QAT'IY qoida → MUST.
    (Grammar 62-bet, hayvonot bog'i dialogining
     oxirgi gapi ham shu edi:
     'Everyone MUST stay close to me.')

 2  '... we BRING our cameras?'
    O'quvchi RUXSAT so'rayapti → CAN.

 3  'No, you ...!'
    QISQA JAVOB savoldagi modalni takrorlaydi:
    'CAN we?' → 'you CAN'T'.

 4  'You ... TAKE ANY PICTURES.'
    Bu — muzeyning TAQIQI → MUSTN'T.
    (Workbook 57-bet, F belgisi:
     'Don't take pictures.')

 5  '... we BRING our lunch?'
    Yana RUXSAT savoli → CAN.

 6  'No, you ...!'
    Yana qisqa javob → CAN'T.

 7  'You ... EAT IN THE MUSEUM.'
    Muzeyda ovqat yeyish TAQIQLANGAN → MUSTN'T.

 8  'WHERE ... we eat?'
    'Where' bilan savol — IMKONIYAT so'ralyapti
    → CAN.

 9  'You ... EAT IN THE RESTAURANT.'
    O'qituvchi RUXSAT beryapti → CAN.


NAQSh — DIALOGNING TUZILIShI:

  O'QUVChI so'raydi  →  DOIM 'CAN'
                        (2, 5, 8)
  O'QITUVChI:
     qoida aytadi    →  MUST    (1)
     rad etadi       →  CAN'T   (3, 6)
     taqiqlaydi      →  MUSTN'T (4, 7)
     ruxsat beradi   →  CAN     (9)


DIQQAT — 'CAN'T' va 'MUSTN'T' YONMA-YON:
  'No, you CAN'T! You MUSTN'T take any
   pictures.'

  Nega ikkalasi?
     'CAN'T'   — SAVOLGA javob (qisqa javob
                 savoldagi modalni takrorlaydi)
     'MUSTN'T' — TAQIQNI kuchaytirish
                 (muzey qoidasi)

  Coursebook 102-bet, 16e-dialogda ham
  shunday edi:
  'No, you can't. You mustn't park here —
   it's illegal.'


DIQQAT — 'ANY' INKORDA:
  'You mustn't take ANY pictures.'
  = hech qanday surat olmang

  INKOR gapda 'some' emas, 'ANY':
     'I don't have ANY money.'  ✓
     'I don't have SOME money.' ✗


DIQQAT — 'WHICH IS NEXT TO':
  'the restaurant WHICH IS NEXT TO the museum'
  = muzey YONIDAGI restoran

  'which' — narsalar uchun ergash gap
  bog'lovchisi ('who' — odamlar uchun).
  'next to' = yonida.


GRAMMAR 62-BET BILAN SOLIShTIRING:

  HAYVONOT BOG'I (Grammar 62)  MUZEY (WB 58)
  ──────────────────────────   ─────────────
  must follow rules            must stay close
  mustn't feed the animals     mustn't take
                               pictures
  Can we touch? — No, you      Can we bring
  can't                        cameras? — No,
                               you can't
  Can we take pictures? —      Can we bring
  Yes, you can                 lunch? — No
  must stay close to me        can eat in the
                               restaurant

  Ikkala dialog ham bir xil qolipda tuzilgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a museum      = muzey
  a camera      = fotoapparat
  lunch         = tushlik
  a restaurant  = restoran
  next to       = yonida
  which         = qaysiki (narsalar uchun)

tasks.prompt: 1  Teacher: First you ........................... always stay close to me.
tasks.promptUz: Birinchidan, doim menga yaqin turishingiz kerak.
tasks.whyUz:
Bu — o'qituvchining QAT'IY qoidasi → MUST.

Grammar 62-bet, hayvonot bog'i dialogi ham
shu gap bilan tugagan:
'Everyone MUST stay close to me.'

DIQQAT: 'MUST ALWAYS stay' — ravish modal
bilan asosiy fe'l ORASIDA.
tasks.speak: 1  Teacher: First you ........................... always stay close to me.

tasks.whyUz:
O'quvchi RUXSAT so'rayapti → CAN ...?

'Must we bring our cameras?' =
'olib kelishimiz SHARTMI?' — ma'nosiz.

Dialogda o'quvchilar UCH marta savol beradi
(2, 5, 8) va uchalasi ham 'CAN'.

QISQA JAVOB savoldagi modalni TAKRORLAYDI:
  'CAN we bring?' → 'No, you CAN'T.'

'No, you mustn't' — grammatik jihatdan
mumkin, lekin qisqa javob qoidasiga ko'ra
'can't' to'g'ri.

tasks.prompt: 4  You ..................... take any pictures.
tasks.whyUz:
Bu — MUZEYNING TAQIQI → MUSTN'T.

Oldingi 'can't' savolga javob edi; bu esa
TAQIQNI kuchaytiradi.
(CB 102-bet, 16e: 'No, you can't. You MUSTN'T
park here.' — bir xil naqsh.)

Workbook 57-bet, F belgisi:
'Don't take pictures.'

'ANY' — inkor gapda ('some' emas).
tasks.speak: 4  You ..................... take any pictures.

tasks.prompt: 5  S2: ................... we bring our lunch with us?
tasks.whyUz:
Yana RUXSAT savoli → CAN.
2-band bilan bir xil.
tasks.speak: 5  S2: ................... we bring our lunch with us?

tasks.whyUz:
QISQA JAVOB savoldagi modalni takrorlaydi:
'CAN we bring?' → 'No, you CAN'T.'
3-band bilan bir xil.

tasks.prompt: 7  You ....................... eat in the museum.
tasks.whyUz:
Muzeyda ovqat yeyish TAQIQLANGAN → MUSTN'T
(eksponatlarga zarar yetishi mumkin).

4-band bilan bir xil naqsh:
'No, you CAN'T! You MUSTN'T ...'
tasks.speak: 7  You ....................... eat in the museum.

tasks.whyUz:
'WHERE' bilan savol — IMKONIYAT so'ralyapti
→ CAN.

'Where MUST we eat?' = 'qayerda yeyishimiz
SHART?' — g'alati.

Savol so'zi + modal + ega + fe'l:
'Where CAN we eat?'

tasks.prompt: 9  Teacher: You ........................ eat in the restaurant which is next to the museum.
tasks.promptUz: Muzey yonidagi restoranda ovqat yeyishingiz mumkin.
tasks.whyUz:
O'qituvchi RUXSAT beryapti → CAN.

Savol 'Where CAN we eat?' edi, javob ham
'CAN' bilan.

'WHICH IS NEXT TO the museum' — ergash gap
('which' narsalar uchun; 'next to' = yonida).

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct modal verbs.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri modal fe'llarning tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  SHOULD
  2  CAN
  3  SHOULD
  4  CAN'T
  5  MUSTN'T


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 1  'You SHOULD always wear a seatbelt.'
    Xavfsizlik kamari — IJOBIY, foydali
    maslahat.
    'shouldn't wear a seatbelt' = xavfli
    maslahat bo'lardi.
    → SHOULD

 2  'CAN I have a glass of water, please?'
    KALIT: 'PLEASE' — bu ILTIMOS.
    'Should I have ...?' = 'ichishim kerakmi?'
    — boshqa ma'no.
    → CAN
    (Grammar 61 va 63-betlarda ham shu gap
     bor edi — kitob uch marta takrorlagan!)

 3  'Harvey SHOULD take singing lessons because
     he has a fantastic voice.'
    KALIT: 'because he has a FANTASTIC VOICE'
    — sabab IJOBIY, demak maslahat ham ijobiy.
    'can't take lessons' bo'lsa sabab bilan
    mos kelmaydi.
    → SHOULD

 4  'You CAN'T go to the cinema tonight, because
     you have to do your homework.'
    KALIT: 'because you HAVE TO DO your
    homework' — uy vazifasi bor, demak
    kinoga BORA OLMAYDI.
    → CAN'T

 5  'You MUSTN'T play music after eleven
     o'clock at night.'
    Kechasi soat 11 dan keyin musiqa qo'yish —
    qo'shnilarga xalaqit, ko'p joyda
    QONUNAN taqiqlangan.
    'should play music after eleven' = teskari
    maslahat.
    → MUSTN'T


ENG MUHIM KALIT — SABAB GAPI:

  3 va 4-bandlarda javob 'BECAUSE' dan
  keyingi qismda:
     3  'because he has a FANTASTIC voice'
        → ijobiy → SHOULD
     4  'because you HAVE TO do your homework'
        → to'sqinlik → CAN'T


MODALLAR FARQI — QISQA ESLATMA:
  SHOULD   — maslahat (yumshoq)   (1, 3)
  CAN      — ruxsat so'rash        (2)
  CAN'T    — imkoni yo'q / ruxsat yo'q (4)
  MUSTN'T  — qat'iy taqiq          (5)


DIQQAT — 1-BANDDAGI 'ALWAYS':
  'You should ALWAYS wear a seatbelt.'
  Ravish MODAL bilan ASOSIY FE'L ORASIDA:
     should ALWAYS wear  ✓
     ALWAYS should wear  ✗


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDAGI 'HAVE TO':
  'you HAVE TO do your homework'
  'have to' = shart (must bilan bir xil ma'no)

  Bu gapda IKKI modal bor:
     'can't go' — imkoni yo'q
     'have to do' — majburiyat


DIQQAT — 5-BANDDAGI 'AFTER ELEVEN O'CLOCK':
  'after eleven o'clock AT NIGHT'
  = kechasi soat 11 dan keyin

  'at night' = kechasi (predlog 'at').


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a seatbelt      = xavfsizlik kamari
  singing lessons = qo'shiq darslari
  fantastic       = ajoyib
  a voice         = ovoz
  to have to      = shart bo'lmoq
  at night        = kechasi

tasks.prompt: 1  You shouldn't/should always wear a seatbelt.
tasks.whyUz:
Xavfsizlik kamari — hayot saqlaydi, IJOBIY
maslahat → SHOULD.

'shouldn't wear a seatbelt' = xavfli maslahat
bo'lardi.

DIQQAT — 'ALWAYS' QAYERDA:
'should ALWAYS wear' ✓
(ravish modal bilan asosiy fe'l ORASIDA).

tasks.prompt: 2  Should/Can I have a glass of water, please?
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'PLEASE' — bu ILTIMOS, ruxsat so'rash
→ CAN.

'Should I have a glass of water?' =
'suv ichishim KERAKMI?' — maslahat so'rash,
boshqa ma'no.

DIQQAT: bu gap Grammar 61 va 63-betlarda ham
bor edi — kitob UCH marta takrorlagan.

tasks.prompt: 3  Harvey can't/should take singing lessons because he has a fantastic voice.
tasks.promptUz: Xarvi qo'shiq darslariga borishi kerak, chunki uning ovozi ajoyib.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT — SABAB GAPI:
'because he has a FANTASTIC VOICE'
Sabab IJOBIY, demak maslahat ham ijobiy
→ SHOULD.

'can't take lessons' bo'lsa sabab bilan mos
kelmaydi (ajoyib ovoz — dars olishga TO'SIQ
emas, aksincha SABAB).

DIQQAT: ega 'HARVEY' (III shaxs birlik)
bo'lsa ham 'should' o'zgarmaydi.

tasks.prompt: 4  You can/can't go to the cinema tonight, because you have to do your homework.
tasks.promptUz: Bugun kechqurun kinoga bora olmaysiz, chunki uy vazifangizni bajarishingiz kerak.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT — SABAB GAPI:
'because you HAVE TO DO your homework'
Uy vazifasi TO'SQINLIK qilyapti → CAN'T.

'can go' bo'lsa sabab bilan ZID bo'lardi.

Grammar 62-bet, 7-mashqning 4-bandi ham
aynan shunday edi:
'I CAN'T go to the cinema. I must study for
a test.'

'have to' = shart (must bilan bir xil).

tasks.prompt: 5  You mustn't/should play music after eleven o'clock at night.
tasks.promptUz: Kechasi soat 11 dan keyin musiqa qo'ymasligingiz kerak.
tasks.whyUz:
Kechasi baland musiqa — qo'shnilarga xalaqit;
ko'p joyda QONUNAN taqiqlangan → MUSTN'T.

'should play music after eleven' = 'kechasi
musiqa qo'yishingiz kerak' — teskari maslahat.

Coursebook 101-bet, 11-mashq jadvali:
'play loud music' → CAN'T.

'AT night' = kechasi (predlog 'at').

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct modal verbs. (continued: 6-10)
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri modal fe'llarning tagiga chizing. (davomi: 6-10)
exercises.explanationUz:
13-MAShQNING OXIRGI BESh BANDI
(58-betdan davom etadi)


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   6  SHOULD
   7  CAN
   8  SHOULDN'T
   9  MUSTN'T
  10  SHOULDN'T


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 6  'Andy SHOULD take the bus instead of the
     car TO SAVE MONEY.'
    KALIT: 'TO SAVE MONEY' — maqsad IJOBIY,
    demak maslahat ham ijobiy.
    'can't take the bus' bo'lsa maqsad bilan
    mos kelmaydi.
    → SHOULD

 7  'It's cold! CAN you close the window,
     please?'
    KALIT: 'PLEASE' — bu ILTIMOS.
    'Must you close the window?' = 'derazani
    yopishingiz SHARTMI?' — g'alati.
    → CAN

 8  'You SHOULDN'T leave the electricity on
     when you go on holiday.'
    Ta'tilga ketganda chiroqni yoqib qoldirish
    — ISROF, lekin QONUNIY taqiq emas.
    Demak MASLAHAT → SHOULDN'T.
    ('can't leave' = 'qoldira olmaysiz' —
     jismonan mumkin, demak mos emas.)
    → SHOULDN'T

 9  'You MUSTN'T drink and drive.'
    Ichib mashina haydash — KO'P MAMLAKATDA
    QONUNAN TAQIQLANGAN → MUSTN'T.
    'can drink and drive' = 'ichib haydashingiz
    mumkin' — juda xavfli maslahat.
    → MUSTN'T

10  'You SHOULDN'T forget to lock your door
     before you leave the house.'
    Bu — MASLAHAT (eslatma) → SHOULDN'T.
    'can't forget' = 'unuta olmaysiz' —
    ma'nosiz (unutish har kimning qo'lidan
    keladi).
    → SHOULDN'T


ENG NOZIK FARQ — 8, 9, 10:

  Uchalasi ham 'nima qilmaslik kerak'
  haqida, lekin:

   8  SHOULDN'T — MASLAHAT (isrofgarchilik)
   9  MUSTN'T   — QONUNIY TAQIQ (ichib haydash)
  10  SHOULDN'T — MASLAHAT (eslatma)

  Grammar 60-bet ta'rifi:
  'mustn't means it is FORBIDDEN ...
   it is AGAINST THE RULE'

  Faqat 9-band qonunga tegishli.


DIQQAT — 'CAN'T' NIMA UChUN MOS EMAS:
  'can't' = imkoni yo'q / ruxsat yo'q.

   8  'You CAN'T leave the electricity on'
      = chiroqni yoqib qoldira OLMAYSIZ
      (lekin jismonan qoldirish mumkin)
  10  'You CAN'T forget to lock your door'
      = eshikni qulflashni unuta OLMAYSIZ
      (lekin unutish mumkin)

  Ikkalasi ham mantiqan noto'g'ri.


DIQQAT — 'INSTEAD OF':
  'take the bus INSTEAD OF the car'
  = mashina O'RNIGA avtobus

  'instead OF + OT/-ING'
  'instead' (yolg'iz) = o'rniga
  (Coursebook 100-bet: 'special slippers to
   wear INSTEAD')


DIQQAT — 'DRINK AND DRIVE':
  'to drink and drive' = ichib mashina
  haydamoq (turg'un ibora).

  'Don't drink and drive' — dunyo bo'ylab
  mashhur xavfsizlik shiori.


DIQQAT — 'LEAVE THE ELECTRICITY ON':
  'leave ... ON' = yoqib qoldirmoq
  Teskarisi: 'turn ... OFF' = o'chirmoq

  Coursebook 98-bet, 1-mashqdagi qo'shimcha
  g'oyalardan: 'Turn off the lights when you
  leave a room.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  instead of      = ... o'rniga
  to save money   = pul tejamoq
  to close        = yopmoq
  electricity     = elektr
  to leave ... on = yoqib qoldirmoq
  to drink and drive = ichib haydamoq
  to lock         = qulflamoq

tasks.prompt: 6  Andy can't/should take the bus instead of the car to save money.
tasks.promptUz: Endi pul tejash uchun mashina o'rniga avtobusda yurishi kerak.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT — MAQSAD GAPI:
'TO SAVE MONEY' (pul tejash uchun) — maqsad
IJOBIY, demak maslahat ham ijobiy → SHOULD.

'can't take the bus' = 'avtobusda yura
olmaydi' — maqsad bilan mos kelmaydi.

'INSTEAD OF the car' = mashina o'rniga.
Coursebook 98-bet: 'Use buses and trams —
not cars.'

tasks.prompt: 7  It's cold! Must/Can you close the window, please?
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'PLEASE' — bu ILTIMOS.

'CAN you ...?' — birovdan iltimos qilish
shakli.
'MUST you close the window?' = 'derazani
yopishingiz SHARTMI?' — g'alati savol.

Odobliroq shakl: 'COULD you close the
window, please?'

tasks.prompt: 8  You shouldn't/can't leave the electricity on when you go on holiday.
tasks.promptUz: Ta'tilga ketganingizda elektrni yoqib qoldirmasligingiz kerak.
tasks.whyUz:
Bu — MASLAHAT (isrofgarchilikning oldini olish),
QONUNIY taqiq EMAS → SHOULDN'T.

'can't leave' = 'qoldira olmaysiz' — lekin
jismonan qoldirish mumkin, demak mantiqan
noto'g'ri.

'to leave ... ON' = yoqib qoldirmoq
(teskarisi: 'turn ... OFF' = o'chirmoq).

tasks.prompt: 9  You mustn't/can drink and drive.
tasks.whyUz:
Ichib mashina haydash — KO'P MAMLAKATDA
QONUNAN TAQIQLANGAN → MUSTN'T.

Grammar 60-bet: 'mustn't means it is
FORBIDDEN ... against the rule'.

'can drink and drive' = 'ichib haydashingiz
mumkin' — juda xavfli va noto'g'ri.

'Don't drink and drive' — dunyo bo'ylab
mashhur xavfsizlik shiori.

DIQQAT: 8 va 10-bandlar 'shouldn't' (maslahat),
bu esa 'mustn't' (qonun) — farqi shu.

tasks.prompt: 10  You can't/shouldn't forget to lock your door before you leave the house.
tasks.promptUz: Uydan chiqishdan oldin eshikni qulflashni unutmasligingiz kerak.
tasks.whyUz:
Bu — MASLAHAT (eslatma) → SHOULDN'T.

'can't forget' = 'unuta OLMAYSIZ' — ma'nosiz,
chunki unutish har kimning qo'lidan keladi.

'shouldn't FORGET to ...' = unutmasligingiz
kerak (= 'should REMEMBER to ...').

'before you LEAVE' — 'before' dan keyin
to'liq gap ham kelishi mumkin.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and tick. Listen again and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va ✓ qo'ying. Yana tinglang va takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL IKKI USTUNLI:
  /r/ PRONOUNCED  (o'qiladi)
  /r/ SILENT      (jim)

TO'RT SO'Z: turn, care, hurry, various


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  turn     →  /r/ SILENT      (jim)
  care     →  /r/ SILENT      (jim)
  hurry    →  /r/ PRONOUNCED  (o'qiladi)
  various  →  /r/ PRONOUNCED  (o'qiladi)


QOIDA — BRITANCHA INGLIZChADA:

  /r/ FAQAT UNLIDAN OLDIN o'qiladi.

  Agar 'r' dan keyin:
     UNLI kelsa       →  O'QILADI
     UNDOSh kelsa     →  JIM
     hech narsa kelmasa (so'z oxiri) → JIM


HAR BIRI NEGA:

  TURN   →  t-u-R-N
            'r' dan keyin 'n' (UNDOSh)
            →  JIM
            O'qilishi: /tɜːn/ — 'to'n'

  CARE   →  c-a-R-e
            'r' SO'Z OXIRIDA ('e' jim)
            →  JIM
            O'qilishi: /keə/ — 'kea'

  HURRY  →  h-u-RR-Y
            'r' dan keyin 'y' (UNLI tovush /i/)
            →  O'QILADI
            O'qilishi: /ˈhʌri/ — 'hari'

  VARIOUS → v-a-R-I-ous
            'r' dan keyin 'i' (UNLI)
            →  O'QILADI
            O'qilishi: /ˈveəriəs/ — 'vearias'

            DIQQAT: bu so'zda IKKI 'r' emas,
            bitta 'r' bor va u unlidan oldin.


DEMAK AUDIO ShART EMAS:
  Qoida to'rtala so'zni ham ANIQ belgilaydi.


DIQQAT — BRITANCHA va AMERIKACHA FARQI:

  Bu qoida FAQAT britancha inglizchada
  ishlaydi. Amerikachada 'r' DOIM o'qiladi:

     SO'Z     BRITANCHA    AMERIKACHA
     turn     /tɜːn/       /tɜːrn/
     care     /keə/        /ker/
     car      /kɑː/        /kɑːr/
     teacher  /ˈtiːtʃə/    /ˈtiːtʃər/

  Enterprise — BRITANCHA kitob, shuning uchun
  britancha qoida ishlatiladi.


QO'ShIMChA MISOLLAR (qoidani mustahkamlash
uchun):

  /r/ JIM (undoshdan oldin yoki so'z oxirida):
     car, far, star, door, four, more
     park, work, first, girl, world
     teacher, mother, father, water
     hard, card, part, short

  /r/ O'QILADI (unlidan oldin):
     red, run, read, rain, room
     very, sorry, marry, carry, borrow
     around, arrive, correct, agree
     Africa, America, orange


QIZIQ HODISA — 'LINKING R':
  So'z oxiridagi jim 'r' KEYINGI so'z unli
  bilan boshlansa, QAYTA JONLANADI:

     'car' — /kɑː/          (r jim)
     'a car is here' — /kɑːr ɪz/  (r o'qiladi!)

     'far' — /fɑː/
     'far away' — /fɑːr əweɪ/  (r o'qiladi!)

  Chunki keyingi so'z UNLI bilan boshlanadi —
  qoida buzilmaydi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to turn      = burilmoq, aylantirmoq
  to care      = g'amxo'rlik qilmoq
  care         = g'amxo'rlik
  to hurry     = shoshilmoq
  various      = turli xil
  pronounced   = talaffuz qilinadigan
  silent       = jim (o'qilmaydigan)

tasks.prompt: turn
tasks.whyUz:
t-u-R-N: 'r' dan keyin 'N' — UNDOSH.
Britancha qoida: /r/ faqat UNLIDAN oldin
o'qiladi → bu yerda JIM.

O'qilishi: /tɜːn/ ('to'n')

Shu kabi: work, first, girl, park, short.

tasks.prompt: care
tasks.whyUz:
c-a-R-e: oxiridagi 'e' JIM, demak 'r' amalda
SO'Z OXIRIDA turibdi — undan keyin hech qanday
unli yo'q → JIM.

O'qilishi: /keə/ ('kea')

Shu kabi: car, far, door, more, teacher.

DIQQAT: 'I care about it' desangiz ham 'r' jim,
lekin 'care about' da keyingi so'z unli bilan
boshlangani uchun 'linking r' paydo bo'ladi.

tasks.prompt: hurry
tasks.whyUz:
h-u-RR-Y: 'r' dan keyin 'Y' keladi va u bu
yerda UNLI tovush (/i/) beradi → O'QILADI.

O'qilishi: /ˈhʌri/ ('hari')

Shu kabi: very, sorry, marry, carry, borrow.

tasks.prompt: various
tasks.whyUz:
v-a-R-i-ous: 'r' dan keyin 'I' keladi — UNLI
→ O'QILADI.

O'qilishi: /ˈveəriəs/ ('vearias')

Shu kabi: around, arrive, correct, America.

exercises.instructionEn: Cover the leaflet, then look at the pictures on p. 98 and try to remember the dos and don'ts with their reasons, as they appeared in the leaflet.
exercises.instructionUz: Varaqani yoping, so'ngra 98-betdagi rasmlarga qarang va varaqadagidek qilinadigan/qilinmaydigan ishlarni sabablari bilan eslashga harakat qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
VAZIFA: varaqani berkitib, faqat RASMLARGA
qarab butun matnni eslash.


RASM → KO'RSATMA + SABAB (to'liq javoblar):

  A (o'rmon)
     Never light fires in forests,
     because trees will burn.

  B (axlat qutisi va axlat)
     Do not drop rubbish in the street,
     because it looks and smells horrible.
     Use rubbish bins.
     Also: do not throw plastic bottles into the
     sea, because fish will die.

  C (o'ralgan go'sht)
     Try not to buy pre-packaged food,
     because the packaging creates a lot of
     rubbish.

  D (qayta ishlash qutisi)
     Put aluminium cans into recycling bins,
     because factories can use them to make new
     things.

  E (tramvay)
     Use public transport,
     because cars pollute the air.

  F (idish yuvish suyuqligi)
     Use less washing-up liquid,
     because it pollutes the seas and rivers.

  G (alyuminiy banka)
     Put aluminium cans into recycling bins,
     because factories can use them to make new
     things.

  H (aerozol)
     Do not use aerosols,
     because they pollute the air.


QOLIP:
  [BUYRUQ], because [SABAB].

  Yoki ikki alohida gap:
  [BUYRUQ]. [SABAB].


MAShQ USULI (uyda yolg'iz o'rganish uchun):
  1  98-betni oching, varaqani yoping.
  2  Har bir rasmga qarab BUYRUQNI ayting.
  3  So'ngra 'Why?' deb o'zingizdan so'rang
     va SABABNI ayting.
  4  Xato qilsangiz — 99-betdan tekshiring.

  Shunday qilib 8 ta ko'rsatma va 8 ta sabab
  yodda qoladi.

tasks.en: Cover the leaflet, then look at the pictures on p. 98 and try to remember the dos and don'ts with their reasons, as they appeared in the leaflet.
tasks.uz: Varaqani yoping, so'ngra 98-betdagi rasmlarga qarang va varaqadagidek qilinadigan/qilinmaydigan ishlarni sabablari bilan eslashga harakat qiling.

tasks.en: A — Never light fires in forests, because trees will burn.
tasks.uz: A — O'rmonlarda hech qachon olov yoqmang, chunki daraxtlar yonib ketadi.

tasks.en: B — Do not drop rubbish in the street, because it looks and smells horrible. Use rubbish bins.
tasks.uz: B — Ko'chaga axlat tashlamang, chunki u dahshatli ko'rinadi va hidlaydi. Axlat qutilaridan foydalaning.
tasks.note:
B rasmi plastik shishalarni ham ko'rsatadi:
'Do not throw plastic bottles into the sea,
because fish will die.'

tasks.en: C — Try not to buy pre-packaged food, because the packaging creates a lot of rubbish.
tasks.uz: C — O'ralgan ovqat sotib olmaslikka harakat qiling, chunki o'ram ko'p axlat hosil qiladi.

tasks.en: D — Put aluminium cans into recycling bins, because factories can use them to make new things.
tasks.uz: D — Alyuminiy bankalarni qayta ishlash qutisiga soling, chunki zavodlar ulardan yangi narsalar yasashi mumkin.
tasks.note: G rasmi ham shu ko'rsatmaga tegishli.

tasks.en: E — Use public transport, because cars pollute the air.
tasks.uz: E — Jamoat transportidan foydalaning, chunki mashinalar havoni ifloslantiradi.

tasks.en: F — Use less washing-up liquid, because it pollutes the seas and rivers.
tasks.uz: F — Idish yuvish suyuqligidan kamroq foydalaning, chunki u dengiz va daryolarni ifloslantiradi.

tasks.en: G — Put aluminium cans into recycling bins, because factories can use them to make new things.
tasks.uz: G — Alyuminiy bankalarni qayta ishlash qutisiga soling, chunki zavodlar ulardan yangi narsalar yasashi mumkin.
tasks.note: D rasmi bilan bir xil ko'rsatma.

tasks.en: H — Do not use aerosols, because they pollute the air.
tasks.uz: H — Aerozollardan foydalanmang, chunki ular havoni ifloslantiradi.

exercises.instructionEn: What advice can you give to visitors to England, China and Japan? Give at least three pieces of advice for each country.
exercises.instructionUz: Angliya, Xitoy va Yaponiyaga boruvchilarga qanday maslahat bera olasiz? Har bir mamlakat uchun kamida uchta maslahat bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'When in England, you SHOULD say "please" and
   "thank you".'

  QOLIP:
     When in [mamlakat], you should / shouldn't
     + [ASOSIY fe'l] + ...


ANGLIYA — BESH MASLAHAT:

  1  When in England, you SHOULD always say
     'please' and 'thank you'.
  2  You SHOULDN'T push into a queue of people,
     because they'll get angry.
  3  You SHOULDN'T be late for appointments.
  4  You SHOULDN'T talk with your mouth full.
  5  You SHOULD always ask before smoking in
     someone's house.


XITOY — BESH MASLAHAT:

  1  When in China, you SHOULDN'T kiss anyone in
     public, because it's very rude.
  2  You SHOULDN'T be late for appointments.
  3  You SHOULDN'T tell jokes to people you
     don't know very well.
  4  You SHOULDN'T leave your chopsticks
     pointing upwards in your rice.
  5  You SHOULD give a present with both hands.


YAPONIYA — BESH MASLAHAT:

  1  When in Japan, you SHOULD take a gift when
     you visit someone.
  2  You SHOULD take your shoes off as you enter
     the house.
  3  You SHOULD make sure the toes of your shoes
     are pointing towards the door.
  4  You SHOULDN'T sit anywhere you like — you
     should wait until someone shows you where
     to sit.
  5  You SHOULDN'T blow your nose in public.


BOShQA ShAKLLAR BILAN (99-betdan):

  WHY DON'T YOU ...?
     'Why don't you take a gift with you?'

  I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO ...
     'I think it's a good idea to say "please"
      and "thank you".'

  I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO ...
     'I don't think it's a good idea to kiss
      anyone in public in China.'

  BUYRUQ (matnlardagidek):
     'Always say "please" and "thank you".'
     'Never push into a queue.'


DIQQAT — 'ADVICE' SANALMAYDIGAN:
  Kitob ataylab 'three PIECES OF advice'
  deydi, 'three advices' emas!

     'an advice'      ✗
     'three advices'  ✗
     'a piece of advice'     ✓
     'three pieces of advice' ✓
     'some advice'    ✓

  Xuddi shunday sanalmaydigan otlar:
     information — a piece of information
     news        — a piece of news
     furniture   — a piece of furniture
     bread       — a piece of bread


DIQQAT — 'WHEN IN ENGLAND':
  Bu — qisqartma:
     'when (you are) in England'

  Ergash gapda ega 'you' va 'to be' fe'li
  tushirib qoldirilgan. Rasmiy va ixcham
  shakl.

  Xitoy matni ham shunday boshlanadi:
  'WHEN IN CHINA, don't kiss anyone ...'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  advice          = maslahat (SANALMAYDIGAN)
  a piece of advice = bitta maslahat
  a visitor       = mehmon, tashrif buyuruvchi
  at least        = kamida

tasks.en: What advice can you give to visitors to England, China and Japan? Give at least three pieces of advice for each country.
tasks.uz: Angliya, Xitoy va Yaponiyaga boruvchilarga qanday maslahat bera olasiz? Har bir mamlakat uchun kamida uchta maslahat bering.

tasks.en: When in England, you should say 'please' and 'thank you'.
tasks.uz: Angliyada 'iltimos' va 'rahmat' deyishingiz kerak.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
'when in England' = 'when you are in England'.

tasks.en: When in England, you shouldn't push into a queue of people, because they'll get angry.
tasks.uz: Angliyada odamlar navbatiga suqilib kirmasligingiz kerak, chunki ularning jahli chiqadi.
tasks.note: ANGLIYA — 2-maslahat.

tasks.en: When in England, you shouldn't be late for appointments or talk with your mouth full.
tasks.uz: Angliyada uchrashuvlarga kechikmasligingiz va og'zingiz to'la turib gapirmasligingiz kerak.
tasks.note: ANGLIYA — 3 va 4-maslahat birga.

tasks.en: When in England, you should always ask before smoking in someone's house.
tasks.uz: Angliyada birovning uyida chekishdan oldin doim ruxsat so'rashingiz kerak.
tasks.note: ANGLIYA — 5-maslahat.

tasks.en: When in China, you shouldn't kiss anyone in public, because it's very rude.
tasks.uz: Xitoyda odamlar oldida hech kimni o'pmasligingiz kerak, chunki bu juda qo'pol.
tasks.note: XITOY — 1-maslahat.

tasks.en: When in China, you shouldn't tell jokes to people you don't know very well.
tasks.uz: Xitoyda yaxshi tanimaydigan odamlarga hazil aytmasligingiz kerak.
tasks.note: XITOY — 3-maslahat.

tasks.en: When in China, you shouldn't leave your chopsticks pointing upwards in your rice, and you should give a present with both hands.
tasks.uz: Xitoyda tayoqchalarni guruchga tik qoldirmasligingiz kerak va sovg'ani ikki qo'llab berishingiz kerak.
tasks.note:
XITOY — 4 va 5-maslahat birga.
Ikki qo'llab berish matnda bor, lekin 12 bandga
kirmagan.

tasks.en: When in Japan, you should take a gift when you visit someone.
tasks.uz: Yaponiyada birovnikiga borganingizda sovg'a olib borishingiz kerak.
tasks.note: YAPONIYA — 1-maslahat.

tasks.en: When in Japan, you should take your shoes off as you enter the house and make sure the toes are pointing towards the door.
tasks.uz: Yaponiyada uyga kirayotganda oyoq kiyimingizni yechishingiz va uchlari eshikka qaraganiga ishonch hosil qilishingiz kerak.
tasks.note: YAPONIYA — 2 va 3-maslahat birga.

tasks.en: When in Japan, you shouldn't sit anywhere you like — you should wait until someone shows you where to sit.
tasks.uz: Yaponiyada xohlagan joyingizga o'tirmasligingiz kerak — kimdir qayerga o'tirishni ko'rsatgunicha kutishingiz kerak.
tasks.note:
YAPONIYA — 4-maslahat.
Matnda bor, lekin 12 bandga kirmagan.

tasks.en: When in Japan, you shouldn't blow your nose in public.
tasks.uz: Yaponiyada odamlar oldida burningizni qoqmasligingiz kerak.
tasks.note: YAPONIYA — 5-maslahat.

tasks.en: Give at least three pieces of advice for each country.
tasks.uz: Har bir mamlakat uchun kamida uchta maslahat bering.
tasks.note:
DIQQAT: 'three PIECES OF advice'.
'advice' SANALMAYDIGAN — 'three advices' XATO.

exercises.instructionEn: Work in pairs. Use the prompts in Ex. 11 and act out short dialogues, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda ishlang. 11-mashqdagi ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib, namunalardagidek qisqa dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI UCh NAMUNA DIALOG:

  1  SA: Do I HAVE TO make the bed?
     SB: Yes, you do. You MUST make the bed.

  2  SA: CAN I play loud music?
     SB: No, you CAN'T.

  3  SA: CAN I use the telephone?
     SB: Yes, of course you CAN.


TARJIMASI:
  1  SA: To'shakni yig'ishtirishim shartmi?
     SB: Ha, shart. To'shakni yig'ishtirishingiz
         kerak.
  2  SA: Baland musiqa qo'ysam bo'ladimi?
     SB: Yo'q, bo'lmaydi.
  3  SA: Telefondan foydalansam bo'ladimi?
     SB: Ha, albatta bo'ladi.


IKKI XIL SAVOL — QAY BIRINI QAChON:

  MAJBURIYAT haqida so'raganda:
     'DO I HAVE TO + fe'l?'
     → Javobi: 'Yes, you do. You MUST ...'
              yoki 'No, you don't.'

  RUXSAT so'raganda:
     'CAN I + fe'l?'
     → Javobi: 'Yes, you can.' /
              'Yes, of course you can.' /
              'No, you can't.'


DIQQAT — NEGA 'DO I HAVE TO', 'MUST I' EMAS:
  'Must I make the bed?' — grammatik jihatdan
  to'g'ri, lekin ZAMONAVIY inglizchada kam
  ishlatiladi.
  'Do I have to ...?' — ancha tabiiyroq.

  Lekin JAVOBDA 'must' ishlatiladi:
     'You MUST make the bed.'


DIQQAT — 'CAN I' va 'MAY I':
  'CAN I use the telephone?' — oddiy, og'zaki
  'MAY I use the telephone?' — RASMIY, odobli
  'COULD I use the telephone?' — juda odobli

  Kitob eng oddiy shaklni bergan.


TASDIQLANGAN 5 QATOR UChUN TO'LIQ DIALOGLAR:

 1  SA: Can I keep pets?
    SB: No, you can't.

 2  SA: Can I play loud music?
    SB: No, you can't.
         (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 3  SA: Can I use the telephone?
    SB: Yes, of course you can.
         (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 4  SA: Do I have to make the bed?
    SB: Yes, you do. You must make the bed.
         (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 5  SA: Do I have to keep the room clean?
    SB: Yes, you do. You must keep the room
        clean.


QOLGAN 5 QATOR UChUN QOLIP
(audio tinglangandan keyin to'ldiriladi):

    SA: Can I have parties in the room?
    SB: ...

    SA: Can I have a TV in the room?
    SB: ...

    SA: Can I put posters on the walls?
    SB: ...

    SA: Do I have to pay the rent on time?
    SB: ...

    SA: Do I have to be home by 11 pm?
    SB: ...


QISQA JAVOBLAR JADVALI:

  SAVOL              IJOBIY JAVOB      SALBIY JAVOB
  ─────────────────  ────────────────  ─────────────
  Can I ...?         Yes, you can.     No, you can't.
                     Yes, of course
                     you can.
  Do I have to ...?  Yes, you do.      No, you don't.
                     You must ...


DIQQAT — QISQA JAVOBDA FE'L TAKRORLANMAYDI:
  'Can I play music?' — 'Yes, you can.'   ✓
  'Can I play music?' — 'Yes, you can play
                         music.'          (ortiqcha)

  Qisqa javobda faqat MODAL qoladi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Do I have to ...?  = ... qilishim shartmi?
  Can I ...?         = ... qilsam bo'ladimi?
  of course          = albatta
  a prompt           = tayanch so'z, ko'rsatma

tasks.en: Work in pairs. Use the prompts in Ex. 11 and act out short dialogues, as in the examples.
tasks.uz: Juftlikda ishlang. 11-mashqdagi ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib, namunalardagidek qisqa dialoglar tuzing.

tasks.en: SA: Do I have to make the bed?  SB: Yes, you do. You must make the bed.
tasks.uz: SA: To'shakni yig'ishtirishim shartmi?  SB: Ha, shart. To'shakni yig'ishtirishingiz kerak.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI 1-NAMUNA.
Savolda 'have to', javobda 'must'.
Bu 11-mashqning 'make the bed' qatorini
MUST deb tasdiqlaydi.

tasks.en: SA: Can I play loud music?  SB: No, you can't.
tasks.uz: SA: Baland musiqa qo'ysam bo'ladimi?  SB: Yo'q, bo'lmaydi.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI 2-NAMUNA.
11-mashqning 'play loud music' qatorini
CAN'T deb tasdiqlaydi.

tasks.en: SA: Can I use the telephone?  SB: Yes, of course you can.
tasks.uz: SA: Telefondan foydalansam bo'ladimi?  SB: Ha, albatta bo'ladi.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI 3-NAMUNA.
11-mashqning 'use the telephone' qatorini
CAN deb tasdiqlaydi.
'of course' — ruxsatni kuchaytiradi.

tasks.en: SA: Can I keep pets?  SB: No, you can't.
tasks.uz: SA: Uy hayvoni saqlasam bo'ladimi?  SB: Yo'q, bo'lmaydi.
tasks.note: 11-mashqning 1-qatori (kitobda ✓ qo'yilgan).

tasks.en: SA: Do I have to keep the room clean?  SB: Yes, you do. You must keep the room clean.
tasks.uz: SA: Xonani toza tutishim shartmi?  SB: Ha, shart. Xonani toza tutishingiz kerak.
tasks.note:
Grammatika qutisidan tasdiqlanadi:
'You must clean your room.'

tasks.en: SA: Can I have parties in the room? / Can I have a TV in the room? / Can I put posters on the walls? / Do I have to pay the rent on time? / Do I have to be home by 11 pm?
tasks.uz: SA: Xonada bazm o'tkazsam bo'ladimi? / Xonada televizor saqlasam bo'ladimi? / Devorlarga plakat ossam bo'ladimi? / Ijara haqini o'z vaqtida to'lashim shartmi? / Kechqurun 11 gacha uyda bo'lishim shartmi?
tasks.note:
Bu besh savolning JAVOBI audiodan aniqlanadi —
betda yozilmagan, taxmin qilinmadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the dialogues, then, in pairs, act out similar dialogues using the prompts from Ex. 9.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialoglarni tinglang, so'ngra juftlikda 9-mashqdagi ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI IKKI NAMUNA DIALOG:

  1-DIALOG:
     A:  Tony, WHAT'S THE MATTER?
     B:  I've got a terrible headache.
     A:  WHY DON'T YOU take an aspirin?

     Tarjimasi:
     A:  Toni, nima bo'ldi?
     B:  Boshim juda qattiq og'riyapti.
     A:  Aspirin ichsangiz-chi?

  2-DIALOG:
     A:  Bob, WHAT'S WRONG WITH YOU?
     B:  I feel very tired.
     A:  YOU SHOULD get some sleep.

     Tarjimasi:
     A:  Bob, sizga nima bo'ldi?
     B:  Juda charchadim.
     A:  Uxlab olishingiz kerak.


DIALOG QOLIPI:
  A:  [ism], what's the matter? /
      what's wrong with you?
  B:  I've got a/the [kasallik]. /
      I feel very [sifat].
  A:  Why don't you [maslahat]? /
      You should [maslahat].


DIQQAT — IKKI XIL SAVOL, BIR XIL MA'NO:
  'What's the matter?'      = Nima bo'ldi?
  'What's wrong with you?'  = Sizga nima bo'ldi?

  Ikkalasi ham kasal odamdan so'raladi.
  Yana: 'What's the matter WITH YOU?'


DIQQAT — IKKI XIL MASLAHAT ShAKLI:
  1-dialogda:  'WHY DON'T YOU take ...?'
               (savol shaklida — do'stona)
  2-dialogda:  'YOU SHOULD get ...'
               (to'g'ridan-to'g'ri)

  Kitob ataylab ikkalasini ko'rsatgan —
  99-betdagi 'Giving Advice' qutisidan.


OLTITA TO'LIQ DIALOG (9-mashqning barcha
bandlari uchun):

 1  A:  What's the matter?
    B:  I've got a terrible headache.
    A:  Why don't you take an aspirin?

 2  A:  What's wrong with you?
    B:  I've got a sore throat.
    A:  You should take some cough syrup.

 3  A:  What's the matter?
    B:  I feel very cold.
    A:  Why don't you put a jumper on?

 4  A:  What's wrong with you?
    B:  I've got the flu.
    A:  You should call the doctor and go to bed.

 5  A:  What's the matter?
    B:  I feel very tired.
    A:  Why don't you get some sleep?

 6  A:  What's wrong with you?
    B:  I've got toothache.
    A:  You should see the dentist.


DIQQAT — 'TERRIBLE':
  Namunada 'a TERRIBLE headache' deyilgan.
  'terrible' = dahshatli, juda qattiq —
  kasallikni kuchaytirish uchun.

  Yana: awful, bad, splitting (bosh og'rig'i
  uchun: 'a splitting headache').


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  What's the matter?     = Nima bo'ldi?
  What's wrong with you? = Sizga nima bo'ldi?
  terrible               = dahshatli, juda qattiq
  to act out             = sahnalashtirmoq
  a prompt               = ko'rsatma, tayanch so'z

tasks.en: Listen to the dialogues, then, in pairs, act out similar dialogues using the prompts from Ex. 9.
tasks.uz: Dialoglarni tinglang, so'ngra juftlikda 9-mashqdagi ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.

tasks.en: A: Tony, what's the matter?  B: I've got a terrible headache.  A: Why don't you take an aspirin?
tasks.uz: A: Toni, nima bo'ldi?  B: Boshim juda qattiq og'riyapti.  A: Aspirin ichsangiz-chi?
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI 1-NAMUNA.
'Why don't you ...?' — do'stona maslahat.

tasks.en: A: Bob, what's wrong with you?  B: I feel very tired.  A: You should get some sleep.
tasks.uz: A: Bob, sizga nima bo'ldi?  B: Juda charchadim.  A: Uxlab olishingiz kerak.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI 2-NAMUNA.
'You should ...' — to'g'ridan-to'g'ri maslahat.

tasks.en: A: What's wrong with you?  B: I've got a sore throat.  A: You should take some cough syrup.
tasks.uz: A: Sizga nima bo'ldi?  B: Tomog'im og'riyapti.  A: Yo'tal sharbatidan ichishingiz kerak.
tasks.note: 9-mashqning 2-bandi.

tasks.en: A: What's the matter?  B: I feel very cold.  A: Why don't you put a jumper on?
tasks.uz: A: Nima bo'ldi?  B: Juda sovqotdim.  A: Jemper kiysangiz-chi?
tasks.note:
9-mashqning 3-bandi.
'put ON' — ajraladigan fe'l.

tasks.en: A: What's wrong with you?  B: I've got the flu.  A: You should call the doctor and go to bed.
tasks.uz: A: Sizga nima bo'ldi?  B: Grippga chalindim.  A: Shifokorni chaqirib, yotishingiz kerak.
tasks.note:
9-mashqning 4-bandi.
'the flu' — 'the' bilan.

tasks.en: A: What's wrong with you?  B: I've got toothache.  A: You should see the dentist.
tasks.uz: A: Sizga nima bo'ldi?  B: Tishim og'riyapti.  A: Tish shifokoriga borishingiz kerak.
tasks.note:
9-mashqning 6-bandi.
'toothache' — artiklsiz (britancha).

exercises.instructionEn: Read the short dialogues and fill in must, mustn't, can, can't, should or shouldn't, then listen and check your answers. Finally, in pairs, act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Qisqa dialoglarni o'qing va must, mustn't, can, can't, should yoki shouldn't so'zlaridan mosini qo'ying, so'ngra tinglab javoblaringizni tekshiring. Oxirida juftlikda shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESH DIALOG — HAR BIRINING SARLAVHASI
JAVOBNI AYTIB TURIBDI!

  a) giving ADVICE        →  should / shouldn't
  b) giving PERMISSION    →  can
  c) expressing OBLIGATION →  must
  d) refusing PERMISSION  →  can / can't
  e) expressing PROHIBITION →  mustn't

  Ya'ni AUDIO ShART EMAS — sarlavhalar
  javobni belgilab beradi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  a) 1  SHOULD
     2  SHOULDN'T
  b) 1  CAN   2  CAN
  c)    MUST
  d) 1  CAN   2  CAN'T
  e)    MUSTN'T


HAR BIR DIALOG TO'LIQ:

 a) GIVING ADVICE (maslahat berish)

    A:  I can't see that sign very well.
    B:  You SHOULD see an optician.

    A:  I feel tired.
    B:  You SHOULDN'T go to bed so late.

    Tarjimasi:
    A:  Anavi belgini yaxshi ko'ra olmayapman.
    B:  Ko'z shifokoriga borishingiz kerak.
    A:  Charchadim.
    B:  Bunchalik kech yotmasligingiz kerak.


 b) GIVING PERMISSION (ruxsat berish)

    A:  CAN I use your phone, please?
    B:  Yes, of course you CAN.

    Tarjimasi:
    A:  Telefoningizdan foydalansam bo'ladimi?
    B:  Ha, albatta bo'ladi.


 c) EXPRESSING OBLIGATION (majburiyat)

    A:  Do I have to wash the dishes?
    B:  Yes, you do! You MUST wash the dishes —
        it's your turn!

    Tarjimasi:
    A:  Idish yuvishim shartmi?
    B:  Ha, shart! Idish yuvishingiz kerak —
        sizning navbatingiz!


 d) REFUSING PERMISSION (ruxsat bermaslik)

    A:  Mum, CAN I have some sweets?
    B:  No, you CAN'T. They're bad for your
        teeth.

    Tarjimasi:
    A:  Oyi, shirinlik yesam bo'ladimi?
    B:  Yo'q, bo'lmaydi. Ular tishga zarar.


 e) EXPRESSING PROHIBITION (taqiq)

    A:  Can I park here?
    B:  No, you can't. You MUSTN'T park here —
        it's illegal.

    Tarjimasi:
    A:  Bu yerga mashina qo'ysam bo'ladimi?
    B:  Yo'q, bo'lmaydi. Bu yerga qo'yish mumkin
        emas — bu qonunga xilof.


ENG MUHIM FARQ — d) va e):

  Ikkalasi ham RAD ETADI, lekin SABABI boshqa:

  d) CAN'T — ONA ruxsat bermayapti
     (shaxsiy qaror, shirinlik zararli)

  e) MUSTN'T — QONUN taqiqlagan
     ('it's ILLEGAL')

  Shuning uchun e) da avval 'you can't'
  deyilib, keyin 'you MUSTN'T' bilan
  KUCHAYTIRILADI.


DIQQAT — a) DAGI IKKI TOMONI:
  'You SHOULD see an optician.'
     → nima QILISh kerak (ijobiy maslahat)
  'You SHOULDN'T go to bed so late.'
     → nima QILMASLIK kerak (salbiy maslahat)

  DIQQAT: 'I feel tired' ga javob 'shouldn't' —
  chunki gap KELAJAKDA kech yotmaslik haqida,
  hozir uxlash haqida emas.


DIQQAT — c) DAGI 'DO I HAVE TO':
  Savolda 'have to', javobda 'must' —
  101-betdagi 12-mashq bilan bir xil naqsh.


DIQQAT — 'AN OPTICIAN':
  optician  = ko'zoynak ustasi, optik
  Ko'z shifokori: an eye doctor / an
  ophthalmologist.
  Kundalik nutqda 'optician' ishlatiladi.


O'XShASh DIALOGLAR TUZISh (mashqning oxirgi
qismi):

  a) maslahat:
     A: I've got a headache.
     B: You should take an aspirin.

  b) ruxsat berish:
     A: Can I open the window?
     B: Yes, of course you can.

  c) majburiyat:
     A: Do I have to make my bed?
     B: Yes, you do! You must make your bed.

  d) ruxsat bermaslik:
     A: Can I watch TV now?
     B: No, you can't. You haven't done your
        homework.

  e) taqiq:
     A: Can I smoke here?
     B: No, you can't. You mustn't smoke in
        hospitals — it's forbidden.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a sign        = belgi, lavha
  an optician   = ko'zoynak ustasi, optik
  to wash the dishes = idish yuvmoq
  your turn     = sizning navbatingiz
  sweets        = shirinliklar
  teeth         = tishlar (tooth ko'pligi)
  to park       = mashina qo'ymoq
  illegal       = qonunga xilof
  legal         = qonuniy

tasks.prompt: a) giving advice —  A: I can't see that sign very well.  B: You ............... see an optician.
tasks.whyUz:
SARLAVHA KALIT: 'giving ADVICE' (maslahat).
Maslahat uchun → SHOULD.

Ijobiy maslahat, chunki ko'z shifokoriga borish
FOYDALI ish.

'must' bo'lmaydi — bu majburiyat emas, do'stona
maslahat.

'an optician' = ko'zoynak ustasi, optik.

tasks.prompt: a) giving advice —  A: I feel tired.  B: You ............ go to bed so late.
tasks.whyUz:
SARLAVHA KALIT: 'giving ADVICE' → should/shouldn't.

Bu yerda SALBIY maslahat: kech yotish CHARCHOQQA
sabab bo'ladi.

DIQQAT: 'You should go to bed' bo'lsa ma'no
boshqa — 'hozir uxlang'. Lekin gap KELAJAKDA
kech yotmaslik haqida, shuning uchun SHOULDN'T.

'so late' = shunchalik kech.

tasks.prompt: b) giving permission —  A: ............... I use your phone, please?
tasks.whyUz:
SARLAVHA KALIT: 'giving PERMISSION' (ruxsat).
Ruxsat SO'RASH uchun → CAN I ...?

'Must I use your phone?' — ma'nosiz
(majburiyat emas, iltimos).

'please' ham iltimos ekanini ko'rsatib turibdi.

Rasmiyroq: 'MAY I ...?' yoki 'COULD I ...?'

tasks.prompt: b) giving permission —  B: Yes, of course you ............... .
tasks.whyUz:
QISQA JAVOB savoldagi modalni TAKRORLAYDI:
  'CAN I ...?'  →  'Yes, you CAN.'

'of course' — ruxsatni kuchaytiradi
(101-betdagi 12-mashqda ham shunday edi:
'Yes, of course you can.').

Qisqa javobda fe'l takrorlanmaydi:
'Yes, you can.' ✓
'Yes, you can use my phone.' (ortiqcha)

tasks.prompt: c) expressing obligation —  A: Do I have to wash the dishes?  B: Yes, you do! You ............... wash the dishes — it's your turn!
tasks.whyUz:
SARLAVHA KALIT: 'expressing OBLIGATION'
(majburiyat) → MUST.

Savolda 'DO I HAVE TO', javobda 'YOU MUST' —
101-betdagi 12-mashq bilan AYNAN bir xil naqsh:
  SA: 'Do I have to make the bed?'
  SB: 'Yes, you do. You must make the bed.'

'it's your turn' — majburiyatning sababi.
'to wash the dishes' = idish yuvmoq.

tasks.prompt: d) refusing permission —  A: Mum, ............... I have some sweets?
tasks.whyUz:
Bola onasidan RUXSAT so'rayapti → CAN I ...?

Sarlavha 'REFUSING permission' — ya'ni ruxsat
BERILMAYDI, lekin SAVOL baribir 'Can I ...?'
shaklida bo'ladi.

'to HAVE sweets' = shirinlik yemoq
('have' bu yerda 'yemoq' ma'nosida).

tasks.prompt: d) refusing permission —  B: No, you ............... . They're bad for your teeth.
tasks.whyUz:
SARLAVHA KALIT: 'REFUSING permission'
(ruxsat bermaslik) → CAN'T.

Qisqa javob savoldagi modalni takrorlaydi:
  'CAN I ...?'  →  'No, you CAN'T.'

DIQQAT — NEGA 'MUSTN'T' EMAS:
Bu ONANING shaxsiy qarori, QONUN emas.
'mustn't' qonuniy taqiq uchun (e-dialogga
qarang).

'teeth' — 'tooth' ning ko'pligi
(tooth → TEETH, noto'g'ri ko'plik).

tasks.prompt: e) expressing prohibition —  A: Can I park here?  B: No, you can't. You ............... park here — it's illegal.
tasks.promptUz: Bu yerga mashina qo'yish mumkin emas — bu qonunga xilof.
tasks.whyUz:
SARLAVHA KALIT: 'expressing PROHIBITION'
(taqiq) → MUSTN'T.

ENG MUHIM FARQ — d) va e):
  d) CAN'T   — ONA ruxsat bermayapti
               (shaxsiy qaror)
  e) MUSTN'T — QONUN taqiqlagan
               ('it's ILLEGAL')

Shuning uchun bu yerda avval 'you can't'
deyilib, keyin 'you MUSTN'T' bilan
KUCHAYTIRILADI.

'illegal' = qonunga xilof (il- + legal).
'to park' = mashina qo'ymoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the short dialogues below and fill in the blanks with the correct modal verb.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi qisqa dialoglarni o'qing va bo'shliqlarni to'g'ri modal fe'l bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  SHOULD
  2  CAN ... CAN'T
  3  MUST
  4  SHOULD
  5  MUSTN'T


TO'LIQ DIALOGLAR:

 1  A: My eyes are tired.
    B: You SHOULD wear your glasses.
    (A: Ko'zlarim charchadi.
     B: Ko'zoynagingizni taqishingiz kerak.)

 2  A: CAN I go outside to play?
    B: No, you CAN'T. It's raining.
    (A: Tashqariga o'ynagani chiqsam
        bo'ladimi?
     B: Yo'q, bo'lmaydi. Yomg'ir yog'yapti.)

 3  A: Do I have to go to school?
    B: Yes you do. You MUST go to school.
    (A: Maktabga borishim shartmi?
     B: Ha, shart. Maktabga borishingiz kerak.)

 4  A: I want to go on holiday this Christmas.
    B: You SHOULD start saving some money.
    (A: Bu Rojdestvoda ta'tilga bormoqchiman.
     B: Pul yig'ishni boshlashingiz kerak.)

 5  A: I'm sorry I'm late, Mrs Brown.
    B: You MUSTN'T be late for school again.
    (A: Kechikkanim uchun uzr, Missis Braun.
     B: Boshqa maktabga kechikmasligingiz
        kerak.)


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'My eyes are TIRED' — muammo bor,
    do'stona MASLAHAT kerak → SHOULD.

 2  Bola RUXSAT so'rayapti → CAN I ...?
    Javob: qisqa javob savolni takrorlaydi
    → 'No, you CAN'T.'
    Sababi: 'It's RAINING.'

 3  KALIT: savolda 'DO I HAVE TO ...?' —
    MAJBURIYAT so'ralyapti.
    Javobda 'Yes you DO' + 'You MUST ...'
    (Coursebook 101-bet, 12-mashq bilan
     AYNAN bir xil naqsh:
     'Do I have to make the bed?'
     'Yes, you do. You must make the bed.')

 4  'I WANT to go on holiday' — maqsad bor,
    unga erishish uchun MASLAHAT → SHOULD.

 5  KALIT: 'I'm sorry I'm LATE' va 'AGAIN' —
    bu TAKRORLANGAN qoidabuzarlik.
    O'qituvchi QAT'IY ogohlantirmoqda
    → MUSTN'T (maktab qoidasi).
    'shouldn't' bo'lsa juda yumshoq bo'lardi.


MODALLAR — QAY BIRI QAChON (qisqa jadval):

  SHOULD   — do'stona maslahat      (1, 4)
  CAN      — ruxsat so'rash          (2)
  CAN'T    — ruxsat bermaslik        (2)
  MUST     — majburiyat              (3)
  MUSTN'T  — qat'iy taqiq/ogohlantirish (5)


DIQQAT — 3-BANDDAGI IKKI SHAKL:
  Savolda:  'DO I HAVE TO go to school?'
  Javobda:  'Yes you DO. You MUST go.'

  Nega ikki xil? Chunki savolda 'Must I ...?'
  zamonaviy inglizchada kam ishlatiladi;
  'Do I have to ...?' tabiiyroq.
  Javobda esa 'must' ishlatiladi.


DIQQAT — 5-BANDDAGI 'AGAIN':
  'You mustn't be late for school AGAIN.'
  'again' — bu birinchi marta EMASligini
  ko'rsatadi, shuning uchun ogohlantirish
  QAT'IY.

  'late FOR school' — predlog 'for'
  (Workbook 57-bet, 6-mashqning 1-bandi).


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDAGI 'START SAVING':
  'start SAVING' — 'start' dan keyin -ING
  ('start TO save' ham to'g'ri).

  'to save money' = pul yig'moq/tejamoq.
  Grammar 62-bet: 'Tonia is SAVING some
  money.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  glasses      = ko'zoynak (DOIM ko'plik)
  outside      = tashqariga
  to save money = pul yig'moq
  Christmas    = Rojdestvo
  to be sorry  = uzr so'ramoq

tasks.prompt: 1  A: My eyes are tired.  B: You ...................................... wear your glasses.
tasks.whyUz:
'My eyes are TIRED' — muammo bor, do'stona
MASLAHAT kerak → SHOULD.

'must wear' bo'lsa juda qat'iy bo'lardi
(bu maktab qoidasi emas, do'stona maslahat).

'glasses' = ko'zoynak — DOIM ko'plikda
('a glass' = stakan, boshqa ma'no).
tasks.speak: 1  A: My eyes are tired.  B: You ...................................... wear your glasses.

tasks.whyUz:
Bola RUXSAT so'rayapti → CAN I ...?

'Must I go outside?' = 'chiqishim SHARTMI?'
— ma'nosiz.

'go outside TO play' — MAQSAD to-infinitive.

QISQA JAVOB savoldagi modalni TAKRORLAYDI:
  'CAN I go?' → 'No, you CAN'T.'

Sababi gapda berilgan: 'It's RAINING.'

'mustn't' bo'lsa juda qat'iy — bu qonuniy
taqiq emas, ob-havo tufayli rad etish.

tasks.prompt: 3  A: Do I have to go to school?  B: Yes you do. You ......................... go to school.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: savolda 'DO I HAVE TO ...?' —
MAJBURIYAT so'ralyapti → javobda MUST.

Coursebook 101-bet, 12-mashq namunasi AYNAN
shunday:
  'Do I have to make the bed?'
  'Yes, you do. You MUST make the bed.'

Nega ikki xil shakl? Savolda 'Must I ...?'
zamonaviy inglizchada kam ishlatiladi.
tasks.speak: 3  A: Do I have to go to school?  B: Yes you do. You ......................... go to school.

tasks.prompt: 4  A: I want to go on holiday this Christmas.  B: You ......................... start saving some money.
tasks.whyUz:
'I WANT to go on holiday' — maqsad bor,
unga erishish uchun do'stona MASLAHAT
→ SHOULD.

'must start saving' bo'lsa juda qat'iy —
bu majburiyat emas, tavsiya.

'start SAVING' — 'start' dan keyin -ING
('start TO save' ham to'g'ri).
tasks.speak: 4  A: I want to go on holiday this Christmas.  B: You ......................... start saving some money.

tasks.prompt: 5  A: I'm sorry I'm late, Mrs Brown.  B: You ............................. be late for school again.
tasks.whyUz:
IKKI KALIT:
  1) 'Mrs Brown' — o'qituvchi, ya'ni MAKTAB
     QOIDASI haqida gapiryapti
  2) 'AGAIN' — bu birinchi marta EMAS,
     demak ogohlantirish QAT'IY

→ MUSTN'T

'shouldn't be late' bo'lsa juda yumshoq
bo'lardi (do'stona maslahat kabi).

'late FOR school' — predlog 'for'.

exercises.instructionEn: Steve sent a letter to his aunt asking for advice on how to keep fit and healthy. Look at the letter his aunt sent him in the Photo File section and write it out in full sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Stiv xolasiga tetik va sog'lom bo'lish haqida maslahat so'rab xat yozdi. Photo File bo'limida xolasi unga yuborgan xatga qarang va uni to'liq gaplar bilan yozib chiqing.
exercises.explanationUz:
DIQQAT — PHOTO FILE:
  Xolasining xati kitobning PHOTO FILE bo'limida
  (kitob oxirida). U bizdagi skanda YO'Q,
  shuning uchun uning aniq matni bu yerda
  keltirilmadi — taxmin qilinmadi.

  Quyida vazifaning TUZILIShI va TO'LIQ NAMUNA
  javob berilgan.


VAZIFANING MOHIYATI:
  Photo File dagi xat QISQARTMA shaklda
  (eslatma-ro'yxat) yozilgan.
  Sizning vazifangiz — uni TO'LIQ GAPLARGA
  aylantirish.

  Masalan:
     QISQA:  'not too many hamburgers'
     TO'LIQ: 'You shouldn't eat too many
              hamburgers.'


QANDAY GAPLAR IShLATILADI:
  6-mashqdagi maslahat shakllari:
     You should ...
     You shouldn't ...
     Why don't you ... ?
     I think it's a good idea to ...
     I don't think it's a good idea to ...


XAT TUZILIShI (norasmiy, qarindoshga):

  1-xatboshi — SALOM va SABAB
     Dear Steve,
     Thanks for your letter. You asked me how to
     keep fit and healthy, so here is my advice.

  2-xatboshi — OVQAT (nima YEYISh kerak)
     You should eat a lot of fruit and
     vegetables, and I think it's a good idea to
     have cereal with milk for breakfast.
     Also, you should drink a lot of water.

  3-xatboshi — NIMA QILMASLIK kerak
     You shouldn't eat too many hamburgers or
     pizzas, and I don't think it's a good idea
     to eat a lot of chocolate or ice-cream.
     You shouldn't drink fizzy drinks or beer,
     either.

  4-xatboshi — MAShQ va XAYRLAShUV
     Why don't you take regular exercise? You
     should walk to work, too — it's good for
     you and for the environment.
     Write back soon and tell me how you are
     getting on.

     Love,
     Aunt Mary


TO'LIQ NAMUNA XAT (bir butun holda):

  Dear Steve,

  Thanks for your letter. You asked me how to
  keep fit and healthy, so here is my advice.

  You should eat a lot of fruit and vegetables,
  and I think it's a good idea to have cereal
  with milk for breakfast. Also, you should drink
  a lot of water.

  You shouldn't eat too many hamburgers or
  pizzas, and I don't think it's a good idea to
  eat a lot of chocolate or ice-cream. You
  shouldn't drink fizzy drinks or beer, either.

  Why don't you take regular exercise? You should
  walk to work, too — it's good for you and for
  the environment.

  Write back soon and tell me how you are getting
  on.

  Love,
  Aunt Mary


DIQQAT — bu NAMUNA javob, kitobning O'Z matni
EMAS. Kitobdagi Photo File xatida boshqa
bandlar bo'lishi mumkin. 6-mashqdagi sakkiz
band asosida tuzilgan.


NORASMIY XAT QOIDALARI (eslatma):
  Boshlanishi:  Dear Steve,
  Tugashi:      Love, / Best wishes,
                (qarindosh va do'stlarga)
  Rasmiy xatda: Dear Sir/Madam ...
                Yours faithfully


DIQQAT — 'EITHER' INKORDA:
  'You shouldn't drink beer, EITHER.'
  Inkor gapda 'ham' ma'nosi — 'TOO' emas,
  'EITHER'.
     Tasdiq:  'I like it, TOO.'
     Inkor:   'I don't like it, EITHER.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to ask for advice = maslahat so'ramoq
  in full sentences = to'liq gaplar bilan
  to write out      = yozib chiqmoq
  to get on         = ishlar yurishmoq
  either            = ham (inkor gapda)

exercises.instructionEn: When we write leaflets giving rules, regulations, advice, instructions, etc, we write one rule after the other on separate lines. We use the imperative and words like never, always, make sure, etc. We may also give the reason why we should do what the rule says.
exercises.instructionUz: Qoida, nizom, maslahat, ko'rsatma beruvchi varaqa yozganda, har bir qoidani alohida qatorda, birin-ketin yozamiz. Buyruq maylini va never, always, make sure kabi so'zlarni ishlatamiz. Qoidaning sababini ham berishimiz mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
YOZISh QUTISI — VARAQA QOIDALARI

KITOBDAGI QOIDA (to'liq):
  'When we write LEAFLETS giving rules,
   regulations, advice, instructions, etc,
   we write ONE RULE AFTER THE OTHER on
   SEPARATE LINES. We use the IMPERATIVE and
   words like NEVER, ALWAYS, MAKE SURE, etc.
   We may also give the REASON why we should
   do what the rule says.'

  KITOBDAGI MISOL:
     'Never light fires in forests.
      Trees will burn.'


VARAQANING BESH XUSUSIYATI:

  1  HAR QOIDA ALOHIDA QATORDA
     (one rule after the other on separate
      lines)

  2  BUYRUQ MAYLI (imperative)
     — ega yo'q: 'Wear a hat.'

  3  KUCHAYTIRUVChI SO'ZLAR:
        NEVER      — hech qachon
        ALWAYS     — doim
        MAKE SURE  — ishonch hosil qiling
        DON'T      — ...mang

  4  SABAB BERILADI (ixtiyoriy)
     'Never light fires in forests.
      TREES WILL BURN.'

  5  Qisqa va aniq gaplar


BU QOIDA 99-BETDAGI VARAQADA IShLATILGAN:
  'HELPING THE ENVIRONMENT'
     • Try not to buy pre-packaged food.
       The packaging creates a lot of rubbish.
     • Use less washing-up liquid.
       It pollutes the seas and rivers.
     ...

  Ko'ryapsizmi — har bandda QOIDA + SABAB,
  alohida qatorda.


DIQQAT — 'MAKE SURE':
  'MAKE SURE you wear a hat.'
  = shlyapa kiyishni unutmang

  100-betdagi Yaponiya matnida ham bor edi:
  'MAKE SURE the toes are pointing towards
   the door.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a leaflet     = varaqa, buklet
  a regulation  = nizom, qoida
  separate      = alohida
  a line        = qator
  the imperative = buyruq mayli
