exercises.instructionEn: Write a leaflet giving advice to people on what to do while they are on the beach during the summer (50-80 words). Use ideas from Ex. 17, as well as your own ideas.
exercises.instructionUz: Yozda plyajda bo'lganlarida nima qilish kerakligi haqida odamlarga maslahat beruvchi varaqa yozing (50-80 so'z). 17-mashqdagi fikrlardan va o'z fikrlaringizdan foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOB BERGAN BOShLANISh:

  ENJOY THE SEA AND SUN

  'Summer is here. It's holiday time. Pack your
   things and head for the nearest beach. But
   keep in mind the following useful tips.'

  Tarjimasi:
  'Yoz keldi. Ta'til vaqti. Narsalaringizni
   yig'ing va eng yaqin plyajga yo'l oling.
   Lekin quyidagi foydali maslahatlarni yodda
   tuting.'


TO'LIQ NAMUNA VARAQA:

  ─────────────────────────────────────────
  ENJOY THE SEA AND SUN

  Summer is here. It's holiday time. Pack your
  things and head for the nearest beach. But
  keep in mind the following useful tips.

  • Always put suncream on your skin.
    It protects your skin from the hot sun.

  • Always wear a hat and sunglasses.
    They protect your head and eyes from the
    sun.

  • Never play in the sun between 11am and 3pm.
    The sun is very dangerous then.

  • Never swim after eating.
    It is dangerous to swim with a full stomach.

  • Never swim near windsurfers.
    There is always a danger of accidents.

  • Don't drop litter on the beach.
    It looks and smells horrible.

  Have a wonderful summer!
  ─────────────────────────────────────────

  Qoidalar qismi ≈ 75 so'z — talab qilingan
  50-80 oralig'ida.


QISQAROQ VARIANT (≈55 so'z, agar kirish qismi
ham hisobga olinsa):

  • Always put suncream on your skin.
    It protects you from the hot sun.
  • Always wear a hat and sunglasses.
  • Never play in the sun between 11am and 3pm.
    The sun is very dangerous then.
  • Never swim after eating.
  • Don't drop litter on the beach.
    It looks and smells horrible.

  Have a wonderful summer!


TUZILIShI — UCh QISM:

  1  SARLAVHA
     'ENJOY THE SEA AND SUN'
     (Katta harflar bilan, e'tibor tortadi.)

  2  KIRISh (kitob bergan)
     Yoz keldi → plyajga boring →
     LEKIN maslahatlarni yodda tuting.

  3  QOIDALAR RO'YXATI
     Har biri ALOHIDA qatorda, buyruq maylida,
     always/never/don't bilan, sababi bilan.

  4  YAKUN (ixtiyoriy)
     'Have a wonderful summer!'


O'Z FIKRLARINGIZ UChUN QO'ShIMChA G'OYALAR:

  • Always drink a lot of water.
    The hot sun makes you thirsty.
  • Never swim alone.
    It is very dangerous.
  • Always swim between the flags.
    Lifeguards can see you there.
  • Don't leave your things on the beach.
    Someone may take them.
  • Make sure children are never alone near
    the sea.


DIQQAT — 'HEAD FOR':
  'HEAD FOR the nearest beach'
  = ... tomon yo'l olmoq
  'head' bu yerda FE'L ('bosh' emas).


DIQQAT — 'KEEP IN MIND':
  'KEEP IN MIND the following tips'
  = yodda tutmoq
  'mind' = ong, xotira


DIQQAT — 'THE FOLLOWING':
  'the FOLLOWING tips' = quyidagi maslahatlar
  Ro'yxatdan OLDIN ishlatiladi.


DIQQAT — SO'Z SANASh:
  Talab: 50-80 so'z.
  Kitob bergan kirish qismi (24 so'z) odatda
  HISOBGA KIRMAYDI — siz faqat QOIDALAR
  qismini yozasiz.
  Har bir qoida + sabab ≈ 12 so'z, demak
  5-6 ta qoida yetarli.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to pack        = (yukni) yig'moq
  to head for    = ... tomon yo'l olmoq
  the nearest    = eng yaqin
  to keep in mind = yodda tutmoq
  the following  = quyidagi
  useful         = foydali
  a tip          = maslahat

tasks.en: Write a leaflet giving advice to people on what to do while they are on the beach during the summer (50-80 words). Use ideas from Ex. 17, as well as your own ideas.
tasks.uz: Yozda plyajda bo'lganlarida nima qilish kerakligi haqida odamlarga maslahat beruvchi varaqa yozing (50-80 so'z). 17-mashqdagi fikrlardan va o'z fikrlaringizdan foydalaning.

tasks.en: ENJOY THE SEA AND SUN
tasks.uz: DENGIZ VA QUYOSHDAN ZAVQLANING
tasks.note:
KITOB BERGAN SARLAVHA.
Katta harflar bilan.

tasks.en: Summer is here. It's holiday time. Pack your things and head for the nearest beach. But keep in mind the following useful tips.
tasks.uz: Yoz keldi. Ta'til vaqti. Narsalaringizni yig'ing va eng yaqin plyajga yo'l oling. Lekin quyidagi foydali maslahatlarni yodda tuting.
tasks.note:
KITOB BERGAN KIRISH.
'head for' = ... tomon yo'l olmoq.
'keep in mind' = yodda tutmoq.

tasks.en: Always put suncream on your skin. It protects your skin from the hot sun.
tasks.uz: Doim teringizga quyoshdan himoya kremi suring. U teringizni issiq quyoshdan himoya qiladi.
tasks.note:
1-qoida (17-mashqdan).
ALWAYS — ijobiy ko'rsatma.

tasks.en: Always wear a hat and sunglasses. They protect your head and eyes from the sun.
tasks.uz: Doim shlyapa va quyosh ko'zoynagi taqing. Ular boshingiz va ko'zlaringizni quyoshdan himoya qiladi.
tasks.note:
2 va 3-qoida birlashtirildi (so'z tejash uchun).
'THEY protect' — ikkalasi haqida, ko'plik.

tasks.en: Never play in the sun between 11am and 3pm. The sun is very dangerous then.
tasks.uz: Soat 11 dan 15 gacha quyoshda o'ynamang. Quyosh o'shanda juda xavfli.
tasks.note:
4-qoida.
'between ... AND ...' — 'to' emas.

tasks.en: Never swim after eating. It is dangerous to swim with a full stomach.
tasks.uz: Ovqatdan keyin suzmang. To'la oshqozon bilan suzish xavfli.
tasks.note:
5-qoida.
'after EATING' — predlogdan keyin -ING.

tasks.en: Never swim near windsurfers. There is always a danger of accidents.
tasks.uz: Vindserfingchilar yonida suzmang. Har doim baxtsiz hodisa xavfi bor.
tasks.note: 6-qoida.

tasks.en: Don't drop litter on the beach. It looks and smells horrible.
tasks.uz: Plyajga axlat tashlamang. U dahshatli ko'rinadi va hidlaydi.
tasks.note:
7-qoida.
DON'T — NEVER dan biroz yumshoqroq.

tasks.en: Have a wonderful summer!
tasks.uz: Ajoyib yoz o'tkazing!
tasks.note:
Yakuniy jumla (ixtiyoriy).
Varaqani do'stona tugatadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete Peter's letter to Mick using the prompts below.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib xatni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ KITOB XATOSI — YO'RIQNOMADA:
  Kitob 'Complete PETER'S letter to MICK'
  deydi, lekin berilgan xat:
     'Dear PETER ... Best wishes, MICK'

  Ya'ni bu MIKNING PITERGA yozgan JAVOB xati!
  To'g'ri yo'riqnoma:
  'Complete MICK'S letter to PETER.'

  (15-mashqdagi xat esa haqiqatan Piterdan
   Mikka edi — kitob ikkalasini adashtirgan.)


KO'RSATMALAR (4 ta):
  thieves/think/someone/be/home
  thieves/not get into/house/easily
  keep/jewellery/money/bank
  thieves/be/usually/scared/dogs


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  thieves CAN'T GET INTO the house EASILY
 2  thieves ARE USUALLY SCARED OF dogs
 3  KEEP your JEWELLERY and MONEY in the BANK
 4  thieves WILL THINK SOMEONE IS AT HOME


TO'LIQ XAT (javoblar bilan):

  Dear Peter,

  I got your letter and I think I can help you.

  First you should always lock your doors and
  windows, so THIEVES CAN'T GET INTO THE HOUSE
  EASILY.

  I think it's a good idea to buy a big guard
  dog because THIEVES ARE USUALLY SCARED OF
  DOGS.

  You should KEEP YOUR JEWELLERY AND MONEY IN
  THE BANK, so thieves can't steal it.

  Also, it's a good idea to leave some lights
  on while you are away because THIEVES WILL
  THINK SOMEONE IS AT HOME.

  I hope my advice is of some help to you.
  Let me know what happens.

                            Best wishes,
                            Mick


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:

  Hurmatli Piter,

  Xatingizni oldim va menimcha sizga yordam
  bera olaman.

  Birinchidan, eshik va derazalaringizni doim
  qulflashingiz kerak, shunda o'g'rilar uyga
  oson kira olmaydi.

  Menimcha, katta qorovul it sotib olish yaxshi
  fikr, chunki o'g'rilar odatda itlardan
  qo'rqadi.

  Taqinchoq va pulingizni bankda saqlashingiz
  kerak, shunda o'g'rilar uni o'g'irlay
  olmaydi.

  Yana, uydan uzoqda bo'lganingizda ba'zi
  chiroqlarni yoqib qo'yish yaxshi fikr, chunki
  o'g'rilar uyda kimdir bor deb o'ylaydi.

  Umid qilamanki, maslahatim sizga yordam
  beradi. Nima bo'lganini menga xabar qiling.

                            Eng yaxshi tilaklar
                            bilan, Mik


DIQQAT — KO'RSATMALAR TARTIBI BOShQA!

  Ro'yxatdagi tartib va bo'shliqlar tartibi
  MOS KELMAYDI:

     1-ko'rsatma (think/someone/be/home)
        →  4-bo'shliq
     2-ko'rsatma (not get into/house/easily)
        →  1-bo'shliq
     3-ko'rsatma (keep/jewellery/money/bank)
        →  3-bo'shliq
     4-ko'rsatma (be/usually/scared/dogs)
        →  2-bo'shliq

  Kitob ataylab shunday qilgan — MA'NOGA
  qarab joylashtirish kerak.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — HAR BO'ShLIQDAN OLDINGI
QISM:

  1  'lock your doors and windows, SO ...'
     Eshikni qulflashning NATIJASI nima?
     → o'g'rilar oson kira olmaydi
     → thieves can't get into the house easily

  2  'buy a big GUARD DOG BECAUSE ...'
     Nega it sotib olish kerak?
     → o'g'rilar itlardan qo'rqadi
     → thieves are usually scared of dogs

  3  'You should ..., so thieves CAN'T STEAL
      IT.'
     'IT' nimaga ishora qiladi? Qimmatbaho
     narsaga.
     → keep your jewellery and money in the
       bank

  4  'leave some LIGHTS ON while you are away
      BECAUSE ...'
     Nega chiroq yoqib qo'yiladi?
     → o'g'rilar uyda kimdir bor deb o'ylaydi
     → thieves will think someone is at home


QISQARTMA ShAKLNI TO'LIQ GAPGA AYLANTIRISh:

  thieves/not get into/house/easily
     → 'thieves CAN'T GET INTO THE house
        easily'
     (modal 'can't' va artikl 'the' qo'shildi)

  thieves/be/usually/scared/dogs
     → 'thieves ARE usually scared OF dogs'
     ('be' → ARE; predlog 'OF' qo'shildi)

  keep/jewellery/money/bank
     → 'keep YOUR jewellery AND money IN THE
        bank'
     (egalik, bog'lovchi va predlog qo'shildi)

  thieves/think/someone/be/home
     → 'thieves WILL THINK someone IS AT home'
     ('will' va 'is' qo'shildi)


DIQQAT — 'SCARED OF':
  'to be SCARED OF something' = ... dan
  qo'rqmoq (predlog 'OF')

  Shu kabi: afraid OF, frightened OF,
  terrified OF


DIQQAT — 'AT HOME':
  'someone is AT HOME' = uyda kimdir bor

  'at home' — turg'un ibora, artikl YO'Q
  ('at the home' XATO).


DIQQAT — 'GET INTO':
  'get INTO the house' = uyga kirmoq
  15-mashqdagi savol ham shunday edi:
  'How did the thieves GET IN?'


DIQQAT — 'A GUARD DOG':
  'a guard dog' = qorovul it
  'to guard' = qo'riqlamoq


DIQQAT — 'IS OF SOME HELP':
  'I hope my advice IS OF SOME HELP to you.'
  = maslahatim sizga biroz yordam beradi
  degan umiddaman

  'to be of help' — rasmiy ibora.


XAT TUZILIShI (Mikning javob xati):
  Murojaat:  Dear Peter,
  Kirish:    'I got your letter and I think
              I can help you.'
  4 ta MASLAHAT + har birining SABABI
  Yakun:     'I hope my advice is of some help
              ... Let me know what happens.'
  Imzo:      Best wishes, Mick


MASLAHAT ShAKLLARI XATDA:
  'you SHOULD always lock ...'      (1)
  'I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO buy ...' (2)
  'You SHOULD keep ...'             (3)
  'IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO leave ...'   (4)

  Ya'ni ikki xil shakl navbatma-navbat —
  99-betdagi 'Giving Advice' qutisidan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to lock          = qulflamoq
  easily           = oson
  a guard dog      = qorovul it
  to be scared of  = ... dan qo'rqmoq
  jewellery        = taqinchoqlar
  a bank           = bank
  lights           = chiroqlar
  away             = uzoqda, yo'q
  to be of help    = yordam bermoq
  Let me know      = Menga xabar bering

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI MAQOL:


 1  'WHEN IN ROME, DO AS THE ROMANS DO.'

    So'zma-so'z:
    'Rimda bo'lganingda, rimliklar qanday
     qilsa, shunday qil.'

    O'zbekchada eng yaqin maqol:
    'Har elning o'z odati bor.'
    'Kirgan yurtingning shohi bo'lmasang ham,
     odatiga qara.'

    MA'NOSI:
    Chet elga borganingda, o'sha yerning
    ODATLARIGA moslash kerak — o'zingnikini
    zo'rlab olib borma.

    NEGA BU UNITDA:
    100-bet AYNAN shu haqda edi —
    Angliya, Xitoy va Yaponiyaning har birida
    o'z odoblari bor:
       Angliyada — navbatga suqilma
       Xitoyda — odamlar oldida o'pma
       Yaponiyada — oyoq kiyimingni yech

    Bir mamlakatda odobli bo'lgan narsa
    boshqasida qo'pol bo'lishi mumkin.

    GRAMMATIKASI:
       'WHEN IN Rome' = 'when YOU ARE IN Rome'
       (ega va 'to be' tushirib qoldirilgan —
        100-betdagi 'When in China' bilan
        bir xil!)

       'DO AS the Romans DO'
       'as' = ...day, ...dek
       Oxirgi 'do' — takrorlanishni oldini
       oladi ('do as the Romans do things'
       o'rniga).

    Kelib chiqishi: IV asrda Avliyo Ambrose
    aytgan maslahatdan.


 2  'EXPERIENCE IS THE BEST TEACHER.'

    So'zma-so'z:
    'Tajriba — eng yaxshi o'qituvchi.'

    O'zbekchada eng yaqin maqol:
    'Ko'rgan — bilganini aytar.'
    'Yuz marta eshitgandan bir marta ko'rgan
     afzal.'

    MA'NOSI:
    Kitobdan yoki birovdan eshitib emas,
    O'ZING boshdan kechirib o'rgangan narsa
    eng mustahkam yodda qoladi.

    NEGA BU UNITDA:
    Butun unit MASLAHAT haqida edi
    (should, must, can). Bu maqol esa
    maslahatning CHEGARASINI ko'rsatadi:
    ba'zi narsalarni faqat o'zing sinab
    ko'rib bilasan.

    GRAMMATIKASI:
       'EXPERIENCE' — artiklsiz, chunki
       SANALMAYDIGAN ot (umumiy ma'noda).
       'AN experience' bo'lsa — bitta aniq
       voqea ('It was a strange experience').

       'THE BEST' — eng ustun daraja,
       'the' SHART.


DIQQAT — MAQOLLAR TARJIMA QILINMAYDI:
  Maqolni so'zma-so'z o'girish ko'pincha
  ma'nosiz bo'ladi. Har tilda O'Z muqobili
  bor.

  'When in Rome...' ni o'zbekchaga
  'Rimda bo'lsang...' deb o'girish emas,
  'Kirgan yurtingning odatiga qara' deyish
  to'g'ri.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  wisdom       = donishmandlik
  wise         = dono
  Rome         = Rim (shahar)
  a Roman      = rimlik
  experience   = tajriba (SANALMAYDIGAN)
  an experience = boshdan kechirilgan voqea
  as           = ...day, ...dek

exercises.instructionEn: Choose words from the list to fill in the gaps, then use them to make sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni to'ldirish uchun ro'yxatdan so'z tanlang, so'ngra ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta so'z, har biri BIR marta):
  smells, aluminium, plastic, washing-up,
  pre-packaged, public, light, pollute


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  PRE-PACKAGED food
  2  WASHING-UP liquid
  3  ALUMINIUM cans
  4  PUBLIC transport
  5  to POLLUTE the air
  6  to LIGHT fires
  7  it SMELLS horrible
  8  PLASTIC bottles


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — IKKI GURUH:

  1-4 va 8 →  SIFAT + OT birikmasi
     pre-packaged FOOD    (qanday ovqat?)
     washing-up LIQUID    (qanday suyuqlik?)
     aluminium CANS       (qanday banka?)
     public TRANSPORT     (qanday transport?)
     plastic BOTTLES      (qanday shisha?)

  5-7 →  FE'L
     to POLLUTE  ('to' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl)
     to LIGHT    ('to' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl)
     it SMELLS   ('it' dan keyin -S qo'shiladi!)


DIQQAT — 5, 6, 7 NING FARQI:
  5  'TO pollute'   →  asosiy shakl (to + fe'l)
  6  'TO light'     →  asosiy shakl (to + fe'l)
  7  'IT smellS'    →  III shaxs birlik → -S

  Bu — mashqning eng nozik joyi.
  Ro'yxatda 'smells' -S bilan berilgan,
  'pollute' va 'light' esa -S siz.
  Demak ro'yxatning O'ZI qaysi bo'shliqqa
  tushishini ko'rsatib turibdi!


DIQQAT — 'ALUMINIUM CANS' va 'PLASTIC BOTTLES':
  3-band 'cans' — bu bo'shliqqa 'aluminium'
     ham, 'plastic' ham mos kelardi.
     Lekin 8-band 'bottles' ga faqat 'plastic'
     mos keladi (alyuminiy shisha bo'lmaydi).
     Demak 3 = aluminium, 8 = plastic.

  Bu — ELIMINATSIYA usuli: avval BITTA javobi
  bor bo'shliqni to'ldiring.


GAP TUZISH — NAMUNA GAPLAR:

 1  I never buy PRE-PACKAGED FOOD because the
    packaging creates a lot of rubbish.
    (Men hech qachon o'ralgan ovqat sotib
     olmayman, chunki o'ram ko'p axlat hosil
     qiladi.)

 2  My mother uses very little WASHING-UP LIQUID.
    (Onam juda oz idish yuvish suyuqligi
     ishlatadi.)

 3  We put all our ALUMINIUM CANS into the
    recycling bin.
    (Biz barcha alyuminiy bankalarimizni qayta
     ishlash qutisiga solamiz.)

 4  I go to school by PUBLIC TRANSPORT.
    (Men maktabga jamoat transportida boraman.)

 5  Cars and factories POLLUTE THE AIR.
    (Mashina va zavodlar havoni ifloslantiradi.)

 6  You mustn't LIGHT FIRES in a forest.
    (O'rmonda olov yoqmaslik kerak.)

 7  Don't drop rubbish in the street — IT SMELLS
    HORRIBLE.
    (Ko'chaga axlat tashlamang — u dahshatli
     hidlaydi.)

 8  PLASTIC BOTTLES in the sea kill fish.
    (Dengizdagi plastik shishalar baliqlarni
     o'ldiradi.)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a gap        = bo'shliq
  to fill in   = to'ldirmoq
  horrible     = dahshatli, jirkanch

tasks.whyUz:
SIFAT + OT: qanday ovqat? — o'ralgan.
Varaqadagi 1-ko'rsatmadan.
98-betdagi C rasmi.

SIFAT + OT: qanday suyuqlik? — idish yuvish.
Britancha ibora ('to wash up' = idish yuvmoq).
98-betdagi F rasmi.

'plastic' ham mos kelardi, LEKIN 8-band
('bottles') ga faqat 'plastic' mos keladi
(alyuminiy shisha bo'lmaydi).
Shuning uchun bu yerda ALUMINIUM.
ELIMINATSIYA usuli.

SIFAT + OT: qanday transport? — jamoat.
'public transport' — SANALMAYDIGAN
('a public transport' XATO).
98-betdagi E rasmi.

'TO' dan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.
Shuning uchun 'pollute' (-S siz).
Varaqadan: 'Cars pollute the air.'

'TO' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl.
'to light a fire' = olov yoqmoq.
DIQQAT: 'light' — noto'g'ri fe'l (light → LIT).
OT sifatida 'light' = yorug'lik, chiroq.

'IT' — III shaxs BIRLIK → fe'lga -S qo'shiladi.
Ro'yxatda 'smells' allaqachon -S bilan berilgan —
bu kalit!
DIQQAT: 'smell + SIFAT' (horrible), RAVISH emas.

Shisha faqat PLASTIK bo'lishi mumkin
(alyuminiy shisha yo'q).
Shuning uchun 3-band 'aluminium' ni oladi.
98-betdagi B rasmi.

exercises.instructionEn: Giving Instructions
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatma berish
exercises.explanationUz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI — KO'RSATMA BERISH

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:
  'We use the IMPERATIVE to tell people what to
   do or not to do.'
  (Odamlarga nima qilish yoki qilmaslik kerakligini
   aytish uchun BUYRUQ MAYLIni ishlatamiz.)

  Misollar:
     'USE public transport.'
     'DO NOT USE aerosols.'


BUYRUQ MAYLI QANDAY YASALADI:

  TASDIQ:
     [fe'lning ASOSIY shakli] + ...
     Use public transport.
     Put cans into recycling bins.

  INKOR:
     DON'T / DO NOT + [ASOSIY shakl] + ...
     Don't use aerosols.
     Do not throw bottles into the sea.


ENG MUHIM XUSUSIYAT — EGA YO'Q:
  'YOU use public transport.'   ✗ (buyruq emas)
  'Use public transport.'       ✓

  Buyruq gapda ega YOZILMAYDI, lekin ma'noda
  DOIM 'you' (siz) tushuniladi.


'DON'T' va 'DO NOT' FARQI:
  DON'T    — og'zaki, oddiy suhbat
             'Don't be late!'
  DO NOT   — RASMIY, yozma, e'lon va qoidalarda
             'DO NOT SMOKE.'

  Varaqada 'DO NOT' ishlatilgan — chunki bu
  rasmiy e'lon matni.


KUCHAYTIRUVChILAR:
  ALWAYS + fe'l   →  'ALWAYS use rubbish bins.'
  NEVER + fe'l    →  'NEVER light fires.'
                     ('don't' O'RNIGA keladi,
                      ikkalasi birga EMAS)

  'NEVER don't light fires.'  ✗ XATO
  'NEVER light fires.'        ✓


YUMShATUVChI:
  TRY TO + fe'l      →  'Try to walk more.'
  TRY NOT TO + fe'l  →  'Try not to buy
                         pre-packaged food.'

  Bu — buyruq emas, TAVSIYA.


BUYRUQ QAYERDA IShLATILADI:
  • e'lon va belgilarda:  'Keep off the grass.'
  • retseptlarda:         'Add two eggs.'
  • yo'l ko'rsatishda:    'Turn left.'
  • qoidalarda:           'Do not use aerosols.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an instruction  = ko'rsatma
  the imperative  = buyruq mayli

'DO NOT' — rasmiy; 'DON'T' — og'zaki.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps in the speech bubbles with the correct words from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Nutq pufakchalaridagi bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi to'g'ri so'zlar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (6 ta so'z, har biri BIR marta):
  flu, headache, toothache, cold, tired,
  sore throat


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  I've got a HEADACHE.
  2  I've got a SORE THROAT.
  3  I feel very COLD.
  4  I've got the FLU.
  5  I feel very TIRED.
  6  I've got TOOTHACHE.


RASMLARDA NIMA KO'RINADI:
  1  Erkak boshini ushlab, og'riqdan yuzini
     burishtirgan          →  bosh og'rig'i
  2  Erkak tomog'ini ushlab, og'zi ochiq
                           →  tomoq og'rig'i
  3  Erkak o'zini quchoqlab, qaltirab turibdi
                           →  sovqotgan
  4  Yigit yo'talyapti, qo'lini og'ziga tutgan
                           →  gripp
  5  Keksa erkak qo'liga suyanib, ko'zlari
     yumilayapti           →  charchagan
  6  Boshi bog'langan odam yuzini ushlagan
                           →  tish og'rig'i


ENG MUHIM KALIT — ARTIKLLAR!

  Kitob har pufakchada ARTIKLNI oldindan
  bosib qo'ygan. Shuning uchun javobni
  faqat rasmga emas, ARTIKLGA qarab ham
  aniqlash mumkin:

     'I've got A ...'    → a headache
                           a sore throat
     'I've got THE ...'  → the flu
     'I've got ...'      → toothache
                           (artiklsiz!)
     'I feel very ...'   → SIFAT kerak:
                           cold, tired


NEGA HAR XIL ARTIKL — KASALLIK OTLARI QOIDASI:

  1) 'A' bilan — og'riq va oddiy kasalliklar:
        a headache      (bosh og'rig'i)
        a sore throat   (tomoq og'rig'i)
        a cold          (shamollash)
        a cough         (yo'tal)
        a temperature   (harorat)

  2) 'THE' bilan — bir nechta kasallik:
        the flu         (gripp)
        the measles     (qizamiq)
        the mumps       (tepki)

  3) ARTIKLSIZ — britancha odat:
        toothache       (tish og'rig'i)
        backache        (bel og'rig'i)
        earache         (quloq og'rig'i)
        stomachache     (qorin og'rig'i)

     DIQQAT: Amerikada bularga ham 'a'
     qo'shiladi ('a toothache').
     Kitob BRITANCHA shaklni ishlatgan.


DIQQAT — 'COLD' IKKI XIL:
  'I feel very COLD.'   → SIFAT: sovqotdim
  'I've got A COLD.'    → OT: shamollab qoldim

  Bu betda 3-rasm 'I feel very ...' shaklida,
  demak SIFAT kerak → COLD (sovqotgan).
  Rasmda odam qaltirab turibdi.


DIQQAT — 'I FEEL' + SIFAT:
  'I feel very tired.'   ✓ (SIFAT)
  'I feel very tiredly.' ✗ (RAVISH — XATO)

  'feel' — his fe'li, undan keyin SIFAT keladi
  (look, smell, taste, sound bilan bir xil —
  99-betda ko'rgan edik).


DIQQAT — 'I'VE GOT' = 'I HAVE':
  'I've got a headache.'  (britancha, og'zaki)
  'I have a headache.'    (amerikacha / rasmiy)
  Ma'nosi BIR XIL.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a headache    = bosh og'rig'i
  a sore throat = tomoq og'rig'i
  sore          = og'riyotgan, yallig'langan
  a throat      = tomoq
  the flu       = gripp (influenza)
  toothache     = tish og'rig'i
  a cold        = shamollash
  tired         = charchagan

⚠⚠ ARTIKL JAVOBNI AYTIB TURADI:

  1-pufakcha: 'I've got A ......'
     → a headache

  4-pufakcha: 'I've got THE ......'
     → the flu

  6-pufakcha: 'I've got ......'
     → toothache (ARTIKLSIZ!)

  3 va 5-pufakcha: 'I feel very ......'
     → SIFAT kerak: cold, tired

  ⚠ Ya'ni taxmin qilish shart emas —
  gapning boshiga qarang.


⚠ NEGA 'TOOTHACHE' ARTIKLSIZ?

  Britaniya inglizchasida:
     I've got TOOTHACHE   (artiklsiz)
     I've got BACKACHE    (artiklsiz)
     I've got EARACHE     (artiklsiz)

  ⚠ Amerikachada esa 'A toothache'.

  ⚠ LEKIN 'a headache' — IKKALASIDA ham
  artikl bilan keladi. Shuning uchun
  1-pufakchada 'a' bor, 6-da yo'q.

tasks.whyUz:
1-rasmda erkak BOSHINI ushlab turibdi.

ARTIKL KALITI: 'I've got A ...' — demak
'a' oladigan kasallik kerak:
  a headache  ✓
  the flu     ✗ ('the' kerak)
  toothache   ✗ (artiklsiz)

head + ache = bosh + og'riq

2-rasmda erkak TOMOG'INI ushlagan, og'zi ochiq.

ARTIKL KALITI: 'I've got A ...' — 'a sore
throat' ✓

'sore' = og'riyotgan, yallig'langan (SIFAT)
'throat' = tomoq

Maslahati: 'Take some cough syrup' (9b).

tasks.prompt: 3  I feel very .......... .
tasks.whyUz:
3-rasmda erkak o'zini QUCHOQLAB, QALTIRAB
turibdi.

KALIT: 'I FEEL very ...' — 'feel' dan keyin
SIFAT keladi. Ro'yxatda ikki sifat bor:
cold va tired.
Qaltirash → COLD.

DIQQAT — 'COLD' IKKI MA'NOLI:
  'I feel COLD'   = sovqotdim (SIFAT)
  'I've got A COLD' = shamolladim (OT)
Bu yerda birinchisi.

Maslahati: 'Put a jumper on' (9b).
tasks.speak: 3  I feel very .......... .

tasks.whyUz:
4-rasmda yigit YO'TALYAPTI, qo'lini og'ziga
tutgan.

ARTIKL KALITI — ENG ANIQ BELGI:
'I've got THE ...' — ro'yxatda faqat BITTA so'z
'the' oladi: THE FLU.

  the flu    ✓
  a headache ✗ ('a' kerak)

'flu' — 'influenza' so'zining qisqartmasi.
Maslahati: 'Call the doctor and go to bed' (9b).

tasks.prompt: 5  I feel very .......... .
tasks.whyUz:
5-rasmda keksa erkak QO'LIGA SUYANIB, ko'zlari
yumilayapti.

KALIT: 'I FEEL very ...' + SIFAT.
3-rasm 'cold' ni olgan, demak bu yerda TIRED.

DIQQAT: 'tired' — SIFAT, 'tiredly' emas.
'feel' his fe'li bo'lgani uchun.

Maslahati: 'Get some sleep' (9b).
tasks.speak: 5  I feel very .......... .

tasks.whyUz:
6-rasmda odamning BOSHI BOG'LANGAN va yuzini
ushlab turibdi — tish og'rig'ining klassik
tasviri.

ARTIKL KALITI — ENG NOZIK JOY:
'I've got ...' — ARTIKL YO'Q!
Ro'yxatda artiklsiz ishlatiladigan yagona so'z:
TOOTHACHE.

BRITANCHA QOIDA:
  toothache, backache, earache, stomachache
  — artiklsiz
Amerikada: 'a toothache' ✓

tooth + ache = tish + og'riq
Maslahati: 'See the dentist' (9b).

exercises.instructionEn: Match the pictures above to the best piece of advice in the list below.
exercises.instructionUz: Yuqoridagi rasmlarni quyidagi ro'yxatdagi eng mos maslahatga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
MASLAHATLAR RO'YXATI:
  Take an aspirin.            ... 1 ... (NAMUNA)
  Put a jumper on.            .......
  See the dentist.            .......
  Get some sleep.             .......
  Take some cough syrup.      .......
  Call the doctor and go to bed. .......


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  Take an aspirin.               →  1 (NAMUNA)
  Put a jumper on.               →  3
  See the dentist.               →  6
  Get some sleep.                →  5
  Take some cough syrup.         →  2
  Call the doctor and go to bed. →  4


HAR BIRI NEGA — KASALLIK va DAVOSI:

  1  HEADACHE (bosh og'rig'i)
     →  Take an ASPIRIN.
        Aspirin — og'riq qoldiruvchi dori.
        (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

  2  SORE THROAT (tomoq og'rig'i)
     →  Take some COUGH SYRUP.
        'cough syrup' = yo'tal sharbati
        (tomoqni yumshatadi).

  3  COLD — sovqotgan
     →  Put a JUMPER on.
        'a jumper' = jemper, issiq kofta
        (britancha; Amerikada 'a sweater').

  4  FLU (gripp)
     →  CALL THE DOCTOR and GO TO BED.
        Gripp — eng jiddiy kasallik,
        shuning uchun shifokor kerak.

  5  TIRED (charchagan)
     →  Get some SLEEP.
        'get some sleep' = uxlab olmoq.

  6  TOOTHACHE (tish og'rig'i)
     →  See the DENTIST.
        'to SEE a doctor/dentist' = shifokorga
        bormoq ('to look at' EMAS).


MANTIQ — ENG JIDDIYDAN ENG YENGILGA:
  Eng jiddiy:  gripp   → shifokorni chaqirish
  O'rta:       tish    → tish shifokoriga borish
               tomoq   → sharbat ichish
               bosh    → aspirin ichish
  Eng yengil:  sovuq   → jemper kiyish
               charchoq → uxlash

  Ya'ni maslahat kasallikning JIDDIYLIGIGA
  qarab beriladi.


DIQQAT — 'PUT A JUMPER ON':
  Ajraladigan fe'l:
     'put a jumper ON'   ✓
     'put ON a jumper'   ✓
     'put IT on'         ✓
     'put on IT'         ✗

  Teskarisi — 'take off' (100-betda ko'rgandik).


DIQQAT — 'SEE THE DENTIST':
  'to SEE a doctor'   = shifokorga bormoq
  'to SEE a dentist'  = tish shifokoriga bormoq

  'see' bu yerda 'ko'rmoq' emas, 'qabuliga
  bormoq' ma'nosida.


DIQQAT — 'GET SOME SLEEP':
  'sleep' — bu yerda OT, SANALMAYDIGAN.
  'get some sleep' = uxlab olmoq.
  'a sleep' XATO.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an aspirin    = aspirin
  a jumper      = jemper (Amerikada: a sweater)
  a dentist     = tish shifokori
  cough syrup   = yo'tal sharbati
  a cough       = yo'tal (o'qilishi /kof/)
  syrup         = sharbat, shinni

tasks.left: Call the doctor and go to bed.

exercises.instructionEn: Work in two teams. Take it in turns to choose words from the list and make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point. The team with the most points is the winner.
exercises.instructionUz: Ikki jamoada ishlang. Navbatma-navbat ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab, gap tuzing. Har bir to'g'ri gap uchun bir ochko. Eng ko'p ochko to'plagan jamoa g'olib.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (12 ta so'z/ibora) — Unit 14 ning
barcha asosiy lug'ati:

  pre-packaged food, pollute, protect,
  recycling bins, light fires,
  it's a good idea to, keep fit,
  blow your nose, queue, with your mouth full,
  tell jokes, appointments


HAR BIRI UChUN NAMUNA GAP:

 1  PRE-PACKAGED FOOD (oldindan o'ralgan ovqat)
    'You shouldn't buy pre-packaged food because
     the packaging creates a lot of rubbish.'
    (99-bet, varaqadan)

 2  POLLUTE (ifloslantirmoq)
    'Cars and aerosols pollute the air.'
    (99-bet)

 3  PROTECT (himoya qilmoq)
    'There are a lot of things we can do to
     protect the environment.'
    (99-bet, varaqaning birinchi gapi)

 4  RECYCLING BINS (qayta ishlash qutilari)
    'You must put aluminium cans into recycling
     bins.'
    (99-bet)

 5  LIGHT FIRES (olov yoqmoq)
    'You mustn't light fires in forests because
     trees will burn.'
    (99-bet)

 6  IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO (... yaxshi fikr)
    'I think it's a good idea to take regular
     exercise.'
    (99-bet, Giving Advice qutisidan)

 7  KEEP FIT (tetik bo'lib turmoq)
    'If you want to keep fit, you should walk to
     work.'
    (99-bet, 6-mashq)

 8  BLOW YOUR NOSE (burnini qoqmoq)
    'In Japan, you mustn't blow your nose in
     public.'
    (100-bet)

 9  QUEUE (navbat)
    'In England, you mustn't push into a queue
     of people.'
    (100-bet)

10  WITH YOUR MOUTH FULL (og'zi to'la holda)
    'Don't talk with your mouth full — it's very
     rude.'
    (100-bet)

11  TELL JOKES (hazil aytmoq)
    'In China, you shouldn't tell jokes to people
     you don't know very well.'
    (100-bet)

12  APPOINTMENTS (uchrashuvlar)
    'You mustn't be late for appointments in
     England or in China.'
    (100-bet)


O'YIN QOIDALARI:
  • Ikki jamoa
  • NAVBATMA-NAVBAT ('take it in turns')
  • Har to'g'ri gap = 1 ochko
  • Eng ko'p ochko — g'olib


DIQQAT — RO'YXAT UNIT 14 NI QAMRAB OLADI:
  1-5   →  99-bet (atrof-muhit varaqasi)
  6-7   →  99-bet (maslahat va sog'liq)
  8-12  →  100-bet (mamlakat odoblari)

  Ya'ni bu o'yin butun unitni takrorlaydi.


DIQQAT — 'TAKE IT IN TURNS':
  'to take it in turns' = navbatma-navbat
  qilmoq (britancha).
  Amerikada: 'to take turns'.

  'It's your turn.' = Sizning navbatingiz.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a team          = jamoa
  to take it in turns = navbatma-navbat qilmoq
  a point         = ochko
  a winner        = g'olib
  to win          = yutmoq (win → WON)

tasks.en: Work in two teams. Take it in turns to choose words from the list and make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point. The team with the most points is the winner.

tasks.en: You shouldn't buy pre-packaged food because the packaging creates a lot of rubbish.
tasks.uz: Oldindan o'ralgan ovqat sotib olmasligingiz kerak, chunki o'ram ko'p axlat hosil qiladi.
tasks.note: 1-so'z: pre-packaged food (99-bet).

tasks.en: Cars and aerosols pollute the air.
tasks.uz: Mashinalar va aerozollar havoni ifloslantiradi.
tasks.note: 2-so'z: pollute (99-bet).

tasks.en: There are a lot of things we can do to protect the environment.
tasks.uz: Atrof-muhitni himoya qilish uchun qila oladigan ko'p ishlarimiz bor.
tasks.note: 3-so'z: protect — varaqaning birinchi gapi.

tasks.en: You must put aluminium cans into recycling bins.
tasks.uz: Alyuminiy bankalarni qayta ishlash qutisiga solishingiz kerak.
tasks.note: 4-so'z: recycling bins (99-bet).

tasks.en: You mustn't light fires in forests because trees will burn.
tasks.uz: O'rmonlarda olov yoqmasligingiz kerak, chunki daraxtlar yonib ketadi.
tasks.note:
5-so'z: light fires (99-bet).
light → LIT (noto'g'ri fe'l).

tasks.en: I think it's a good idea to take regular exercise.
tasks.uz: Menimcha, muntazam jismoniy mashq qilish yaxshi fikr.
tasks.note: 6-ibora: it's a good idea to + fe'l.

tasks.en: If you want to keep fit, you should walk to work.
tasks.uz: Tetik bo'lib turishni xohlasangiz, ishga piyoda borishingiz kerak.
tasks.note: 7-ibora: keep fit (99-bet, 6-mashq).

tasks.en: In Japan, you mustn't blow your nose in public.
tasks.uz: Yaponiyada odamlar oldida burningizni qoqmasligingiz kerak.
tasks.note: 8-ibora: blow your nose (100-bet).

tasks.en: In England, you mustn't push into a queue of people.
tasks.uz: Angliyada odamlar navbatiga suqilib kirmasligingiz kerak.
tasks.note: 9-so'z: queue (100-bet), o'qilishi /kyu/.

tasks.en: Don't talk with your mouth full — it's very rude.
tasks.uz: Og'zingiz to'la turib gapirmang — bu juda qo'pol.
tasks.note: 10-ibora: with your mouth full (100-bet).

tasks.en: In China, you shouldn't tell jokes to people you don't know very well.
tasks.uz: Xitoyda yaxshi tanimaydigan odamlarga hazil aytmasligingiz kerak.
tasks.note:
11-ibora: tell jokes (100-bet).
'SAY a joke' XATO.

tasks.en: You mustn't be late for appointments in England or in China.
tasks.uz: Angliyada ham, Xitoyda ham uchrashuvlarga kechikmasligingiz kerak.
tasks.note:
12-so'z: appointments (100-bet).
7b-mashqning 10-bandi ikki javobli edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the pictures to the instructions, then expand them into full sentences. Use always, never or don't.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarni ko'rsatmalarga moslang, so'ngra ularni to'liq gaplarga aylantiring. always, never yoki don't dan foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI RASM (A-G):

  A  Yo'l-yo'l soyabon ostida ona qizining
     yelkasiga quyoshdan himoya kremi surmoqda
  B  Keng somon shlyapa va ko'zoynak kiygan ayol
  C  Quyoshda yotgan, quyosh ko'zoynagi taqqan
     ayol
  D  Soyada stol atrofida OVQATLANAYOTGAN ikki
     qiz
  E  Ochiq quyoshda o'ynayotgan ikki qizcha
     (chelak-belkurak bilan)
  F  Toshloq plyajda sochilib yotgan AXLAT
     (shisha, chiqindi)
  G  Vindserfing taxtasi va rangli yelkani


YETTI KO'RSATMA:
  put suncream on/skin
  drop litter on/beach
  play in/sun between 11am & 3pm
  wear/hat
  swim after eating
  wear sunglasses
  swim near windsurfers


BARCHA JAVOBLAR (rasm + to'liq gap):

  put suncream on/skin  →  A  (KITOBDA NAMUNA)
     ALWAYS PUT SUNCREAM ON YOUR SKIN.

  drop litter on/beach  →  F
     NEVER DROP LITTER ON THE BEACH.
     (yoki: DON'T DROP LITTER ON THE BEACH.)

  play in/sun between 11am & 3pm  →  E
     NEVER PLAY IN THE SUN BETWEEN 11AM AND 3PM.

  wear/hat  →  B
     ALWAYS WEAR A HAT.

  swim after eating  →  D
     NEVER SWIM AFTER EATING.

  wear sunglasses  →  C
     ALWAYS WEAR SUNGLASSES.

  swim near windsurfers  →  G
     NEVER SWIM NEAR WINDSURFERS.


DIQQAT — KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Birinchi katakchaga 'A' harfi ALLAQAChON
  yozib qo'yilgan.


UCh IJOBIY, TO'RT SALBIY:

  ALWAYS (3 ta) — nima QILISh kerak:
     put suncream on your skin
     wear a hat
     wear sunglasses

  NEVER / DON'T (4 ta) — nima QILMASLIK kerak:
     drop litter on the beach
     play in the sun between 11am and 3pm
     swim after eating
     swim near windsurfers


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — ALWAYS MI, NEVER MI:

  Ko'rsatma FOYDALI bo'lsa   →  ALWAYS
  Ko'rsatma XAVFLI bo'lsa    →  NEVER / DON'T

  Masalan:
     krem surish — himoya qiladi  → ALWAYS
     axlat tashlash — zarar        → NEVER


KO'RSATMALARNI TO'LIQ GAPGA AYLANTIRISh:

  Kitobda qisqartma shakl berilgan
  (chiziqcha bilan). To'liq gapda ARTIKL va
  EGALIK olmoshi qo'shiladi:

     put suncream ON/SKIN
       →  put suncream ON YOUR SKIN

     wear/HAT
       →  wear A HAT

     drop litter ON/BEACH
       →  drop litter ON THE BEACH

     play IN/SUN
       →  play IN THE SUN

  DIQQAT: 'the sun', 'the beach' — 'THE' bilan
  (yagona narsalar).
  'a hat' — 'A' bilan (bir dona shlyapa).
  'your skin' — EGALIK olmoshi.


DIQQAT — 'SUNGLASSES' DOIM KO'PLIKDA:
  'sunglasses'  ✓
  'a sunglass'  ✗
  Bitta juftlik: 'a pair of sunglasses'

  Shu kabi: glasses, trousers, scissors,
  slippers, chopsticks.


DIQQAT — 'BETWEEN ... AND ...':
  'between 11am AND 3pm'  ✓
  'between 11am TO 3pm'   ✗

  'between' DOIM 'and' bilan keladi.

   u ham to'g'ri.)


DIQQAT — 'AFTER + -ING':

  Predlogdan keyin fe'l -ING oladi
  (100-betdagi 'before smoking' bilan bir xil).

  litter          = axlat (ko'chadagi)
  to drop litter  = axlat tashlamoq
  sunglasses      = quyosh ko'zoynagi
  a windsurfer    = vindserfingchi
  to expand       = kengaytirmoq

exercises.explanationUz:
SABABLAR RO'YXATI (7 ta):
  • The sun is very dangerous then.
  • It protects your skin from the hot sun.
  • It protects your head from the sun.
  • There is always a danger of accidents.
  • It looks and smells horrible.
  • It is dangerous to swim with a full stomach.
  • They protect your eyes from the sun.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  put suncream on/skin
     →  It protects your SKIN from the hot sun.
        (KITOBDA STRELKA CHIZILGAN — NAMUNA)

  drop litter on/beach
     →  It looks and smells horrible.

  play in/sun between 11am & 3pm
     →  The sun is very dangerous THEN.

  wear/hat
     →  It protects your HEAD from the sun.

  swim after eating
     →  It is dangerous to swim with a FULL
        STOMACH.

  wear sunglasses
     →  THEY protect your EYES from the sun.

  swim near windsurfers
     →  There is always a danger of ACCIDENTS.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — KALIT SO'ZLAR:

  SKIN (teri)      →  suncream (krem teriga
                      suriladi)
  HEAD (bosh)      →  hat (shlyapa boshga
                      kiyiladi)
  EYES (ko'z)      →  sunglasses (ko'zoynak
                      ko'zga taqiladi)

  Uchta 'protect' gapi tananing UCh a'zosini
  nomlaydi — shuning uchun adashish mumkin
  emas.

  FULL STOMACH (to'la oshqozon)
                   →  swim after eating
  ACCIDENTS (baxtsiz hodisa)
                   →  windsurfers (to'qnashuv)
  LOOKS AND SMELLS HORRIBLE
                   →  litter (axlat)
  THEN (o'shanda)  →  between 11am & 3pm
                      (vaqt haqida)


DIQQAT — 'IT' va 'THEY' FARQI ENG MUHIM KALIT:

  'IT protects your skin ...'   →  suncream
                                   (BIRLIK)
  'IT protects your head ...'   →  a hat
                                   (BIRLIK)
  'THEY protect your eyes ...'  →  sunglasses
                                   (KO'PLIK!)

  Ya'ni 'THEY' shakli o'zi aytib turibdi:
  javob KO'PLIK ot bo'lishi kerak.
  Ro'yxatdagi yagona ko'plik — SUNGLASSES.

  Va fe'l ham farq qiladi:
     it protectS  (III shaxs birlik → -S)
     they protect (ko'plik → -S YO'Q)


DIQQAT — 'THEN' SO'ZI:
  'The sun is very dangerous THEN.'
  'then' = o'sha vaqtda

  Demak sabab VAQT haqidagi ko'rsatmaga
  tegishli: 'between 11am & 3pm'.

  Nega o'shanda xavfli? Chunki quyosh eng
  tik turadi va nurlari eng kuchli bo'ladi.


DIQQAT — 'A FULL STOMACH':
  'to swim with a FULL STOMACH'
  = to'la oshqozon bilan suzmoq

  100-betdagi 'with your mouth full' bilan
  bir xil qurilma: 'with + ot + sifat'.


DIQQAT — 'PROTECT ... FROM ...':
  'protect + [nima] + FROM + [nimadan]'
     It protects your skin FROM the sun.
     ('protect from' — predlog 'from')


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to protect ... from ... = ...ni ...dan himoya
                            qilmoq
  a danger      = xavf
  dangerous     = xavfli
  an accident   = baxtsiz hodisa
  a stomach     = oshqozon (o'qilishi /stamak/)
  horrible      = dahshatli
  then          = o'shanda, o'sha vaqtda

exercises.explanationUz:
1-14 UNITLARNI QAMRAB OLUVCHI TAKRORLASh.
Har bandda BITTA so'z xato — uni to'g'risi
bilan almashtirish kerak.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  in    →  OF      (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)
   2  because → SO
   3  There →  IT
   4  must  →  MUSTN'T
   5  as    →  THAN
   6  fastly →  FAST
   7  from  →  TO
   8  Will  →  WOULD
   9  mine  →  MY
  10  my    →  MINE
  11  Do    →  CAN
  12  Where →  WHAT
  13  for   →  TO
  14  some  →  A


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 1  'It's the most comfortable flat IN all.'
    → 'the most comfortable flat OF all'
    USTUN DARAJADA guruh 'OF' bilan beriladi:
       the best OF all
       the biggest OF the three
    (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA — 'of' yozib qo'yilgan)

 2  'Tonia is saving some money BECAUSE she
     can go on holiday next year.'
    → '... SO she can go on holiday next year.'
    Tonia pul yig'yapti — MAQSAD uchun
    (ta'tilga borish uchun), sabab uchun emas.
    'because' — SABAB (nima uchun sodir bo'ldi)
    'so' — MAQSAD/NATIJA (nima uchun qilyapti)
    ('so that' ham to'g'ri, lekin bir so'z
     kerak bo'lsa — 'so')

 3  'THERE will be hot and sunny at the
     weekend.'
    → 'IT will be hot and sunny at the weekend.'
    Ob-havo haqida gapirganda ega — 'IT'.
       It is cold.  It will be sunny.
    'There is/are' — MAVJUDLIK uchun:
       'There will be a storm.' ✓ (ot bilan)
       'There will be sunny.'   ✗ (sifat bilan)

 4  'You MUST talk during the test.'
    → 'You MUSTN'T talk during the test.'
    Nazorat ishi paytida gapirish TAQIQLANGAN.
    'must talk' = 'gapirishingiz shart' —
    mantiqan noto'g'ri.

 5  'This car is cheaper AS that one.'
    → 'This car is cheaper THAN that one.'
    QIYOSIY daraja DOIM 'THAN' bilan:
       cheaper THAN, bigger THAN, better THAN
    'AS ... AS' — TENGLIK uchun:
       'as cheap AS that one' (bir xil narxda)

 6  'Don't talk so FASTLY.'
    → 'Don't talk so FAST.'
    'FAST' — ham SIFAT, ham RAVISH.
    'fastly' degan so'z INGLIZ TILIDA YO'Q!
    Shu kabi: hard, late, early, high
       'work HARD'  ✓  'work HARDLY' — boshqa
                        ma'no (deyarli emas)

 7  'My school is close FROM my house.'
    → 'My school is close TO my house.'
    'close TO' — turg'un birikma.
    'far FROM' — teskarisi 'from' bilan!
       close TO ✓   /   far FROM ✓
       close FROM ✗  /  far TO ✗

 8  'WILL you like a cup of tea?'
    → 'WOULD you like a cup of tea?'
    'Would you like ...?' — taklif qilish
    (choy, ovqat va h.k.).
    'Will you like ...?' = 'kelajakda yoqadimi?'
    — boshqa ma'no.

 9  'She's MINE niece.'
    → 'She's MY niece.'
    OT oldida — MY (egalik SIFATI)
    OT o'rniga — MINE (egalik OLMOSHI)
       my niece ✓  /  mine niece ✗

10  'That's not your coat. Its MY.'
    → 'It's MINE.'
    OT o'rniga — MINE.
    9-bandning TESKARISI: kitob ataylab ikkalasini
    yonma-yon bergan.
    ⚠ DIQQAT: bu bandda AKTUALDA IKKI xato bor —
    'Its' ham 'It's' bo'lishi kerak (apostrof).
    Kitobda bitta katakcha bor, shuning uchun
    asosiy javob MINE.

11  'I can't swim. DO you?'
    → 'CAN you?'
    Qisqa savol ASOSIY gapdagi yordamchi/modal
    fe'lni takrorlaydi:
       'I CAN'T swim. CAN you?'
       'I DON'T like it. DO you?'
       'I AM tired. ARE you?'

12  'I'm Italian. WHERE about you?'
    → 'WHAT about you?'
    'What about you?' = Sizchi?
    Turg'un ibora — 'where' bilan ishlatilmaydi.

13  'Banks are open from 9 am FOR 3 pm.'
    → 'from 9 am TO 3 pm'
    'FROM ... TO ...' — vaqt oralig'i.
    'for' — davomiylik ('for 3 hours').
    Yana: 'from ... UNTIL/TILL ...' ham to'g'ri.

14  'I'd like SOME bottle of water, please.'
    → 'A bottle of water'
    'bottle' — SANALADIGAN va BIRLIKDA,
    demak 'A' kerak.
    'some' ko'plik yoki sanalmaydigan bilan:
       some bottles ✓  /  some water ✓
       some bottle  ✗


GURUHLAR BO'YIChA (qaysi unitdan):

  ARTIKL/EGALIK:  9, 10, 14
  QIYOSLASh:      1, 5
  PREDLOG:        7, 13
  MODAL:          4, 11
  RAVISh:         6
  OB-HAVO 'IT':   3
  BOG'LOVChI:     2
  TURG'UN IBORA:  8, 12


YANGI SO'ZLAR:

  to save money = pul yig'moq
  during        = ... davomida
  cheap         = arzon
  close to      = ... ga yaqin
  far from      = ... dan uzoq
  a niece       = jiyan (qiz)
  a nephew      = jiyan (o'g'il)
  a coat        = palto
  Italian       = italiyalik
  a bottle      = shisha, butilka

exercises.explanationUz:
MATN — AMAZON O'RMONI HAQIDA

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  THE      7  THE
   2  —        8  THE
   3  —        9  —
   4  THE     10  THE
   5  THE     11  THE
   6  THE     12  —

  Ya'ni: 'the' KERAK — 1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 11
         'the' KERAK EMAS — 2, 3, 9, 12


TO'LIQ MATN (javoblar bilan):

  THE Amazon Rainforest is in — Brazil,
  — South America. It lies at the beginning of
  THE Amazon River. THE Amazon River is THE
  longest river in the world.

  THE Amazon Rainforest is a very beautiful
  place. A lot of animals, birds and insects
  live in it. There are also many trees and
  plants.

  THE forest has a serious problem. People are
  cutting down too many of its trees. As a
  result, many of its plants and animals are
  dying. — Trees and plants are very important
  to the environment. Scientists say that THE
  world is in danger because of THE destruction
  of — rainforests.


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:
  Amazon tropik o'rmoni Braziliyada, Janubiy
  Amerikada joylashgan. U Amazonka daryosining
  boshlanish qismida yotadi. Amazonka —
  dunyodagi eng uzun daryo.

  Amazon o'rmoni juda go'zal joy. Unda ko'plab
  hayvon, qush va hasharotlar yashaydi. Yana
  ko'p daraxt va o'simliklar bor.

  O'rmonning jiddiy muammosi bor. Odamlar uning
  juda ko'p daraxtini kesyapti. Natijada uning
  ko'plab o'simlik va hayvonlari nobud
  bo'lmoqda. Daraxt va o'simliklar atrof-muhit
  uchun juda muhim. Olimlar aytishicha, tropik
  o'rmonlarning yo'q qilinishi tufayli dunyo
  xavf ostida.


'THE' QO'YILADIGAN HOLLAR (bu matndan):

  1) O'RMON, DARYO, DENGIZ, OKEAN nomlari:
        THE Amazon Rainforest  (1, 7)
        THE Amazon River       (4, 5)
        the Atlantic Ocean, the Nile

  2) USTUN DARAJA:
        THE longest river      (6)
        the best, the biggest

  3) ALLAQAChON AYTILGAN narsa:
        THE forest             (8)
        (yuqorida 'Amazon Rainforest' deyilgan
         edi — endi 'o'sha o'rmon')

  4) YAGONA narsalar:
        THE world              (10)
        the sun, the moon, the sky

  5) 'THE ... OF ...' qurilmasi:
        THE destruction OF rainforests  (11)
        the top of the hill


'THE' QO'YILMAYDIGAN HOLLAR (bu matndan):

  1) MAMLAKAT nomlari:
        — Brazil               (2)
        (ISTISNO: the USA, the UK,
         the Netherlands)

  2) QIT'A nomlari:
        — South America        (3)
        (— Europe, — Africa, — Asia)

  3) UMUMIY ma'nodagi KO'PLIK ot:
        — Trees and plants are important  (9)
        — rainforests          (12)
        (barcha daraxtlar, barcha o'rmonlar
         haqida — aniq emas)


ENG NOZIK JOY — 9 va 12:
  9   '— TREES and plants are very important'
      → BARCHA daraxtlar haqida (umumiy)
      → 'the' YO'Q

  12  'destruction of — RAINFORESTS'
      → BARCHA tropik o'rmonlar haqida
      → 'the' YO'Q

  LEKIN 8-bandda:
      'THE forest has a serious problem'
      → aynan AMAZON o'rmoni haqida (yuqorida
        aytilgan)
      → 'the' KERAK

  Ya'ni: UMUMIY → the yo'q;  ANIQ → the bor.


BOG'LIQLIK — UNIT 14 MAVZUSI:
  Matn ATROF-MUHIT haqida — Coursebook

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the comparative or superlative forms.
exercises.instructionUz: Qiyosiy yoki ustun daraja shakllarini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  MORE BEAUTIFUL
   2  NOISIER
   3  OLDER ... THE OLDEST
   4  THE LARGEST
   5  MORE EXPENSIVE
   6  CLEVERER
   7  BIGGER
   8  TALLER ... THE TALLEST
   9  THE MOST LUXURIOUS
  10  QUIETER


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — IKKI SAVOL:

  1-SAVOL: QIYOSIY mi, USTUN mi?
     'THAN' bor  →  QIYOSIY  (-er / more)
     'OF ALL' yoki 'IN THE ...' bor
                 →  USTUN    (the -est / the most)

  2-SAVOL: SIFAT UZUNMI?
     1 bo'g'in yoki -y bilan tugasa
                 →  -ER / -EST
     2+ bo'g'in   →  MORE / THE MOST


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 1  beautiful (3 bo'g'in) + 'than'
    → MORE BEAUTIFUL than

 2  noisy (-y bilan tugaydi) + 'than'
    → y → I + ER = NOISIER than

 3  IKKI BO'SHLIQ:
    'old ... THAN'      → OLDER (qiyosiy)
    'old ... OF ALL'    → THE OLDEST (ustun)

 4  'large ... IN THE WORLD' → ustun
    'large' oxirida 'e' bor → faqat -ST
    → THE LARGEST

 5  expensive (3 bo'g'in) + 'than'
    → MORE EXPENSIVE than

 6  clever (2 bo'g'in, lekin -er bilan tugaydi)
    + 'than'
    → CLEVERER than
    (Ba'zi kitoblarda 'MORE CLEVER' ham qabul
     qilinadi — ikkalasi ham to'g'ri, lekin
     'cleverer' ko'proq ishlatiladi.)

 7  big (1 bo'g'in, unli+undosh) + 'than'
    → G IKKILANADI: BIGGER than

 8  IKKI BO'SHLIQ:
    'tall ... THAN'     → TALLER (qiyosiy)
    'tall ... OF ALL'   → THE TALLEST (ustun)

 9  luxurious (4 bo'g'in) + 'IN THE AREA'
    → ustun, uzun sifat
    → THE MOST LUXURIOUS

10  quiet (2 bo'g'in) + 'much ... THAN'
    → QUIETER than
    ('much' — qiyosiy darajani kuchaytiradi:
     'much quieter' = ancha tinchroq)


YASALISh QOIDALARI — TO'LIQ JADVAL:

  1 BO'G'IN:
     tall  → tallER  → the tallEST
     old   → oldER   → the oldEST

  1 BO'G'IN, oxiri UNLI+UNDOSh:
     big   → bigGER  → the bigGEST
     hot   → hotTER  → the hotTEST
     (oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI)

  Oxiri 'E' bilan:
     large → largER  → the largEST
     nice  → nicER   → the nicEST
     (faqat -R / -ST qo'shiladi)

  Oxiri 'Y' bilan:
     noisy → noisIER → the noisIEST
     easy  → easIER  → the easIEST
     (y → I + ER/EST)

  2+ BO'G'IN:
     beautiful → MORE beautiful
               → THE MOST beautiful
     expensive → MORE expensive
               → THE MOST expensive

  NOTO'G'RI ShAKLLAR:
     good  → better → the best
     bad   → worse  → the worst
     far   → further → the furthest


DIQQAT — USTUN DARAJADA 'THE' ShART:
     'the oldest of all'   ✓
     'oldest of all'       ✗


DIQQAT — QIYOSIYDA 'THAN' ShART:
     'older THAN the Colosseum'  ✓
     'older AS the Colosseum'    ✗
     (62-betdagi 9-mashqning 5-bandi!)


DIQQAT — 6-BANDDAGI 'THAN ME':
  'My sister is cleverer THAN ME.'
  Og'zaki nutqda 'than me' ✓
  Rasmiy yozuvda 'than I am' ✓
  ('than I' — juda rasmiy)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  noisy      = shovqinli
  a motorbike = mototsikl
  the Parthenon = Parfenon (Afinadagi ibodatxona)
  the Colosseum = Kolizey (Rimdagi amfiteatr)
  the Pyramids  = Piramidalar (Misr)
  a desert   = sahro
  clever     = aqlli
  a neighbour = qo'shni
  luxurious  = hashamatli
  an area    = hudud
  the country = qishloq (bu ma'noda)
  quiet      = tinch

('MORE CLEVER' ham to'g'ri hisoblanadi,
 lekin 'cleverer' ko'proq ishlatiladi.)

tasks.prompt: 9  The Grand is ....................... (luxurious) hotel in the area.

'IN THE AREA' bor → USTUN daraja.

tasks.whyUz:

'quiet' — 2 bo'g'in, lekin qisqa sifat sifatida
-ER oladi:
  quiet → quietER

DIQQAT — 'MUCH':
'MUCH quieter' = ANCHA tinchroq.
'much' qiyosiy darajani KUCHAYTIRADI

'the country' bu yerda = QISHLOQ (shahar

exercises.instructionEn: Choose the correct item.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  B (Can)
   2  A (Don't)
   3  C (is cooking)
   4  B (a)
   5  A (but)
   6  A (Can)
   7  C (Who)
   8  B (on)
   9  C (drives)
  10  A (do)


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 1  '... I have a glass of water, PLEASE?'
    KALIT: 'PLEASE' — bu ILTIMOS.
    Ruxsat so'rash → CAN.
    'Must I have ...?' = 'ichishim shartmi?'
    'Should I have ...?' = 'ichishim kerakmi?'
    → B (Can)
    (62-betdagi 9-mashqning 14-bandi ham shu
     gap edi!)

 2  '... drop litter in the street.'
    KALIT: gapda EGA YO'Q!
    'Shouldn't' va 'Mustn't' dan oldin EGA
    kerak ('You shouldn't ...').
    Egasiz ishlatiladigan yagona shakl —
    BUYRUQ MAYLI: 'DON'T'.
    → A (Don't)

 3  'He ... dinner AT THE MOMENT.'
    KALIT: 'AT THE MOMENT' = ayni damda
    → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    → C (is cooking)

 4  'There is ... MAN at the door.'
    'man' — undosh tovush bilan boshlanadi
    → 'A'.
    'an' faqat UNLI tovush oldidan.
    'the' — aniq odam haqida bo'lardi, lekin
    'There is' YANGI narsani tanishtiradi.
    → B (a)

 5  'I did the shopping yesterday, ... I didn't
     clean the house.'
    KALIT: ikki qism QARAMA-QARShI
    (bir ishni qildim, ikkinchisini qilmadim).
    → A (but)

 6  '... I use your pen?'
    Ruxsat so'rash → CAN.
    'Can't I ...?' va 'Mustn't I ...?' —
    savol sifatida g'alati.
    → A (Can)

 7  '... did you go on holiday WITH?'
    KALIT: 'WITH' — kim BILAN?
    Odam haqida so'ralganda → WHO.
    'Which' — tanlov ichidan;
    'When' — vaqt.
    → C (Who)

 8  'take the first turning ... your left.'
    'ON your left/right' — turg'un ibora.
    → B (on)

 9  'He ... to work EVERY DAY.'
    KALIT: 'EVERY DAY' — takrorlanuvchi harakat
    → PRESENT SIMPLE.
    'He' — III shaxs birlik → -S qo'shiladi.
    → C (drives)

10  'Do they live in a flat?' 'Yes, they ...'
    QISQA JAVOB savoldagi yordamchi fe'lni
    takrorlaydi:
       'DO they ...?' → 'Yes, they DO.'
    'does' — 'he/she/it' uchun;
    'don't' — savolga ZID (Yes deyilgan).
    → A (do)


MASHQNING UCh ASOSIY KALITI:

  A) VAQT IBORASI zamonni belgilaydi:
        'at the moment' → Present Continuous (3)
        'every day'     → Present Simple (9)
        'yesterday'     → Past Simple (5)

  B) QISQA JAVOB savolni takrorlaydi (10)

  C) TURG'UN IBORALAR:
        'on your left' (8)
        'Can I ... please?' (1, 6)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a glass of water = bir stakan suv
  to drop litter   = axlat tashlamoq
  at the moment    = ayni damda
  to do the shopping = xarid qilmoq
  a turning        = burilish (yo'lda)
  on your left     = chap tomoningizda
  to go along      = ... bo'ylab bormoq
  a flat           = kvartira

tasks.prompt: 1  ................. I have a glass of water, please?  A Must  B Can  C Should
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'PLEASE' — bu ILTIMOS, majburiyat emas.
Ruxsat so'rash → CAN.

'Must I have a glass of water?' =
'suv ichishim SHARTMI?' — ma'nosiz.

Grammar 61-bet, 4-mashqning 5-bandi ham
aynan shu gap edi.

tasks.prompt: 2  ................. drop litter in the street.  A Don't  B Shouldn't  C Mustn't
tasks.whyUz:
ENG MUHIM KALIT: gapda EGA YO'Q!

'Shouldn't' va 'Mustn't' dan OLDIN ega kerak:
  'YOU shouldn't drop litter.' ✓
  'Shouldn't drop litter.'     ✗

Egasiz ishlatiladigan yagona shakl —
BUYRUQ MAYLI: 'DON'T + fe'l'.

Coursebook 99-bet, varaqa:
'Do not drop rubbish in the street.'

tasks.prompt: 3  He ................. dinner at the moment.  A cooks  B cooked  C is cooking
tasks.promptUz: U ayni damda kechki ovqat pishiryapti.

VAQT KALITI: 'AT THE MOMENT' = ayni damda
→ PRESENT CONTINUOUS (is/are + -ing).

'cooks' — Present Simple (odat, har kuni)
'cooked' — Past Simple (o'tgan zamon)

Bu ikkalasi 'at the moment' bilan mos kelmaydi.

tasks.prompt: 4  There is ................. man at the door.  A an  B a  C the
tasks.whyUz:
'man' UNDOSH tovush /m/ bilan boshlanadi → 'A'.
'an' faqat UNLI tovush oldidan
(an apple, an hour).

'the' bo'lmaydi, chunki 'There is ...'
YANGI, noma'lum narsani tanishtiradi.

tasks.prompt: 5  I did the shopping yesterday, ................. I didn't clean the house.  A but  B to  C when
tasks.promptUz: Kecha xarid qildim, lekin uyni tozalamadim.
tasks.whyUz:
MANTIQ KALITI: ikki qism QARAMA-QARSHI —
bir ishni qildim, ikkinchisini QILMADIM.

Qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchisi → BUT.

'to' — maqsad; 'when' — vaqt. Ikkalasi ham
bu yerda mos kelmaydi.

tasks.prompt: 6  ................. I use your pen?  A Can  B Can't  C Mustn't
tasks.whyUz:
Ruxsat SO'RASH → CAN I ...?

'Can't I use your pen?' — bu norozilik
ohangi ('nega foydalanolmayman?').
'Mustn't I ...?' — juda g'alati.

1-band bilan bir xil qoida.

tasks.prompt: 7  ................. did you go on holiday with?  A Which  B When  C Who
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: gap oxiridagi 'WITH' — kim BILAN?

ODAM haqida so'ralganda → WHO.
  'Who did you go with?' ✓

'Which' — berilgan tanlov ichidan
  ('Which hotel did you stay at?')
'When' — vaqt ('When did you go?')

DIQQAT: predlog gap OXIRIDA qoladi —
og'zaki inglizchada odatiy hol.

tasks.prompt: 8  Go along High Street and take the first turning ................. your left.  A in  B on  C to
tasks.promptUz: High Street bo'ylab boring va chap tomondagi birinchi burilishga kiring.
tasks.whyUz:
'ON your left / ON your right' — TURG'UN
ibora (yo'l ko'rsatishda).

  'on your left'  ✓
  'in your left'  ✗
  'to your left'  — ba'zan ishlatiladi, lekin
                   'on' standart

'a turning' = burilish (yo'ldagi).
'go ALONG a street' = ko'cha bo'ylab bormoq.

tasks.prompt: 9  He ................. to work every day.  A is driving  B drove  C drives
tasks.promptUz: U har kuni ishga mashinada boradi.
tasks.whyUz:
VAQT KALITI: 'EVERY DAY' — takrorlanuvchi,
odatiy harakat → PRESENT SIMPLE.

'He' — III shaxs BIRLIK → fe'lga -S:
  he driveS ✓

'is driving' — ayni damdagi harakat
('at the moment' bilan ishlatilardi).
'drove' — o'tgan zamon.

tasks.prompt: 10  'Do they live in a flat?' 'Yes, they ................. .'  A do  B does  C don't
tasks.whyUz:
QISQA JAVOB savoldagi YORDAMCHI FE'LNI
takrorlaydi:
  'DO they live ...?' → 'Yes, they DO.'

'does' — faqat he/she/it uchun
  ('Does he live ...?' → 'Yes, he does.')

'don't' — 'YES' bilan ZID:
  'Yes, they don't' — mantiqsiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavs ichidagi fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh DIALOG — BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  A: I like your new dress, Tina.
    B: Oh, thanks. I BOUGHT it yesterday.
    A: WAS it very expensive?
    B: Yes, it WAS.
    A: ARE YOU GOING TO WEAR it to the party
       tonight?
    B: Yes, I AM.

 2  A: Hi, Sue. It'S Anne. What ARE YOU DOING
       this evening?
    B: Oh, hello Anne. Well, I'M GOING TO STAY
       at home and relax.
    A: Okay. I'LL CALL you tomorrow.

 3  A: How WAS your holiday, Molly?
    B: Oh, it WAS terrible! The hotel WAS very
       expensive and the beach WAS dirty.
    A: What about the weather?
    B: It RAINED every day.
    A: WAS the food good?
    B: No, it TASTED awful!

 4  A: I'M hungry.
    B: What about a sandwich?
    A: No, thanks. I WANT something hot.
       I think I'LL HAVE a bowl of soup.

 5  A: There WAS a great film on TV yesterday.
       DID YOU SEE it?
    B: No, I DIDN'T.


ZAMONLAR QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  PAST SIMPLE — 'yesterday', tugagan voqea
     bought, was, rained, tasted, did you see,
     didn't

  PRESENT SIMPLE — hozirgi holat, his-tuyg'u
     it's (Anne), I'm (hungry), I want

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS — ayni damda
     What are you doing (this evening)?

  BE GOING TO — REJA (oldindan o'ylangan)
     Are you going to wear ...?
     I'm going to stay at home

  WILL — AYNI DAMDAGI qaror
     I'll call you tomorrow
     I think I'll have a bowl of soup


1-DIALOG BATAFSIL:

  'I BOUGHT it yesterday' — 'YESTERDAY' →
     Past Simple. buy → BOUGHT.

  'WAS it very expensive?' — o'tmishdagi
     narx haqida → Past Simple.

  'Yes, it WAS.' — qisqa javob savolni
     takrorlaydi.

  'ARE YOU GOING TO WEAR it tonight?'
     ENG MUHIM KALIT: keyingi javob
     'Yes, I AM' — ya'ni javobda 'BE' fe'li!
     Demak savol ham 'BE' bilan boshlanishi
     kerak → 'ARE you going to wear'.
     ('Will you wear ...?' bo'lsa javob
      'Yes, I WILL' bo'lardi.)

  'Yes, I AM.' — 'Are you going to ...?' ga
     qisqa javob.


2-DIALOG BATAFSIL:

  'It'S Anne.' — telefonda o'zini tanishtirish
     turg'un shakli. ('It's + ism')

  'What ARE YOU DOING this evening?'
     Kelajakdagi reja haqida so'rash —
     Present Continuous ishlatiladi.

  'I'M GOING TO STAY at home' — REJA
     ('I'm staying' ham to'g'ri).

  'I'LL CALL you tomorrow' — AYNI DAMDA
     qabul qilingan qaror → WILL.
     ('Okay' so'zi qarorning hozir
      qabul qilinganini ko'rsatadi.)


3-DIALOG BATAFSIL:
  Butun dialog TUGAGAN ta'til haqida →
  hammasi PAST SIMPLE:
     How WAS your holiday?
     it WAS terrible
     The hotel WAS expensive
     the beach WAS dirty
     It RAINED every day
     WAS the food good?
     it TASTED awful

  DIQQAT: 'every day' bo'lsa ham Past Simple —
  chunki ta'til TUGAGAN ('It rained every day'
  = o'sha ta'tilda har kuni yog'di).


4-DIALOG BATAFSIL:
  'I'M hungry' — hozirgi holat → Present Simple.
  'I WANT something hot' — his/xohish →
     Present Simple ('I am wanting' XATO!).
  'I THINK I'LL HAVE a bowl of soup' —
     'I think' + WILL = ayni damdagi qaror.

  DIQQAT — 'WANT' DAVOM ETMAYDI:
     Xohish, his, fikr bildiruvchi fe'llar
     Continuous shaklda ishlatilmaydi:
        want, like, love, hate, know,
        understand, believe, need
     'I am wanting' ✗


5-DIALOG BATAFSIL:
  'There WAS a great film on TV YESTERDAY'
     → Past Simple ('there is' ning o'tgan
       zamoni).
  'DID YOU SEE it?' → Past Simple savoli
     (did + ASOSIY shakl).
  'No, I DIDN'T.' → qisqa javob.

  DIQQAT: 'Did you SAW it?' XATO —
  'did' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY shaklda!


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a dress     = ko'ylak
  to wear     = kiymoq (wear → WORE)
  to relax    = dam olmoq
  terrible    = dahshatli
  dirty       = iflos
  to taste    = ta'mi bo'lmoq
  awful       = juda yomon
  hungry      = och
  a sandwich  = buterbrod
  a bowl of soup = bir kosa sho'rva

wordFormation.ruleUz: BUYRUQ GAPLAR — DOS va DON'TS (1 va 3-mashqlar)

items.base: Don't keep pets in your room.
I think it's a good idea to ...
I don't think it's a good idea to ...

wordFormation.explanationUz: Bu betning eng muhim qoidasi: har kasallik OZ artiklini oladi.
'ache' = og'riq. Tana a'zosiga qo'shilib kasallik nomini yasaydi.
Grammatika qutisidan. Hammasidan keyin ASOSIY shakl.

items.derivedUz: You can listen to the radio.

wordFormation.explanationUz: Har bir dialog sarlavhasi modalni belgilaydi.
Hammasidan keyin ASOSIY shakl; -S qo'shilmaydi; 'do' kerak emas.

items.base: You DON'T HAVE TO park here.

wordFormation.explanationUz: Ikki shakl: DON'T + fe'l, yoki NO + -ING.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Use buses and trams. Don't keep pets in your room.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Avtobus va tramvaydan foydalaning. Xonangizda uy hayvonlarini saqlamang.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Buyruq gapda EGA YO'Q.
DOS — tasdiq, DON'TS — 'don't' bilan.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Never eat in class. Always have your passport with you.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sinfda hech qachon ovqat yemang. Doim pasportingizni yoningizda olib yuring.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'never' va 'always' buyruqni KUCHAYTIRADI.
'never' — 'don't' dan kuchliroq taqiq.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Try not to buy pre-packaged food.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Oldindan o'ralgan ovqat sotib olmaslikka harakat qiling.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Eng YUMSHOQ inkor maslahat.
'try not to' — qat'iy taqiq emas, tavsiya.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I can see a forest in picture A. I can see plastic bottles in picture B.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: A rasmida o'rmonni ko'raman. B rasmida plastik shishalarni ko'raman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Rasm tasvirlash qolipi.
'in picture A' — artikl YO'Q (harf bilan).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Never light fires in forests. Trees will burn.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'rmonlarda hech qachon olov yoqmang. Daraxtlar yonib ketadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Varaqaning butun tuzilishi shu:
har bandda 1-gap KO'RSATMA, 2-gap SABAB.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The leaflet says, 'Try not to buy pre-packaged food.' Why? — Because the packaging creates a lot of rubbish.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Varaqada '...' deyilgan. Nega? — Chunki o'ram ko'p axlat hosil qiladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
4b-mashqning qolipi.
'because + EGA + FE'L' (ot emas!).
'because OF + OT' — boshqa qurilma.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You should drink a lot of water. You shouldn't use aerosols.

should — hech qanday shaxsda -S QO'SHILMAYDI.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Why don't you take regular exercise?

sentencePatterns.formula: I (DON'T) THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO + [ASOSIY fe'l] + ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I think it's a good idea to walk to work. I don't think it's a good idea to use aerosols.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menimcha, ishga piyoda borish yaxshi fikr. Menimcha, aerozollardan foydalanish yaxshi fikr emas.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'idea TO + fe'l' — 'idea USING' XATO.
Inkor BOSH gapga qo'yiladi: 'I DON'T think'.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It looks and smells horrible.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U dahshatli ko'rinadi va dahshatli hidlaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
His fe'llaridan keyin RAVISH emas, SIFAT:
look, smell, taste, sound, feel, seem.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When in China, don't kiss anyone in public. When in England, you should say 'please' and 'thank you'.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xitoyda odamlar oldida hech kimni o'pmang. Angliyada 'iltimos' va 'rahmat' deyishingiz kerak.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'when in X' = 'when you are in X' —
ega va 'to be' tushirib qoldirilgan.
Ixcham va rasmiy shakl.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It is polite to take a gift. It's very rude to kiss anyone in public.

sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Baholovchi qurilma.
'It is polite TAKING' — XATO.

'to' YO'Q: 'makes people TO be upset' XATO.
Shu kabi: It makes me happy.

'make sure' dan keyin butun gap keladi.
'that' tushirib qoldirilishi mumkin.

sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Holat bildiruvchi qurilma:
with your mouth full, with your eyes closed,
with the door open.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Never push into a queue of people or they'll get angry.

sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Boshim og'riyapti. Grippga chalindim. Tishim og'riyapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Har kasallik O'Z artiklini oladi:
  a — headache, sore throat, cold, cough
  the — flu, measles

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I feel very cold. I feel very tired.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Juda sovqotdim. Juda charchadim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'feel' — his fe'li, undan keyin SIFAT.
'I feel tiredly' — XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: WHAT'S THE MATTER? / WHAT'S WRONG WITH YOU?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Tony, what's the matter? — I've got a terrible headache.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Toni, nima bo'ldi? — Boshim juda qattiq og'riyapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Kasal odamdan so'raladigan ikki savol.
Ma'nosi bir xil.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You can use the telephone. You can't keep pets.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Telefondan foydalanishingiz mumkin. Uy hayvonlarini saqlay olmaysiz.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
can = ruxsat berish
can't = ruxsat bermaslik
Hech qanday shaxsda -S QO'SHILMAYDI.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You must make the bed. You mustn't smoke in hospitals.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: To'shakni yig'ishtirishingiz kerak. Kasalxonalarda chekish mumkin emas.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
must = majburiyat (obligation)
mustn't = taqiq (prohibition)
DIQQAT: mustn't ≠ don't have to!

sentencePatterns.formula: CAN I + [fe'l]?  /  DO I HAVE TO + [fe'l]?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can I play loud music? — No, you can't.  Do I have to make the bed? — Yes, you do.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Baland musiqa qo'ysam bo'ladimi? — Yo'q. To'shakni yig'ishtirishim shartmi? — Ha.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'Can I ...?' — RUXSAT so'rash
'Do I have to ...?' — MAJBURIYAT so'rash
'Do I can ...?' — XATO!

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You must keep the classroom clean. You mustn't fight in class.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sinfxonani toza tutishingiz kerak. Darsda urishmang.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
IJOBIY qoida → MUST
SALBIY qoida → MUSTN'T
'must' dan keyin 'to' YO'Q.

sentencePatterns.formula: CAN I + [ASOSIY fe'l] ... ?  —  Yes, of course you CAN. / No, you CAN'T.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can I use your phone, please? — Yes, of course you can.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Telefoningizdan foydalansam bo'ladimi? — Ha, albatta bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ruxsat so'rash va berish/rad etish.
Qisqa javob savoldagi modalni takrorlaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: DO I HAVE TO + [fe'l]?  —  Yes, you do! You MUST + [fe'l].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Do I have to wash the dishes? — Yes, you do! You must wash the dishes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Idish yuvishim shartmi? — Ha, shart! Idish yuvishingiz kerak.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Savolda 'have to', javobda 'must'.
101-betdagi 12-mashq bilan bir xil naqsh.

sentencePatterns.formula: No, you CAN'T. You MUSTN'T + [fe'l] — it's illegal.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can I park here? — No, you can't. You mustn't park here — it's illegal.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu yerga mashina qo'ysam bo'ladimi? — Yo'q. Bu yerga qo'yish mumkin emas — qonunga xilof.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'can't' — shaxsiy rad etish;
'mustn't' — QONUNIY taqiq (kuchaytirish).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You should see an optician. You shouldn't go to bed so late.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ko'z shifokoriga borishingiz kerak. Bunchalik kech yotmasligingiz kerak.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
MASLAHAT — 'must' dan yumshoqroq.
99-betdagi 'Giving Advice' qutisidan.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Always wear a hat. Never swim after eating. Don't drop litter on the beach.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Doim shlyapa kiying. Ovqatdan keyin suzmang. Plyajga axlat tashlamang.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Varaqaning asosiy qolipi.
FOYDALI → ALWAYS
XAVFLI → NEVER / DON'T

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It protects your skin from the hot sun. They protect your eyes from the sun.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U teringizni issiq quyoshdan himoya qiladi. Ular ko'zlaringizni quyoshdan himoya qiladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'protect ... FROM ...' — predlog 'from'.
BIRLIK → it protectS (-S bilan)
KO'PLIK → they protect (-S siz)

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It is dangerous to swim with a full stomach.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: To'la oshqozon bilan suzish xavfli.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'It is + SIFAT + TO + fe'l' qurilmasi
(100-betdagi 'It is polite to take a gift'
bilan bir xil).

sentencePatterns.formula: THERE IS ALWAYS A DANGER OF + [OT].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There is always a danger of accidents.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Har doim baxtsiz hodisa xavfi bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'a danger OF something' — predlog 'of'.
'There is ...' — mavjudlik qurilmasi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Never light fires in forests. Trees will burn.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'rmonlarda hech qachon olov yoqmang. Daraxtlar yonib ketadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Har qoida ALOHIDA qatorda,
keyin uning SABABI.
99-betdagi varaqa aynan shunday tuzilgan.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kirgan yurtingning odatiga qara.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'when in X' = 'when you are in X'.
100-betdagi 'When in China' bilan bir xil.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You should take regular exercise. You shouldn't drop rubbish in the street.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Muntazam jismoniy mashq qilishingiz kerak. Ko'chaga axlat tashlamasligingiz kerak.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
MASLAHAT.
-S qo'shilmaydi, 'to' yo'q, 'do' kerak emas.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You must be home by 11 pm. You mustn't park here. Must I stay?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 11 gacha uyda bo'lishingiz kerak. Bu yerga mashina qo'yish mumkin emas. Qolishim kerakmi?

MAJBURIYAT / TAQIQ.
So'roqda MUST oldinga chiqadi.
'mustn't' talaffuzi: birinchi 'T' JIM.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They can swim well. They cannot / can't swim well. You can watch TV.

QOBILIYAT yoki RUXSAT.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I could swim when I was five. They couldn't swim well.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Besh yoshimda suza olardim. Ular yaxshi suza olmasdi.

'could' — 'can' ning o'tgan zamoni.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can they swim? Could they swim? Could you help me?
