So'roq: modal EGADAN OLDIN.
'Could you ...?' — odobli iltimos ham bo'ladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: WHY DON'T YOU + [fe'l]?  /  I (DON'T) THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO + [fe'l].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Why don't you take regular exercise? I don't think it's a good idea to eat junk food.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Muntazam mashq qilsangiz-chi? Menimcha, zararli tez ovqat yeyish yaxshi fikr emas.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Qo'shimcha maslahat shakllari.
Inkor BOSH gapga qo'yiladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Don't enter. / No entry. Don't touch. Don't turn right.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kirmang. Tegmang. O'ngga burilmang.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Belgi va e'lonlar tili.
'NO + -ING' shaklida:
No smoking, No parking, No swimming.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You should always do your homework. Peter shouldn't eat so much junk food.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Doim uy vazifangizni bajarishingiz kerak. Piter bunchalik ko'p zararli ovqat yemasligi kerak.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ravish (always) MODAL bilan ASOSIY FE'L
ORASIDA turadi.
Ega III shaxs bo'lsa ham 'should' o'zgarmaydi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You should feed your cat twice a day. You should take your cat to the vet every six months.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mushugingizni kuniga ikki marta ovqatlantirishingiz kerak. Har olti oyda veterinarga olib borishingiz kerak.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Qisqartma ko'rsatmani to'liq gapga
aylantirish: EGALIK olmoshi va ARTIKL
qo'shiladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You shouldn't forget to fill its water bowl.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uning suv idishini to'ldirishni unutmasligingiz kerak.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
= 'You should REMEMBER to ...'
'forget TO do' — hali qilinmagan ish.
'ITS' — apostrofsiz egalik olmoshi.

sentencePatterns.formula: CAN I + [ASOSIY fe'l] ... ?  —  No, you CAN'T.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can I go to the cinema? — No, you can't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kinoga borsam bo'ladimi? — Yo'q, bo'lmaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
QISQA JAVOB savoldagi MODALNI takrorlaydi.
'Can I ...?' → 'you can't'
('you shouldn't' — savolga mos kelmaydi).

sentencePatterns.formula: CAN + [EGA] + [fe'l]?  —  Yes, you CAN. / No, you CAN'T.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can we touch the animals? — No, you can't. Can we take pictures? — Yes, you can.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hayvonlarga tegsak bo'ladimi? — Yo'q. Suratga olsak bo'ladimi? — Ha.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
QISQA JAVOB savoldagi modalni takrorlaydi.
'You are NOT ALLOWED to' = 'you CAN'T'.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You can take pictures but you mustn't bother them.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Suratga olishingiz mumkin, lekin ularni bezovta qilmang.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'BUT' — ruxsat va taqiqni qarama-qarshi
qo'yadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: [COULD/COULDN'T] + [fe'l] + WHEN I WAS [yosh], BUT I [CAN/CAN'T] NOW.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I couldn't count when I was three but I can now.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uch yoshimda sanay olmasdim, lekin hozir olaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Vaqt belgisi modalni tanlaydi:
'when I WAS' → could
'NOW' → can

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We must hurry or we'll miss the bus.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shoshilishimiz kerak, aks holda avtobusdan qolamiz.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'OR' bu yerda = 'aks holda'.
CB 100-bet: 'Never push into a queue OR
they'll get angry.'

sentencePatterns.formula: IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO + [fe'l]   /   YOU SHOULD + [fe'l]   /   WHY DON'T YOU + [fe'l]?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I think it's a good idea to move to Rome. Maybe you should wait. Why don't you ask your friends?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menimcha, Rimga ko'chish yaxshi fikr. Balki kutsang. Do'stlaringdan so'rasang-chi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Keyingi so'z qaysi ibora ekanini belgilaydi:
'TO + fe'l' → good idea
'fe'l' (to siz) → should
'?' → Why don't you

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She's my niece. That's not your coat. It's mine.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U mening jiyanim. Bu sizning paltongiz emas. Bu meniki.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
OT BOR → my (egalik SIFATI)
OT YO'Q → mine (egalik OLMOSHI)

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Claire is more beautiful than Marie. Your motorbike is noisier than mine.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kler Maridan chiroyliroq. Mototsikilingiz menikidan shovqinliroq.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
QIYOSIY daraja — 'THAN' SHART.
Qisqa sifat → -ER; uzun sifat → MORE.

sentencePatterns.formula: THE + [sifat]+EST / THE MOST + [sifat] + OF ALL / IN THE ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The Pyramids are the oldest of all. The Grand is the most luxurious hotel in the area.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Piramidalar hammasidan qadimiy. Grand — hududdagi eng hashamatli mehmonxona.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
USTUN daraja — 'THE' SHART.
'of all' yoki 'in the ...' bilan keladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: THERE WAS / WERE + [ot] + [o'tgan vaqt].  —  DID you [fe'l]?  —  No, I DIDN'T.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There was a great film on TV yesterday. Did you see it? — No, I didn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kecha televizorda ajoyib film bor edi. Ko'rdingizmi? — Yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Past Simple savolida 'DID + ASOSIY shakl'.
'Did you saw' — XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: ARE YOU GOING TO + [fe'l] ... ?  —  Yes, I AM.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Are you going to wear it to the party tonight? — Yes, I am.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bugun bazmga uni kiyasizmi? — Ha, kiyaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
REJA — 'be going to'.
Qisqa javobda faqat 'be' qoladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I think I'll have a bowl of soup. Okay. I'll call you tomorrow.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'ylaymanki, bir kosa sho'rva ichaman. Yaxshi. Ertaga qo'ng'iroq qilaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
AYNI DAMDAGI qaror → WILL.
'I think I'll ...' — juda keng tarqalgan qolip.

sentencePatterns.formula: DO they + [fe'l]?  —  Yes, they DO.   /   'Do I have to ...?' — 'Yes, you do.'
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Do they live in a flat? — Yes, they do.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular kvartirada yashashadimi? — Ha, yashashadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
QISQA JAVOB savoldagi yordamchi fe'lni
takrorlaydi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Never eat with your fingers. Always use a knife and fork. Don't be late for dinner.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qo'lingiz bilan ovqat yemang. Doim pichoq va sanchqidan foydalaning. Kechki ovqatga kechikmang.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Dasturxon odobi qoidalari — buyruq maylida.
'be late' — 'late' SIFAT bo'lgani uchun 'BE'
kerak.

sentencePatterns.formula: I'VE GOT A / THE / — + [kasallik].  —  You should + [maslahat].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I've got a headache. — You should take an aspirin.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Boshim og'riyapti. — Aspirin ichishingiz kerak.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Kasallik + maslahat dialogi.
Har kasallik O'Z artiklini oladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We should not drop rubbish in the streets because it looks and smells horrible.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ko'chalarga axlat tashlamasligimiz kerak, chunki u dahshatli ko'rinadi va hidlaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Qoida + sabab — 99-betdagi varaqaning
modal bilan qayta yozilgan shakli.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Packaging creates a lot of rubbish. Cars pollute the air.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'ram ko'p axlat hosil qiladi. Mashinalar havoni ifloslantiradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
III shaxs BIRLIK → -S qo'shiladi.
'packaging' sanalmaydigan → BIRLIK.
'cars' → KO'PLIK, -S YO'Q.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We mustn't throw rubbish in the sea either.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Dengizga ham axlat tashlamasligimiz kerak.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: TASDIQ gapda 'too', INKOR gapda 'either'.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He should see an optician. Children shouldn't talk to strangers.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U ko'zoynak ustasiga borishi kerak. Bolalar notanish odamlar bilan gaplashmasligi kerak.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
FOYDALI → SHOULD;  ZARARLI → SHOULDN'T.
Ega III shaxs bo'lsa ham 'should' o'zgarmaydi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You should take your dog for a walk three times a day. You shouldn't keep your dog in a cage.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Itingizni kuniga uch marta sayrga olib chiqishingiz kerak. Qafasda saqlamasligingiz kerak.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Qisqartma ko'rsatmaga EGALIK olmoshi va
PREDLOG qo'shiladi:
'keep/cage' → 'keep your dog IN A cage'.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: before crossing the street; after eating a big meal
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: ko'chadan o'tishdan oldin; ko'p ovqat yegandan keyin
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Predlogdan keyin fe'l DOIM -ING oladi.
'before to cross' — XATO.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: put on a heavy jacket = put a heavy jacket on = put it on
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: qalin kurtka kiymoq
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
OLMOSH bilan faqat O'RTADA:
'put IT on' ✓ / 'put on IT' ✗

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Always have a torch with you. Never leave rubbish behind.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Doim qo'l fonarini yoningizda olib yuring. Hech qachon axlat tashlab ketmang.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You must be quiet. You mustn't smoke. You mustn't eat or drink.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jim bo'lishingiz kerak. Chekmasligingiz kerak. Yeyish yoki ichish mumkin emas.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: No, you can't! You mustn't take any pictures.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yo'q, bo'lmaydi! Suratga olmasligingiz kerak.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where can we eat? — You can eat in the restaurant which is next to the museum.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qayerda ovqat yeya olamiz? — Muzey yonidagi restoranda yeyishingiz mumkin.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Savol so'zi + MODAL + ega + fe'l.
Javob ham bir xil modal bilan.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Harvey should take singing lessons because he has a fantastic voice. You can't go to the cinema because you have to do your homework.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xarvi qo'shiq darslariga borishi kerak, chunki ovozi ajoyib. Kinoga bora olmaysiz, chunki uy vazifangiz bor.

sentencePatterns.formula: Do I have to + [fe'l]?  —  Yes you do. You MUST + [fe'l].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Do I have to go to school? — Yes you do. You must go to school.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Maktabga borishim shartmi? — Ha, shart. Maktabga borishingiz kerak.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Savolda 'have to', javobda 'must'.
CB 101-bet, 12-mashq bilan bir xil naqsh.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Nobody heard anything. Nobody saw anything.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hech kim hech narsa eshitmadi. Hech kim hech narsa ko'rmadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'nobody' allaqachon inkor, shuning uchun
keyingi so'z 'anything' ('nothing' EMAS).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Why didn't anybody hear anything? — Because they live quite far from the other houses.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nega hech kim eshitmadi? — Chunki ular boshqa uylardan ancha uzoqda yashaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'Why' savoliga DOIM 'Because' bilan javob.
DIQQAT: javobda olmoshlar UCHINCHI shaxsga
o'zgaradi ('we' → 'they').

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You should lock your doors, so thieves can't get into the house easily. Buy a guard dog because thieves are usually scared of dogs.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Eshiklaringizni qulflang, shunda o'g'rilar oson kira olmaydi. Qorovul it oling, chunki o'g'rilar itlardan qo'rqadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'SO' — NATIJA;  'BECAUSE' — SABAB.
Maslahat xatining asosiy qolipi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Thieves are usually scared of dogs.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'g'rilar odatda itlardan qo'rqadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Predlog 'OF' SHART.
Shu kabi: afraid of, frightened of.
